439.d: Kaks istuvat naist seljaga vaataja poole. Nende taga puud ja põõsad
439.de: Two women sitting with their backs to the viewer. Behind them trees and bushes

448.d: Tumedajuukselise mehe poolfiguur. Keha pool-, pea täisprofiilis vasemale. Vasak käsi ülal pea kohal, parem kepiga rinnakohal.
448.de: Half-figure of a dark-haired man. Body in half-profile, head in full profile to the left. Left hand raised above the head, right hand with a cane at chest level.

449.d: Vaade suvisele tänavale sinise hoonega tagaplaanil ja puudega pahemal pool ees. Paremal tänav hoonetega.
449.de: View of a summer street with a blue building in the background and trees on the left in front. On the right a street with buildings.

450.d: Laua taga istuva mehe poolfiguur. Ees avatud leht. Pea pöördega paremale.
450.de: Half-figure of a man sitting at a table. An open sheet in front. Head turned to the right.

451.d: Laua taga istuva mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Pea toetatud vasakule käele. Laual vasakul punaste kaantega raamat.
451.de: Bust portrait of a man sitting at a table, in half-profile to the right. His head resting on his left hand. On the table on the left a book with red covers.

452.d: Vaade ülalt alla vooremaastikule. Ees keskel järv. Selle äärest algavas voorte  vahelises orus majad ja rida puid. Taga mets.
452.de: View from above onto a hilly (voore) landscape. In the front centre, a lake. In the valley between the hills starting from its shore, houses and a row of trees. Forest behind.

453.d: Tumedajuukselise laua taga istuva mehe poolfiguur, peaaegu en face. Paremas käes sulepea; vasakus suitsev pabeross.
453.de: Half-figure of a dark-haired man seated at a table, almost en face. In his right hand a pen; in his left a smoking cigarette.

454.d: Esiplaanil jõekäär. Paremal jõest ülal kaldal tee telefoniliiniga. Vasataskaldal künkal üksikuid põõsaste ja puude gruppe. Taga keskel vardas Eesti lipp.
454.de: In the foreground a bend in the river. On the right, above the river on the bank, a road with a telephone line. On the left bank, on a hillock, isolated groups of bushes and trees. In the middle background, the Estonian flag on a pole.

456.d: Käsipõsakil punase kattega lauale nõjatuva keskealise kiilaspäise mehe poolfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Parempoolses suunurgas põlev pabeross, pilk suunatud tema vastas istuvale mehele, sellest näha žestikuleerivas hoiakus vasakut kätt, vasakut külge ja diagonaalis laual lebavat ajalehe poognat.
456.de: The half-figure of a middle-aged bald man, resting his cheek on his hand, leaning on a table with a red cover, in half-profile to the right. A burning cigarette in the right corner of his mouth, his gaze directed at the man sitting opposite him, of whom his left hand, his left side, and a diagonally lying newspaper sheet on the table are visible in a gesturing posture.

457.d: Seisva mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Juustes veidi halli, näpitsprillid. Hall kuub, punasetriibuline kaelaside, valge krae.
457.de: Half-figure of a standing man, in profile to the left. A little gray in the hair, pince-nez glasses. Gray coat, red-striped necktie, white collar.

460.d: Pildi esiplaanil järv, mille kaldal taamal majad. Silmapiiril kõrge mägimassiiv ning kollakashall taevas. Vasakul nurgas kivine kaaristuga kaldarinnatis, millel rohelised puud ja põõsad ning valge torniga loss nende vahel. Sinakashallides üldtoonides pilt kohati, eriti puude osas, selgelt eraldavate pintslilöökidega maalitud.
460.de: In the foreground of the picture a lake, with houses on its shore further back. On the horizon a high mountain massif and a yellowish-grey sky. In the left corner a stony arched embankment wall with green trees and bushes, and between them a castle with a white tower. In overall bluish-grey tones, the picture is painted, at places especially in the trees, with clearly separated brush strokes.

466.d: Huvitavas rakursis nähtud tänavapilt, kus inimfiguurid paistavad rinnuni või vööni. Esiplaanil vasakul hallis pikas rüüs ja hallides saabastes matsakas mammi, vasakus käes lillade kaantega raamat ja munade ning juurviljadega täidetud korv. Mammist vasakul räbalates sant, kaabu välja sirutatud, almust palumas. Paremal siidisukkades, mustades lakk-kingades ja tumesinises seelikus daam, kellele omakorda kõnnib vastu soliidses hallis ülikonnas, kinnaste ja jalutuskepiga härrasmees. Paremal servas narmendava rohelise kuulutusega kuulutustulp, esiplaanil roosa sigaretikarp tänaval maas ja punase lehviga valge koerake. Fooniks punastest tellistest müür.
466.de: A street scene seen from an interesting angle, where human figures are shown to the chest or waist. In the foreground on the left, a stout old woman in a long grey robe and grey boots, in her left hand a book with purple covers and a basket filled with eggs and vegetables. To the left of the old woman, a beggar in rags, cap held out, asking for alms. On the right, a lady in silk stockings, black patent-leather shoes and a dark blue skirt, towards whom walks a gentleman in a solid grey suit, with gloves and a walking cane. On the right edge a billboard post with a tattered green announcement, in the foreground a pink cigarette box lying on the street and a white dog with a red bow. The background is a wall of red brick.

477.d: Ühtlaselt halli taeva all vasakul kollakas viljapõld kolme kähara pajupuuga. Silmapiiril rohekashall metsatriip. Maalitud siledate ühtlaste pintslilöökidega.
477.de: Under an evenly grey sky, a yellowish grain field with three curly willow trees on the left. On the horizon a greyish-green strip of forest. Painted with smooth, even brushstrokes.

483.d: Esiplaanil poollamav naisakt, vasak käsi ülestõstetult ümber pea. Naisakti jalgadest paremal ilusa, lainjate poolpikkade juuste, sirge nina ja pruunide silmadega naise portree. Lamava akti kohal vasakul üleelusuuruses näo ülaosa kahe silma ja ninajoonega. Foonil otsekui üksteisesse murduvad tahukad. Pastelne rohekashall-roosa värvigamma.
483.de: In the foreground a semi-reclining female nude, left arm raised around the head. To the right of the nude's legs, a portrait of a woman with beautiful wavy shoulder-length hair, a straight nose and brown eyes. Above the reclining nude on the left an over-life-size upper part of a face with two eyes and the line of a nose. In the background facets seemingly breaking into one another. A pastel greenish-grey-pink colour range.

486.d: 50x38 "Viljandi motiiv" Muks Juhan 40x51, õli, papp 1930.a.(eesti). Asukoht objektil: taga ülal vasakul pliiatsiga
486.de: 50x38 "Viljandi motiiv" Muks Juhan 40x51, oil, cardboard 1930. Location on object: on the back, upper left, in pencil

506.d: Ees vasakul seisev alasti naisfiguur lillepuhmaga paremas kaenlas. Kaelas kollane pearätik. Taustaks suvine maastik veekoguga, taamal talumajad.(eesti)
506.de: In the front on the left a standing nude female figure with a bunch of flowers under her right arm. A yellow headscarf around her neck. Background a summer landscape with a body of water, farmhouses in the distance.

507.d: Esiplaanil jõekaldal supellinal kaks alasti naisfiguuri, vasakpoolne poollamavas, parempoolne istuvas asendis. Taamal lage liivane maastik.(eesti)
507.de: In the foreground on a riverbank, on a bathing sheet, two nude female figures, the left one in a semi-reclining position, the right one seated. Further back a bare sandy landscape.

508.d: Esiplaanil seisev alasti naisfiguur en face juurviljakorviga. Taustaks sügisene maastik.(eesti)
508.de: In the foreground, a standing nude female figure en face with a basket of root vegetables. An autumn landscape in the background.

509.d: Istuva alasti naise põlvpilt, nägu ja õlad peaaegu en face. Keha kerge pöördega vasemale.(eesti)
509.de: Knee-length portrait of a seated nude woman, face and shoulders almost en face. Body turned slightly to the left.

510.d: Esiplaanil meri. Keskel kaldajoon üksiku paadiga. Taamal maju ja taeva foonil paistvaid mäetippe.(eesti)
510.de: In the foreground the sea. In the middle the shoreline with a single boat. In the distance houses and mountain peaks showing against the sky background.

515.d: Esiplaanil akna laual sangaga potis kirjud lilled. Paremal raamat, selle üle rippuva valge rätikuga. Taustaks vaade Narva kindlusele: vasakul Ivangorod, paremal Hermani kindlus.(eesti)
515.de: In the foreground, on a windowsill, colourful flowers in a pot with a handle. On the right a book, over which a white towel hangs. In the background a view of Narva Fortress: on the left Ivangorod, on the right Hermann Castle.

520.d: Ees keskel laual viiul poognaga, sellest paremal mannekeeni pea, tagapool vasakul kõrvaga kannus lilled.(eesti)
520.de: In the front centre on the table a violin with a bow, to its right a mannequin's head, behind on the left flowers in a jug with a handle.

526.d: Kahe istuva tütarlapse (peaaegu en face) poolfiguurid. Vasapoolsel käes lehvik, parempoolsel teatrikava. Taust erkpunane.
526.de: Half-figures of two seated girls (almost en face). The one on the left holds a fan, the one on the right a theatre programme. Background bright red.

527.d: Ees keskel harkisjalu seisev naine. Vasakus käes kann jooksva veekraani all. Taga väike kaheruuduline aken.
527.de: In the centre foreground a woman standing with legs apart. In her left hand a jug under a running water tap. Behind, a small two-paned window.

534.d: Veest kerkivad kaks teravatipulist kaljut. Esiplaanil all paremal linnulennult vaadatud maaribal mõned miniatuursed paadid ja paar maja. Kaljud pehmeis hallikas-beežides toonides, veepind tugev-sinine.
534.de: Two sharp-peaked cliffs rise from the water. In the foreground, lower right, on a strip of land seen as if from a bird's-eye view, a few miniature boats and a couple of houses. The cliffs in soft grayish-beige tones, the water surface strong blue.

535.d: Istuva keskealise mehe poolfiguur veerandpöördes paremale, must kübar peas, tume ülikond seljas. Mehe nägu pruunides-ookertoonides selgelt välja vormitud. Sinised silmad, tumedad sirged kulmud, sirge nina, huuled kokku pigistatud. Vasak õlg veidi tõstetud, käsi toetub põlvele, parem kõverdatult süles. Kaeluses kriiskavvalge särgikrae, punane lips ees, valge rätt rinnatasukus. Foon beežikas, kohati heledama sinaka jumega.
535.de: Half-length figure of a seated middle-aged man in three-quarter turn to the right, wearing a black hat and a dark suit. The man's face is clearly modelled in brown-ochre tones. Blue eyes, dark straight eyebrows, straight nose, lips pressed together. Left shoulder slightly raised, hand resting on the knee, right hand bent in the lap. At the neckline a glaringly white shirt collar, a red tie in front, a white handkerchief in the breast pocket. Background beige, in places with a lighter bluish tinge.

536.d: Pruunil alusel, viimasega lähedases toonis vaasis valged ja punased nelgid ja paar avatud õiega roosat roosi. Foon tume.
536.de: On a brown base, in a vase of a similar tone, white and red carnations and a couple of open pink roses. Dark background.

544.dm: graafikaplaadi kõrgus: 5.1 cm; lehe laius: 4.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 5.7 cm; graafikaplaadi laius: 3.5 cm
544.d: päikesekiirtes viljakõrred, lõokesepesa viie pojaga ning lendav lõoke, esiplaanil avatud raamat
544.de: grain stalks in sunlight, a lark's nest with five chicks and a flying lark, an open book in the foreground

545.d: vapp-eksliibris talurahvakunsti motiividel, kummalgi küljel neli puust hobusepead
545.de: coat-of-arms bookplate with peasant art motifs, on each side four wooden horse heads

547.d: Kahepoolse trepiga maja, trepi ees seisab naine, tema jalge ees kolm hane. Udune akvarellilik maalilaad.
547.de: A house with a double-sided staircase, in front of the staircase stands a woman, in front of her feet three geese. Hazy watercolour-like painting style.

548.de: Aerial view of houses and trees

552.de: Aquatint Location on object: lower left

556.de: two young women side by side

571.d: Laual jänes, juurvili, taldrik õuntega, sinine rätik ja paremal samovar.
571.de: On the table a hare, vegetables, a plate with apples, a blue cloth and a samovar on the right.

573.d: Esiplaanil vasakul poollamavas asendis naise figuur. Jalgade juures avatud vihmavari. Tagapool keskel neli naise täisfiguuri. Taga vasakul ja paremal kõrged vanad pajud.
573.de: In the foreground on the left a semi-reclining female figure. An open umbrella at her feet. Behind, in the middle, four full-length female figures. Behind, on the left and right, tall old willows.

574.d: Eest keskelt otse taha all suunduv tänav 2 - 3 kordsete hoonetega vasakul ja kivimüüriga paremal. Kõnniteel inimfiguure. Üle maja katuste paistab tagaplaanil roheline väljak, selle ääres majade rägastik.
574.de: A street running straight back from the centre front, with 2–3-storey buildings on the left and a stone wall on the right. Human figures on the pavement. Above the roofs of the houses, a green square is visible in the background, with a maze of houses along its edge.

576.d: Ees laual kastrul, kohvikann, poolik kõrvits. Laua taga kaussi kuivatava naise poolfiguur; pea poolprofiilis vasakule.
576.de: In front, on a table, a saucepan, a coffee pot, a half pumpkin. Behind the table, a half-figure of a woman drying a bowl; head in half-profile to the left.

578.d: Esiplaanil kollasel vaibal seljaga meesfiguur sinist särki ära võtmas. Vasakul tooli kohale kummardunud punases särgis trummilööja, kelle taga seisavad inimesed ja eemalt paistavad linnamajad. Paremal kinnine vanker trepiga.
578.de: In the foreground, on a yellow carpet, a male figure seen from behind taking off a blue shirt. On the left a drummer in a red shirt bent over a chair, behind whom people are standing and city buildings can be seen in the distance. On the right a closed carriage with steps.

579.d: Keskel esiplaanil sinine tool mitmesuguste esemetega. Tagaplaanil paremal madal raudahi, mille ees puuhalud.
579.de: In the centre foreground a blue chair with various objects. In the background on the right a low iron stove with firewood logs in front of it.

582.d: Vasakul toolil istub naine, kollane rätt õlgadel ja imetab last. Paremal tagaplaanil istub laua ääres mees pea lauale toetatud. Samas kõrval pudel ja klaas.
582.de: On the left a woman sits on a chair, a yellow shawl on her shoulders, nursing a child. In the background on the right a man sits at a table with his head resting on the table. Beside him a bottle and a glass.

583.d: Noore istuva naise kolmveerandfiguur pöördes paremale. Käed süles kokku pandud. Lühikesed blondid juuksed, kirju roosa krae.
583.de: Three-quarter figure of a young seated woman turned to the right. Hands folded in the lap. Short blond hair, colourful pink collar.

584.d: Esiplaanil paremal heledas pluusis ja tumedas sellikus tüdruk, roosa rätt ümber puusade, kaelas pikk sinine sall. Vasakul lillakas pluusis ja pruunides pükstes poiss. Tagaplaanil inimesi.
584.de: In the foreground on the right a girl in a light blouse and dark skirt, a pink shawl around her hips, a long blue scarf around her neck. On the left a boy in a purplish blouse and brown trousers. People in the background.

585.d: Esiplaanil kalda ääres kaks lotja. Eemal hulk madalaid hooneid, inimesi hobuvankritega.
585.de: In the foreground by the shore two barges. In the distance a number of low buildings, people with horse carts.

586.d: Kanalivaade majade ja puudega kallastel. Esiplaanil paremal üksik kalastaja, vasaku kalda ääres kaks paati.
586.de: View of a canal with houses and trees on the banks. In the foreground on the right a solitary fisherman, two boats by the left bank.

587.d: Talvine Tartu vaade külmrohelise jõe, pruunide laevade ja vastaskaldalt paistvate pruunikate majadega.
587.de: Winter view of Tartu with a cold-green river, brown ships and brownish houses visible on the opposite bank.

588.d: Otsevaates mehe poolfiguur. Vasak käsi puusas, paremas käes pintsel ja lapp; peas kaabu.
588.de: Frontal half-figure of a man. Left hand on hip, in the right hand a brush and a rag; a hat on his head.

589.d: Esiplaanil aiamaa, kus töötavad neli inimest, vasempoolne figuur teeb lõket. Keskplaanil madalad agulimajad. 1/3 pildipinnast sinine taevas. Maalitud erksates toonides, kirju üldmõju.
589.de: In the foreground a vegetable garden where four people are working, the left-hand figure making a bonfire. In the middle ground low suburban houses. 1/3 of the picture surface is blue sky. Painted in bright tones, colourful overall impression.

590.d: Vasakul kipsist lapsefiguur, punase laiaäärse peakattega; jalge ees linnutopis ja paar sibulat. Paremal mustrilisel drapeeringul linnutopis ja kahe kõrvaga savipott. Paremal all avatuna väike kohver.
590.de: On the left a plaster child figure with a red wide-brimmed headdress; in front of its feet a stuffed bird and a couple of onions. On the right, on a patterned drapery, a stuffed bird and a two-eared clay pot. At the bottom right, a small open suitcase.

591.de: EKN Moskvas 1935. Location on the object: mark

607.de: K. Liiman. Location on object: on the back, on the stretcher

609.d: Istuv pakkjalgadega naine, laps ees seismas(eesti)
609.de: A seated woman with splayed legs, a child standing in front

615.d: Esiplaanil kaks põlvitavat naist. Üks käpuli hõredaid odrakõrsi haaramas, teine seelikusaba vöö vahele seadmas. Taamal kiviaedu ja hobune vankriga.
615.de: In the foreground two kneeling women. One on all fours grasping sparse barley stalks, the other tucking her skirt hem into her belt. In the background stone fences and a horse with a cart.

630.d: Lõua alt setud terava otsaga mütsikesega väikelapse portreepea, valkjas glasuur
630.de: Portrait head of a small child with a small cap tied under the chin with a pointed tip, whitish glaze

631.dm: kõrgus: 43.0 cm; sügavus: 24.0 cm; laius: 19.5 cm
631.d: Keskealise mehe täidlane raskepäraste vormidega nägu, juustepiir taandunud, lühike soeng, tugevad kulmud väike nina
631.de: The full, heavy-featured face of a middle-aged man, receding hairline, short hairstyle, strong eyebrows, small nose

633.dm: kõrgus: 40.0 cm; sügavus: 22.5 cm; laius: 18.0 cm
633.d: Noore mehe portreepea, juuksed üle pea kammitud, sisselõigatud silmad, madalad kulmud, ümar väike lõug
633.de: Portrait head of a young man, hair combed back over the head, incised eyes, low eyebrows, small round chin

639.dm: kõrgus: 73.5 cm; sügavus: 14.0 cm; laius: 26.0 cm
639.d: Tugevate jäsemetega seisev naisakt hoiab draperiid mõlema käega vasakul puusal. Teos on lõpetamata.
639.de: A standing female nude with strong limbs holds drapery with both hands at the left hip. The work is unfinished.

640.dm: kõrgus: 31.0 cm; sügavus: 27.0 cm; laius: 21.0 cm
640.d: Noore naise pea kaela alt lõigatud, pilukil silmad, väike kühmuga nina, rikkalikud juuksed keskelt lahku kammitud ja kõrvu katvad juuksed koondatud kuklasse soeng
640.de: Head of a young woman cut off below the neck, slanted eyes, small nose with a bump, rich hair parted in the middle and hair covering the ears gathered into a bun at the nape

710.d: Esiplaanil laud. Sellel avatud raamat. Raamatul tikutoos ja kinnas, tindipott, likööripudel, sinine email-kann ja valge email-kann lilledega, kerajas likööripudel ja punase oriendi karp. Taustaks draperii kirjust ja sinisest rätikust.
710.de: In the foreground a table. On it an open book. On the book a matchbox and a glove, an inkpot, a liqueur bottle, a blue enamel jug and a white enamel jug with flowers, a spherical liqueur bottle and a red oriental box. The background is a drapery of a mottled and blue cloth.

715.d: Esiplaanil jõel laev, selle lael kaks inimkuju. Keskel sild, taamal maju.
715.de: In the foreground a ship on the river, with two human figures on its deck. A bridge in the middle, houses beyond.

728.d: Geometriseeritud vormides kompositsioon: esiplaanil keskel külgvaates, tumedate juustega ja sinise näoga naine profiilis, musta kontuuriga ümbritsetud. Seljas hele kleit, käte asemel nelinurgad. Vasakul servas musta kontuuriga geomeetrilistest kujunditest konstruktsioon. Foonil mitmevärvilised nelinurgad üksteisesse põimumas. Peamiselt roosakas-pruunides, sinistes ja kollastes toonides.
728.de: A composition in geometrized forms: in the foreground in the centre, in side view, a dark-haired woman with a blue face in profile, surrounded by a black contour. She wears a light-coloured dress, and instead of arms there are quadrangles. On the left edge a construction of geometric shapes with a black contour. In the background multicoloured quadrangles interlocking with one another. Mainly in pinkish-brown, blue and yellow tones.

729.d: Allservas diagonaalselt üle pildi allosa jooksev kollane tee, millest kahel pool suured põlised puud. Foonil tumedam sinine rahutu taevas. Sügav sinakasroheline koloriit.
729.de: In the lower part a yellow road running diagonally across the bottom of the picture, with large old trees on both sides. In the background a darker restless blue sky. Deep bluish-green colouring.

2083.d: Hallipäise, moka- ja väikses lõuahabemega mehe rinnapilt. Keha poolprofiilis paremale. Pea kerge pöördega samas suunas. Taust sinine.
2083.de: Bust of a grey-haired man with a moustache and small chin beard. Body in three-quarter profile to the right. Head slightly turned in the same direction. Blue background.

2085.d: Esiplaanil üksikute noorte kuuskede vahelt vasakule kulgev lumine rada. Taamal hooneid.
2085.de: In the foreground a snowy path leading to the left among scattered young spruces. Buildings in the distance.

2232.d: Vaade talvisele Tartu sadamale. Esiplaanil kai ääres seisvaid laevu, keskosas pontoonsild, taamal kahelpool jõge maju, pärmivabrikuga keskel.
2232.de: View of the winter harbour of Tartu. In the foreground ships standing at the quay, in the middle section a pontoon bridge, in the distance houses on both sides of the river, with the yeast factory in the centre.

2234.d: Naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale. Seljas punane pluus. Lillakas-punane toon domineerib. Frisuur antud laiade, pastoossete pintslitõmmetega.
2234.de: Bust portrait of a woman in half-profile to the right. Wearing a red blouse. Purplish-red tone dominates. Hairstyle rendered with broad, pastose brushstrokes.

2236.d: Esialal madalal rannaribal vasakul põõsapuhmas, paremal kaks kõrget mändi. Madala horisondiga merepinnal peegeldub punetav, kolm neljandikku pildipinnast haarav taevas.
2236.de: In the foreground on a low strip of shore on the left a bush, on the right two tall pines. On the sea surface with a low horizon a reddening sky is reflected, occupying three quarters of the picture surface.

2385.d: Suvine vaade rohekasbeežile lameda tipuga mäele. Esiplaanil hallikad, rohekad kivirahnud, vasakul kividest laotud rinnatis tõuseb mäkke. Silmapiiril vasakul, helesinise taeva taustal peente tüvedega käharad puud. Maalitud tugeva faktuuriga, kohati värvi pinnale vormides.
2385.de: A summer view of a greenish-beige, flat-topped mountain. In the foreground, greyish, greenish boulders; on the left a parapet built of stones rises up the mountain. On the horizon on the left, curly-crowned trees with slender trunks against a pale blue sky background. Painted with a strong texture, in places the paint modelled on the surface.

2387.d: Esiplaanil, lumisel väljal astuv hobune reega, külgvaates. Reel asuvatel rohekatel jääpankadel istub tumedais rõivais mees, vasak käsi hoiab ohje, parem toetub jääplokile. Tagaplaanil kaks lumise katusega talumaja, silmapiiril sinine metsatriip. Maalitud vorme üldistavalt, laiade pintslilöökidega, pastoosselt.
2387.de: In the foreground, a horse pulling a sledge, walking across a snowy field, seen from the side. On the sledge, on greenish ice blocks, sits a man in dark clothing, his left hand holding the reins, his right resting on an ice block. In the background two farmhouses with snowy roofs, on the horizon a blue strip of forest. Painted in a generalising manner of forms, with broad, impasto brushstrokes.

2388.d: Esiplaanil vasakul, mäeveerul astmeliselt kuubikutaolised majad päikesevalguses. Nende ees paremal kaks käharat lehtpuud. Tagaplaanil lausk mägi. Maalitud sumedates rohekaspruunides ja ookertoonides laiade vabade pintslilöökidega.
2388.de: In the foreground on the left, on a mountain slope, cube-like houses arranged in steps in sunlight. In front of them on the right, two curly deciduous trees. In the background a sheer mountain. Painted in muted greenish-brown and ochre tones with broad free brush strokes.

2390.d: Hämaras interjööris vasakul lauanurk, selle taga istub sirge seljaga daam, jalg üle põlve poolpöördes paremale. Naisel suure karusnahkse kraega mantel, punase seosega sinakasroheline kübar silmadel. Parem käsi toetub lauale, vasak süles. Tagaplaanil paremal uks, seinal pilt. Maali koloriit tume, hallikassinine.
2390.de: In a dim interior, on the left the corner of a table, behind it sits a lady with a straight back, one leg crossed over the knee in a half-turn to the right. The woman wears a coat with a large fur collar, a bluish-green hat trimmed with red hangs over her eyes. Her right hand rests on the table, her left in her lap. In the background on the right a door, on the wall a picture. The colouring of the painting is dark, greyish blue.

2392.d: Vasakul lauanurk, mille ääres istumas mees, näoga vaataja poole. Laual kolm taldrikut ja pudel. Paremal tüseda naise kolmveerandfiguur, paremas käes taldrik. Ruumi sügavuses roosaka kattega, ovaalse seljatoega tugitool ja seinakell. Maalitud kahvatutes, beežikais toonides.
2392.de: On the left, the corner of a table, at which a man is sitting, facing the viewer. On the table three plates and a bottle. On the right, the three-quarter figure of a stout woman, a plate in her right hand. In the depth of the room an armchair with a pinkish cover and an oval back, and a wall clock. Painted in pale, beige-ish tones.

2474.dm: lehe laius: 17.1 cm; lehe kõrgus: 25.7 cm
2474.d: Esiplaanil mees selgvaates, parem käsi üles tõstetud, vasak ette kõverdatud. Seljas sõduri riided. Vasakul otsevaates sõdur, käed kõrval, paremas käes püss. Taga paremal kolonn inimfiguure ja hobune. Vasakul äärel üksik figuur kõndimas otsevaates, kott seljas. Kauguses majad, inimfiguurid, paremal kihutav hoburakend inimestega, ülal keskel, suure tumeda maja ees õhku paiskuv maapind, vasakul äärel põlev maja.
2474.de: In the foreground a man in front view, right hand raised, left arm bent forward. Wearing soldier's clothes. On the left a soldier in front view, arms at his sides, a rifle in his right hand. Behind on the right a column of human figures and a horse. On the left edge a solitary figure walking in front view, a bag on his back. In the distance houses, human figures, on the right a galloping horse-drawn carriage with people, at the top centre, in front of a large dark house, ground being thrown into the air, on the left edge a burning house.

3298.d: Vasakus nurgas kunstniku enese palja pealaega pea vaatega paremale, õla kõrguselt ära lõigatud. Tagapool tänavaristmik, puudega skväär, voorimees, tillukesi figuure. Tänav suundub kaarega kaugemale, kiriku ja tornide poole. Maal tihedalt läbi maalitud, portrees rõhutatud plastilisust, keskplaanil tähtis osa puude oksastiku mustreil.(eesti)

The street curves further away, towards the church and towers. The painting is densely worked through, plasticity emphasised in the portrait, in the middle ground the pattern of tree branches plays an important role.

3299.d: Aknalaual seisab suures plaanis purk kolme amarülliseõiega, mis ulatuvad pildi ühest servast teiseni ja väike tume naisfiguur - skulptuur. Aknast avaneb vaade linna majadele, mis tõusevad kuni Toompea nõlvani, nii et taevast jääb ülaservas paistma ainult väike riba.(eesti)
3299.de: On the windowsill stands, in a large close-up, a jar with three amaryllis flowers reaching from one edge of the picture to the other, and a small dark female figure - a sculpture. From the window opens a view of the city's houses, rising up to the slope of Toompea, so that only a narrow strip of sky remains visible at the upper edge.

3497.d: Esiplaanil nööridega ümbritsetud alal kollakal vaibal seljaga meesfiguur sinist särki ära tõmbamas. Vasakul kummargil tooli kohal punases särgis ja soniga mees trummi löömas. Tooli najale toetub jõumehe foto. Maas lebavad pomm ja tõstekangid ning suur roheline kohver. Eemal kasseerib poisike nööri taha kogunenud vaatajatelt raha. Tagapool tsirkuse vankrid ja telgid kaugelt paistvate linnamajadega.
3497.de: In the foreground, within an area bounded by ropes, on a yellowish carpet, a male figure with his back turned is pulling off a blue shirt. On the left, a man bent over a chair, wearing a red shirt and cap, is beating a drum. A photograph of a strongman leans against the chair. On the ground lie a weight and lifting bars and a large green suitcase. In the distance a boy is collecting money from spectators gathered behind the rope. Further back circus wagons and tents with town houses visible in the distance.

3498.d: Esiplaanil tugevate pintslilöökidega, pastoosselt maalitud valgetes õites puu, millest paremal roosas pluusis, sinises seelikus ja pearätis kummarduv naine. Keskplaanis väljaehitusega maja ning kõrvalhoone, tagaplaanil teisigi maju vasakul, ülal pilvedes taevas. Esiplaanil kolm keppidele toetuvat taimepuhmast pildiservast välja ulatumas.
3498.de: In the foreground, painted with strong brushstrokes in impasto, a tree in white blossom, to the right of which a woman bends over, wearing a pink blouse, a blue skirt and a headscarf. In the middle ground a house with an extension and an outbuilding, in the background other houses to the left, above them a sky in clouds. In the foreground three plant clumps supported by sticks project beyond the edge of the picture.

3499.d: Pildi alumises pooles värviliselt sillerdav jõgi, kaldariba ja vee kohale küündiva puuga paremal. Vasakul kaldal paadid, mõnes istuvad inimesed. Rohelise rohu, puukese ja paari põõsaga kaetud kaldast tagapool tänav kõndivate inimestega ning punasteks, kollasteks, roheliseks ja valgeks värvitud majad. Ülal sinine, valgete pilvedega taevas. Eredad rõõmsad värvitoonid, paadid ja vesi kohati kaunis pastoosselt maalitud.
3499.de: In the lower half of the picture, a river shimmering with colour, a strip of shore and a tree reaching over the water on the right. On the left bank, boats, in some of which people are sitting. Behind the bank, covered with green grass, a small tree and a couple of bushes, a street with walking people and houses painted red, yellow, green and white. Above, a blue sky with white clouds. Bright, joyful colour tones, the boats and water painted in places quite impasto.

3500.d: Kerges paremalepöördes istuva naise põlvportree. Küünarnukist tõstetud parem käsi toetub diivani seljatoele, vasak, sõrmustatud käsi, puhkab põlvedele laotatud elevandiluukarva narmastega rätikul. Seljas ühesuguses sinises toonis seelik ja kübar ning kirju pluus. Foon tumedated hallides ja pruunides toonides.
3500.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman sitting in a slight turn to the right. Her right arm, raised from the elbow, rests on the back of a sofa, her left hand, wearing a ring, rests on a shawl with ivory-coloured fringes laid over her knees. She wears a skirt and hat of the same blue tone and a colourful blouse. The background is in dark grey and brown tones.

3511.d: rannas kuivavad võrgud, mehed ja seapõrsad

3512.dm: lehe laius: 46.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 33.5 cm

3513.d: sinine meri, kollane taevas ja rannal hulk inimesi
3513.de: blue sea, yellow sky and a crowd of people on the shore

3514.dm: lehe kõrgus: 31.5 cm; lehe laius: 23.5 cm
3514.d: Vasakul ohaka latv õienuttidega, paremal osa varrest lehtedega.
3514.de: On the left the top of a thistle with flower buds, on the right part of a stem with leaves.

3520.dm: lehe laius: 14.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 17.0 cm
3520.d: Profiilis vasakule sammumas, pea veidi kuklas, kepiga mees. Tema kõrval paljajalu poisike
3520.de: Walking in profile to the left, head slightly tilted back, a man with a stick. Beside him a barefoot little boy

3526.d: Etüüdilik kompositsioon taluõuest. Esiplaanil lippaed kinnise väravaga. Värava ees sammuvad valged haned ja seisab naisfiguur selg.ees. Taamal paistab kaks taluhoonet.
3526.de: Study-like composition of a farmyard. In the foreground a picket fence with a closed gate. White geese are walking in front of the gate and a female figure stands with her back turned. In the distance two farm buildings can be seen.

3547.dm: kõrgus: 22.0 cm; sügavus: 19.0 cm; laius: 35.5 cm
3547.d: Kaks jässakat hobust seismas harkis jalgadega teineteise vastas
3547.de: Two stocky horses standing with legs apart facing each other

3742.d: Kolmest naisfiguurist koosnev kompositsioon: tumedate puude all paremal vilepilli puhuv, vasakul lamav ja vasakul ülal lambatallega naisakt. Tumedad hallikaspruunid värvitoonid, maalitud piirjooni hajutavalt.
3742.de: A composition of three female figures: under dark trees, on the right a nude woman playing a pipe, on the left a reclining one, and above on the left a nude woman with a lamb. Dark greyish-brown colour tones, painted with diffused contour lines.

3746.de: Linocut. Location on the object: lower left

5271.d: ME TÕUS JA LANGUS - ÜHES RAAMATUGA+ Lõikejoone all: F.SANNAMEES. Asukoht objektil: esikülg
5271.de: ME TÕUS JA LANGUS - ÜHES RAAMATUGA+ Below the cutting line: F.SANNAMEES. Location on object: front

5272.de: Death mask of a man with an elongated face

5277.dm: laius: 49.5 cm (uus alusraam); kõrgus: 50.5 cm; kõrgus: 52.0 cm (uus alusraam ); laius: 48.0 cm
5277.d: Neli paremale sammuvat naist, kahel vasakpoolsel vasak käsi tõstetud, paremalt teisel naisel kollane kleit ja käsi kaela juurde tõstetud. Kõikide näod antud profiilis, sirged ninad ja rõhutatult mandlilõikelised silmad. Maalitud pastelltoonides, sulavate üleminekutega.
5277.de: Four women striding to the right, the two on the left with their left hand raised, the second woman from the right in a yellow dress with her hand raised to her neck. All faces given in profile, straight noses and emphatically almond-shaped eyes. Painted in pastel tones, with smooth transitions.

5498.dm: lehe laius: 44.2 cm; lehe kõrgus: 36.1 cm
5498.d: Vasakul toanurgas lohakalt üles tehtud magamisase, paremal radiaatori ees toolid esemete ja tumeda rõivaga
5498.de: In the corner of the room on the left a carelessly made bed, on the right chairs in front of a radiator with objects and dark clothing

5664.d: Hallikas üldgammas maalitud linnavaade. Esiplaanil jõgi sinise laevaga. Kaldapealsetel raagus puud. Taamal sillakaaristu ning tihedalt üksteise kõrval kõrguvad majad.
5664.de: A cityscape painted in an overall greyish tone. In the foreground a river with a blue ship. Bare trees on the riverbanks. In the distance a row of bridge arches and houses towering closely next to one another.

5669.d: Vasakul pikas rüüs seisev naine, käed tõstetud silmade kõrgusele. Paremal mustad ristid punasel taustal.
5669.de: On the left a woman standing in a long robe, hands raised to eye level. On the right black crosses on a red background.

5671.dm: kõrgus: 34.5 cm (a) Vm.); laius: 34.5 cm (b) Vm.); kõrgus: 42.0 cm (b) Vm.); laius: 42.0 cm (a) Vm.)
5671.d: I. Talvine äärelinna vaade hallikaspruunides toonides. Esiplaanil oja lumme mattunud sillakesega, kõrge plankaed, värav kõrgete valgete väravapostide vahel. Aia taga helepruun maja, mille ümber raagus puud. Pastoosselt maalitud.
5671.de: I. Winter suburban view in greyish-brown tones. In the foreground a brook with a small bridge buried in snow, a high board fence, a gate between tall white gate posts. Behind the fence a light brown house, surrounded by bare trees. Painted pastosely.

5693.dm: lehe laius: 77.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 81.5 cm
5693.d: Esiplaanil veekogu taga vooremaastik põllulaikude, kahe kollase heleda valgusrefleksi ja sinetava võsa ja kauge metsaga. Tagafoonil rünkpilvine taevas.
5693.de: In the foreground, beyond a body of water, a drumlin landscape with patches of field, two yellow bright light reflections and bluish scrub and distant forest. In the background a sky with cumulus clouds.

5694.d: Üle astangutena tõusvate majade katuste paistab Oleviste kiriku torn. Tornikiiver pildi ülaservaga äralõigatud. Põhitooniks punaka varjundiga pruun.
5694.de: Above the roofs of houses rising in terraces, the tower of St. Olaf's Church is visible. The spire is cut off by the upper edge of the picture. The main tone is a reddish-tinged brown.

5768.d: Kollakaspruuni paberi foonil säravate rohekas-siniste silmadega, sirge nina ja punaste poikvel huultega tütarlapse portree. Helepruunide juuste kiharad raamivad mõlemalt poolt nägu.
5768.de: Against a background of yellowish-brown paper, a portrait of a girl with bright greenish-blue eyes, a straight nose and red slightly parted lips. Curls of light brown hair frame the face on both sides.

5771.d: Keskel helehall pildi sügavusse suunduv tee, millest vasakul triibuline post ja põldu teeveerest eraldav kiviaed. Teest paremal, aia taga taluhooned ja puud ning kooguga kaev. Silmapiiril vasakul tumehalli katusega talumajad ja siluetina antud puud. Ülal helesinine, valkjasroosade pilvedega kaetud taevas.
5771.de: In the middle a light grey road leading into the depth of the picture, to the left of which a striped post and a stone wall separating the field from the roadside. To the right of the road, beyond the wall, farm buildings and trees, and a well with a sweep. On the horizon to the left, farmhouses with dark grey roofs and trees given as silhouettes. Above, a light blue sky covered with whitish-pink clouds.

5777.d: Maalimata foonil rohekas pearätis naeratav tütarlaps otsevaates, pea pisut kallutatud vasakule. Räti alt paistavad otsmikul lahku kammitud tumedad juuksed. Tüdrukul tumedad silmad, terav lõug. Ülakeha markeeritud hallika poolkustunud joonega.
5777.de: Against an unpainted background, a smiling girl in a greenish headscarf, seen frontally, head tilted slightly to the left. Under the scarf, dark hair parted on the forehead is visible. The girl has dark eyes, a sharp chin. The upper body is marked with a grayish, half-faded line.

5803.d: Noore tütarlapse kujutus profiilis paremale. Heledad lokkis juuksed, valge pluus. Must foon.
5803.de: Depiction of a young girl in profile to the right. Light curly hair, white blouse. Black background.

5831.d: Ovaali kujundatud tumesinises valge vestiga kleidis keskealise naise rinnapilt. Krae kinnitatud sõlega. En face.
5831.de: Bust portrait, shaped in an oval, of a middle-aged woman in a dark blue dress with a white vest. Collar fastened with a brooch. En face.

5850.d: Pikliku näoga noormehe rinnaportree, pea pööratud kergelt vasakule, kõrge laup, heledad, lühikesed, sirged juuksed. Seljas kollakaspruun kuub, sinise-valgeruuduline särk  lipsuga. Kokku sulatatud erinevaid toone, kohati pastoosne. Foonil selgelt eristatavad pintslilöögid, hallid, sinised, lillad ja külmrohelised toonid.
5850.de: Bust portrait of a young man with an elongated face, his head turned slightly to the left, a high forehead, light-coloured, short, straight hair. He is wearing a yellowish-brown coat, a blue-and-white checked shirt with a tie. Different tones are blended together, in places pastose. In the background, clearly distinguishable brushstrokes in grey, blue, purple and cold-green tones.

5852.d: Kitsa näoga, õlekarvaliste, ülepea kammitud juustega noore mehe rinnaportree. Pea pöördes paremale, pilk suunatud otse. Särk eest avatud. Maalitud jõulise pintslilöögiga.
5852.de: A bust portrait of a young man with a narrow face and straw-coloured hair combed straight back. Head turned to the right, gaze directed straight ahead. Shirt open at the front. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes.

5853.d: Esiplaanil haljasala, kus jalutavad inimesed. Taga kõrgub Tallinna vanalinn linnamüüri tornide ja majadega. Vasakule jääb Oleviste kirik.
5853.de: In the foreground a green area where people are walking. Behind it rises Tallinn's Old Town with the towers and houses of the town wall. To the left is St. Olaf's Church.

5854.d: Esiplaanil ridastikku diagonaalis paremalt raagus puud, mis lõikavad ülaserva. Tagapool tara, inimfiguurid ja ülaservaga lõikuvad majad.
5854.de: In the foreground, bare trees in a row diagonally from the right, cutting the upper edge. Behind them a fence, human figures and houses cutting the upper edge.

5856.d: Esiplaanil, merel, paat aerutava naise ja võrke paati tõmbava mehega. Eemal teisi paate ja rannariba.
5856.de: In the foreground, at sea, a boat with a woman rowing and a man pulling nets into the boat. In the distance other boats and a shoreline.

5857.d: Esiplaanil osa laevast, tekil kolm meest, neist parempoolseimal käes köis.
5857.de: In the foreground part of a ship, on deck three men, the rightmost holding a rope.

5862.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt paremalt vasakule näha osa laeva pardast kahe mastiga. Paremal üks mees ja vasakul kaks meest purjeid üles tõmbamas. Paremal meri. Kõrge horisont.
5862.de: In the foreground diagonally from right to left part of a ship's side with two masts is visible. At right one man and at left two men hoisting the sails. At right the sea. High horizon.

5893.d: Vasakul mändide all kaks lehma, paremal raiutud puid. Taga mets.
5893.de: On the left under pines two cows, on the right felled trees. Forest behind.

6079.d: Kolm seisvat naisakti: vasakpoolne kerge pöördega paremale, keskmine vasemale; parempoolne en face.
6079.de: Three standing female nudes: the left one slightly turned to the right, the middle one to the left; the right one en face.

6081.d: Profiilis vasakule keskealise mehe poolfiguur, paremast küünanrnukist tõstetud käes puuvarras, vasak käsi rinna kohal; seljas särk, pehme krae ja roheka kaelasidemega.
6081.de: In profile facing left, the half-figure of a middle-aged man, in his raised right hand from the elbow a wooden stick, left hand at chest level; wearing a shirt, a soft collar and a greenish necktie.

6082.d: Istuva vana naise poolfiguur profiilis paremale. Peas valge rätik, ees prillid, käes hoiab raamatut. Maalitud siledalt, ühtlaselt, lokaalselt.
6082.de: Half-figure of a sitting old woman in profile to the right. White kerchief on the head, glasses in front, holding a book in hand. Painted smoothly, evenly, locally.

6091.d: Valges rätikus ja pluusis naine, lambaraudadega käes, lamba kohale kummardumas. Näojooned väga skemaatiliselt antud. Pildi esiplaanil pooleldi pügatud lammas, kellest kõrgemal paremat kätt korv villaga. Koloriit rohekaspruunides ja kollastes värvitoonides. Valgusega on esile tõstetud naise pea ning õlad ja lamba tagaosa.
6091.de: A woman in a white kerchief and blouse, holding sheep shears, bending over a sheep. The facial features are given very schematically. In the foreground a half-shorn sheep, above which, at right, a basket with wool. The colour scheme is in greenish-brown and yellow tones. The woman's head and shoulders, and the sheep's hindquarters, are highlighted with light.

6095.d: Esiplaanil lumine maapind. Taamal rida raagus puid.
6095.de: In the foreground, snowy ground. In the distance a row of bare trees.

6097.d: Esiplaanil veekogu (end. vallikraav) kai ääres seisva praami ja laevaga. Keskel, vasakul madalale kaldale veetud kaks väikest aurikut, paremal järsult tõusev vana linnus all puudega ja üle latvade paistva lootsi torniga; taamal maju ja lehtpuid.
6097.de: In the foreground a body of water (former moat) with a barge and a ship standing by the quay. In the centre, on the left, two small steamships drawn up on the low shore, on the right a steeply rising old fortress with trees below and a pilot's tower visible over the treetops; in the distance, houses and deciduous trees.

6099.d: Laual taldrik banaaniga, selle taga banaane ja apelsin. Vasakul kaks apelsini. Taga keskel põll leht-kaktusega.
6099.de: On the table a plate with a banana, behind it bananas and an orange. On the left two oranges. In the background in the centre an apron with a leaf cactus.

6101.d: Esialal vasakul kivine jõekallas, keskel, peegelduval veepinnal ankrus lootsik õngemehega. Tagapool jõe kallaste ääres pooleldi kaldale tõmmatud paate ja purjekaid, jõe keskel väike purjekas valendava purjega. Taga linna suitsvaid korstnaid ja kirikutorni tipp taeva taustal.
6101.de: In the foreground on the left a rocky riverbank, in the centre, anchored on the reflecting water surface, a small boat with an angler. Further back along the riverbanks, boats and sailboats partly drawn up onto the shore, in the middle of the river a small sailboat with a whitish sail. Behind, the city's smoking chimneys and the tip of a church tower against the sky.

6102.d: Esiplaanil jõgi paatidega. Taga linna panoraam. Vasakul korstnad.
6102.de: In the foreground a river with boats. Behind it a panorama of the city. On the left chimneys.

6109.d: Valgeis rünkpilves sinise taeva foonil esiplaanil vasakul maja ees puude all grupp kirevais riideis naisi pereemaga eesotsas, tema vasta väljasirutatud parema käega Kalev, seljataga kolm meest laegaste ja kannuga, keskel Kalevi ratsu teda hoidva mehega, paremal puude all ratsanike rivi odadega.
6109.de: Against a background of white cumulus clouds and blue sky, in the foreground on the left, in front of a house under trees, a group of women in colourful clothes with the mother of the family at the head, towards her with outstretched right hand Kalev, behind him three men with chests and a jug, in the middle Kalev's steed with a man holding it, on the right under trees a row of horsemen with spears.

6110.d: Valgete pilverünkadega sinisel taevafoonil pildi esiplaanil kolm palveseisakus püstiseisvat naist pikkades maani kuubedes, äärmistel pead rinnal, parempoolsel käed kokkupandult rinnal, keskmisel pea kuklasse kallutatud, vaatega kolmveerand vasakule; vasakul äärel ohvrituli üleskerkiva suitsu
6110.de: Against a blue sky background with white cloud masses, in the foreground of the picture three women stand upright in an attitude of prayer, in long floor-length robes, the outer ones with heads bowed on their chests, the one on the right with hands folded on her chest, the middle one with head tilted back, gazing three-quarters to the left; at the left edge a sacrificial fire with rising smoke.

6111.d: Esiplaanil roheline muru. Paremal riputab naine nööridele pesu, kus ripuvad sinised, kollased, punased, valged pesuesemed. Nööride tagant paistab laudaed, mille taga vasakul põõsad. Sinine taevas.
6111.de: Green grass in the foreground. On the right a woman is hanging laundry on lines, with blue, yellow, red, white pieces of laundry hanging on them. Behind the lines a plank fence is visible, behind which on the left are bushes. Blue sky.

6114.d: Neli alasti figuuri suunduvad väänlevaid kehaliigutusi tehes tantsuekstaasis üle pildi pinna paremalt vasakule. Foon tuhm sinine, maapind roheline, kehad pruunikad, all paremal punane ketas. Leht koosneb mitmest kokkuliimitud tükist.
6114.de: Four nude figures move across the picture surface from right to left in a dance ecstasy, making writhing bodily movements. Background dull blue, ground green, bodies brownish, lower right a red disc. The sheet consists of several pieces glued together.

6115.d: Keskel taeva helesinisel taustal seisev naisakt, sinistest lilledest pärg käes, murul seismas. Naise parem jalg lõdvalt kõverdunud, ümber pea on põimitud pats. Naisest vasakul väike, heledapäine alasti lapsuke seljaga vaataja poole, ülestõstetud käes sinine lill. Kauguses madala silmapiiri kohal valged pilved.
6115.de: In the centre, against the light blue background of the sky, a standing female nude with a wreath of blue flowers in her hand, standing on grass. The woman's right leg is loosely bent, a braid is wound around her head. To the left of the woman a small, fair-haired naked child with its back to the viewer, holding a blue flower in its raised hand. In the distance, above the low horizon, white clouds.

6148.d: Vasakul uduvines meri, paremal kivine rand: esiplaanil võrku parandav naine ja neli last, kaks figuuri jalgupidi vees; tagapool paadid, kalurimajad ja kalakuurid. Maalitud kahvatutes toonides, hallikas üldgammas.
6148.de: On the left a misty sea, on the right a rocky shore: in the foreground a woman mending a net and four children, two figures with their feet in the water; further back boats, fishermen's houses and fish sheds. Painted in pale tones, a greyish overall colour scheme.

6154.d: Toas avatud akna all voodis magav laps. Vasakul, ukse juures elektrit väljalülitav naine.
6154.de: In the room, under an open window, a child sleeping in bed. On the left, by the door, a woman switching off the electricity.

6177.d: Ateljeenurga vaade ülalt nähtuna: pruunil poodiumil kipstorso selgvaates vaarikapunase draperii taustal. Eespool kollase linaga kaetud taburetil punaseõieline potilill. Vasakul ülal paistmas helesinise raamiga pildinurk, paremal all osa alusest maalivahenditega. Esemeid jälgiv laad, erksad puhtad toonid.
6177.de: A view of a studio corner seen from above: on a brown pedestal a plaster torso in profile against a raspberry-red drapery background. In front, on a stool covered with a yellow cloth, a potted flower with red blossoms. Upper left, a corner of a picture with a light blue frame is visible, lower right part of a stand with painting materials. A style attentive to objects, vivid pure tones.

6226.d: Vaade merele. Ees keskel ja taga suured kivid. Kaugemal lainetel vahused harjad.
6226.de: View of the sea. In the foreground centre and background large rocks. In the distance, foamy crests on the waves.

6227.d: Esiplaanil kännustik suurte üksikute kuuskedega. Kaugemal saetud puud. Vasakult paremale (diagonaalselt) kulgev tee. Taamal mets.
6227.de: In the foreground a clearing with tree stumps and large solitary spruces. Further away sawn trees. A road running diagonally from left to right. In the distance a forest.

6228.dm: lehe laius: 28.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 19.6 cm
6228.d: Vasakul, paremast nurgast taha vasakule suunduv kivine rannaviirg, paremal lainetav meri. 1/3 tööst taeva all.
6228.de: On the left, a rocky coastline running from the right corner into the background to the left, on the right a rippling sea. 1/3 of the work is sky.

6229.d: Esiplaanil oja, ümbritsetud raagus põõsastest. Keskplaanil põllu keskel lumi. Tagaplaanil lagedad põllud, suletud metsaga horisondil.
6229.de: In the foreground a stream, surrounded by bare bushes. In the middle ground snow in the middle of a field. In the background open fields, closed off by forest on the horizon.

6339.d: Rannamaastik väikese lahe ning neemega. Maali keskteljel, paremal puithoonekobarad. Vasakul ja taga, silmapiiril meri, ees mõned suuremad kivid. Paremal pool märgata ka maju ümbritsevaid aedu ning paari üksikut puud. Paremal on ka üks kummuli paat. Maali ülapoole moodustab pilvetupsudega taevas. Koloriidilt hallides toonides. Esiplaanil veidi enam värvielavust. Markeeriv, veidi impressionistlik pintslijoon.
6339.de: A coastal landscape with a small bay and a headland. On the central axis of the painting, on the right, clusters of wooden buildings. On the left and behind, on the horizon, the sea, in front some larger rocks. On the right, gardens surrounding the houses and a couple of solitary trees can also be seen. On the right there is also an upturned boat. The upper part of the painting is formed by a sky with tufts of cloud. The colouring is in grey tones. In the foreground slightly more vividness of colour. A marking, somewhat impressionistic brushstroke.

6365.d: Esiplaanil keset rohelist muru teerada suunaga eest taha hoonete vahele. Teest paremal ja vasakul taluhooned.
6365.de: In the foreground, amid green grass, a path leading from front to back between the buildings. To the right and left of the path, farm buildings.

6375.d: Eest paremalt kaares kaugusesse suunduv külavahetee, vasakul ojakäär. Vasemal üle oja kasesalu. Taamal paremal õlgkatusega taluhooned, horisondil sinav metsaviirg.
6375.de: A village road curving away into the distance on the right, a stream bend on the left. On the left, a birch grove across the stream. In the background on the right, thatched-roof farm buildings, a bluish strip of forest on the horizon.

6401.d: Tugitoolis istuva keskealise naise poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, paljastatud laup, peened näojooned, lühikesed juuksed. Seljas käisteta, avara kaelusega must kleit, seos ehtega vasakul õlal, ümber käsivarre, toolileenil hallikas karusnahk. Natuuri järgiv realistlik kujutamisviis. Sinkjashall taust.
6401.de: A half-figure of a middle-aged woman sitting in an armchair, in three-quarter turn to the left, forehead exposed, fine facial features, short hair. Wearing a sleeveless black dress with a wide neckline, a clasp with a jewel on the left shoulder, around the arm, a greyish fur on the back of the chair. A naturalistic, realistic manner of depiction. Bluish-grey background.

6421.d: Väikese 7-8 a. tütarlapse portree elusuuruses istuvas asendis. Foon tume. Tütarlapsel pruunid, lühikeseks lõigatud juuksed, seljas roosa kleit. Paljad pruunikad käsivarred ja jalasääred. Istub kirju riidega kaetud istmel, asetades ühe jala risti üle teise põlve. Üks käsi asetatud põlvele, teine istmele.
6421.de: A life-size portrait of a small 7–8-year-old girl in a sitting position. Dark background. The girl has brown, short-cropped hair, wearing a pink dress. Bare brownish arms and lower legs. She sits on a seat covered with patterned fabric, placing one leg crossed over the other knee. One hand placed on the knee, the other on the seat.

6422.d: Toolil istuva pikkades pükstes naise täisfiguur. Paremas käes samale õlale toetuv avatud päikesevari. Taustaks põõsastik.
6422.de: Full figure of a woman in long trousers, seated on a chair. In her right hand an open parasol resting on the same shoulder. Background of shrubbery.

6424.d: Otsejoones tahapoole suunduv tänav kõrgete majadega mõlemal pool. Tänaval inimesi ja sõidukeid.
6424.de: A street running straight into the distance with tall houses on both sides. People and vehicles on the street.

6425.d: Akna ees laual tume vaas kollaste ja roosakate õitega, selle ees punaseruuduline rätik ja punutud korvike. Vasakul laeva nurgal klaaskann. Akna taga puud.
6425.de: On a table in front of the window, a dark vase with yellow and pinkish flowers, in front of it a red-checked cloth and a small woven basket. On the left, at the corner of the table, a glass jug. Trees behind the window.

6427.d: Maastik õitsevate põõsastega, ees vasakul valguselaikudega tee naise ja lapsega, tagapool puid ja sinetavat vett, valgeis pilveis taevas.
6427.de: Landscape with flowering bushes, in front on the left a path with patches of light with a woman and a child, behind it trees and bluish water, sky with white clouds.

6431.d: Esiplaanil säravas päikeses rohelised puud ja põõsad, tagapool puude keskel näha kahte viilkatusega maja.
6431.de: In the foreground green trees and bushes in bright sunshine, further back among the trees two houses with gable roofs are visible.

6443.d: Suvine Pariisi tänavavaade. Vasakul üksikuid puid, paremal mõned inimfiguurid. Taga Sacre Coeur´i hele kuppel.
6443.de: A summer view of a Paris street. On the left a few solitary trees, on the right some human figures. Behind, the pale dome of Sacré-Cœur.

6466.d: Esiplaanil parvel paremal ja keskel hobused vankritega, vasakul grupp inimesi. Keskel jõgi. Vastaskaldal paremal ja keskel üksikuid väikeseid maju.
6466.de: In the foreground on a raft on the right and in the middle horses with carts, on the left a group of people. In the middle a river. On the opposite bank on the right and in the middle a few small houses.

6472.d: Esiplaanil lai, suurelt osalt jääs olev jõgi. Vasakul ridastikku mitmekorruselised kivihooned; paremal kaldapealsel kasvavad puud. Tagapool paistab üle jõe viiv Vabaduse sild.
6472.de: In the foreground a wide river, largely covered with ice. On the left a row of multi-storey stone buildings; on the right, on the bank, growing trees. Behind, the Vabaduse Bridge crossing the river can be seen.

6477.d: Eespool madalamad künkad, tagapool kõrged mäed. Keskel puude ja põõsaste vahel valge kirikutorn. Taeval rahutud pilved.
6477.de: In front lower hills, behind them high mountains. In the middle, among trees and bushes, a white church tower. Restless clouds in the sky.

6483.d: Ees vasakul viljarõuk, tagapool paremal neli rõuku.
6483.de: In front on the left a grain stack, further back on the right four stacks.

6484.d: Keskel eest taha suunduva veekogu kaldail raagus puid. Vasakul puu vahelt paistmas hooned.
6484.de: In the centre, bare trees on the banks of a body of water receding from front to back. On the left, buildings visible through the trees.

6491.d: A. Promet; Kullerkupud; ....; Pöördel kleebitud paberijälgi. Asukoht objektil: pöördel taga.
6491.de: A. Promet; Kullerkupud; ....; Traces of glued paper on the verso. Location on object: on the verso.

6499.d: Hallikassinises, väikeste roosade lilledega kleidis noore naise profiilportree. Naise kollakaspruunid juuksed tagant allapoole koolutatud, pealael lokk. Naisel väike punane suu, pisut kongus nina. Foon roosa. Eriti näo ja kaela piirkonnas kumab läbi õhukese värvikihi alusjoonistus.
6499.de: A profile portrait of a young woman in a greyish-blue dress with small pink flowers. The woman's yellowish-brown hair is curled downwards at the back, with a curl at the crown. The woman has a small red mouth, a slightly hooked nose. The background is pink. Especially in the area of the face and neck, the underdrawing shows through the thin layer of paint.

6507.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur patjadele toetuvana. Peas sinine sulega kübar, seljas samavärviline kleit. Ees avatud raamat.
6507.de: Half-figure of a seated woman leaning on pillows. On her head a blue feathered hat, wearing a dress of the same colour. An open book in front of her.

6529.d: Neegri rinnaportree, poolpöördes paremale. Tumedate silmade pilk suunatud vaatajale. Näol joonistuvad selgelt välja lihasekühmud. Seljas bordoopunane kuub, valge särk ning lips. Foon pruun.
6529.de: Bust portrait of a Black man, in half-turn to the right. The gaze of the dark eyes directed at the viewer. Muscle contours are clearly drawn on the face. Wearing a burgundy-red coat, white shirt and tie. Brown background.

6537.d: Sügisene rand tormise mere ja taevaga, tagaplaanil, ees paremal ja vasakul saledad kased tormis paindunud, puistamas lehti.
6537.de: An autumn shore with a stormy sea and sky, in the background, in front on the right and left slender birches bent in the storm, shedding their leaves.

6551.d: Kaks lähivaates talumaja, üks külje-, teine otsaseinaga vaataja poole. Majade ees õuel suur kivi, esiplaanil vasakul väiksemaid kive, rohtu ja lilli. Majade taga ulatuvad kõrged puud üle katuseharjade. Taevas hallikassinine. Parempoolsele majale langeb loojangukuma.
6551.de: Two farmhouses in close view, one facing the viewer with its side wall, the other with its gable end. In front of the houses in the yard a large stone, in the foreground on the left smaller stones, grass and flowers. Behind the houses tall trees rise above the roof ridges. Sky greyish-blue. Sunset glow falls on the house on the right.

6583.d: Esiplaanil veekogu, selle paremal ja vasakul kaldal tihe põõsastik ja puud. Taamal puude vahel valge hoone punase katusega.
6583.de: In the foreground a body of water, on its right and left banks dense shrubbery and trees. Further back among the trees a white building with a red roof.

6584.d: Esiplaanil vesi, selle taga kõrgenev küngas kaskedega. Pildi ülaservas kitsas riba sinist taevast.
6584.de: Water in the foreground, behind it a rising hill with birches. A narrow strip of blue sky at the top edge of the picture.

6615.dm: kõrgus: 93.0 cm (arm); laius: 80.5 cm; kõrgus: 85.5 cm; laius: 87.5 cm (arm)
6615.d: Avatud aknalaual savivaas helepunaste moonidega. Aknast avaneb vaade suvisele tänavale.
6615.de: A clay vase with light red poppies on an open windowsill. The window opens onto a summer street view.

6616.d: Vaikelu motiiv. Esiplaanil laual ja kausis asetseva puuviljaga. Keskel lillevaas kahe tulbiõiega.
6616.de: Still life motif. In the foreground fruit on a table and in a bowl. In the middle a flower vase with two tulip blossoms.

6628.d: Avatud ukse juures, küljega vaataja poole seisev naisefiguur, kaenlas mingi nõu, jalgade juures kass. Paremal puupliit, selle peal oleva metallnõuga. Värvigamma tume, üksikute kollakate refleksidega. Läbi maalikihi kumab paberi roosa toon.
6628.de: Beside an open door, a female figure standing sideways to the viewer, holding some vessel under her arm, a cat at her feet. On the right a wood stove with a metal vessel on top. Dark colour scheme, with occasional yellowish reflections. The pink tone of the paper shows through the paint layer.

6632.d: Laiade pahtlitõmmetega roosakas-kollakas toonis kaetud pinda kraabitud istuva, noore naise täisfiguur. Ülakeha ette kummarunud. Parem käsi hoiab kinni vasaku, kõverdatud jala pahkluust. Vaade suunatud alla, käele.
6632.de: On a surface covered in pinkish-yellow tones with broad palette-knife strokes, the full figure of a young seated woman scratched into it. Upper body bent forward. Right hand holds the ankle of the bent left leg. Gaze directed downward, at the hand.

6693.d: Esiplaanil raagus puud ja lumised katused. Taga Toomkiriku torn, kõrval paremal kõrgem punase katusega maja.
6693.de: Bare trees and snowy roofs in the foreground. Behind, the tower of the Dome Church, beside it on the right a taller house with a red roof.

6694.d: Esiplaanil vasakul savikruus, paremal õunu; tagapool laastukorv valge riidetükiga (paberiga?)
6694.de: In the foreground on the left an earthenware jug, on the right apples; behind a wood-shaving basket with a piece of white cloth (paper?).

6695.d: Kitsa kaelaga sinises savikruusis kõrgevarrelised tuliliiliad; vasakul raamat. Foon roosa.
6695.de: Tall-stemmed tiger lilies in a blue clay jug with a narrow neck; on the left a book. The background is pink.

6696.d: Paremal meri liigendatud rannajoonega; kaldal maju ja üksikuid puid.
6696.de: On the right the sea with an articulated coastline; on the shore houses and scattered trees.

6698.d: Ees ja keskel punaste katustega mitmekorruseliste majade grupp rohelises.
6698.de: In front and in the middle a group of multi-storey houses with red roofs amid greenery.

6700.d: Erksates toonides maalitud vaade madalatele kuuridele ja nende taga asetsevate majade katuseviiludele. Vasakul, majade vahel raagus puu võra, paremal, taeva taustal kaks puud. Maalitud punakais, oranžides toonides tumedate kontuuridega.
6700.de: View painted in bright tones of low sheds and the gable roofs of houses behind them. On the left, between the houses, the bare crown of a tree, on the right, against the sky, two trees. Painted in reddish, orange tones with dark contours.

6705.d: Laual pruun savivaas eredavärviliste lilledega. Vaasi kõrval grupp rohelisi seenekesi. Fooniks roosakas tapeet ja rohekas kardin.
6705.de: On the table a brown clay vase with brightly coloured flowers. Beside the vase a group of green mushrooms. Background of pinkish wallpaper and a greenish curtain.

6716.d: Pikisuunaline vaade gooti kiriku hämarasse interjööri. Paremal kolm piilarit, kõrged võlvid ülal. Vasakult kahest aknaorvast langeb nappi valgust. Otse ja paremal paistmas kaks heledat akent. Üksikuid figuure ruumis. Rohekashall, pruun gamma, arhitektuuridetaile selgelt välja modelleeriv laad.
6716.de: A longitudinal view into the dim interior of a Gothic church. On the right three pillars, high vaults above. From two window niches on the left scant light falls. Straight ahead and on the right two bright windows are visible. Individual figures in the space. Greenish-grey, brown gamut, a style clearly modelling architectural details.

6723.d: Heledates toonides suvine maastik suurte lehtpuude ja kahe väikese inimfiguuriga.
6723.de: A summer landscape in light tones with large deciduous trees and two small human figures.

6724.d: Pruunikal laual klaaskann lopsakate siniste, punaste ja kollaste lilledega, sinine sulega kübar ja üksik kollane õis. Samas sinine draperii.
6724.de: On a brownish table a glass jug with lush blue, red and yellow flowers, a blue feathered hat and a single yellow bloom. In the same place a blue drapery.

6726.d: Esiplaanil kõrged raagus puud ja tarad, taga hooneid.
6726.de: In the foreground tall bare trees and fences, buildings behind.

6730.d: Kollasel, punutud põhjaga toolil kollane korv, helesinine draperii ning punane vaas punaste ja kollaste lilledega.
6730.de: On a yellow chair with a woven seat a yellow basket, light blue drapery and a red vase with red and yellow flowers.

6731.d: Tumedates toonides suvine maastik. Esiplaanil kõrged lehtpuud, nende tagant paistavad hooned milledest üks punase katusega.
6731.de: A summer landscape in dark tones. In the foreground tall deciduous trees, behind them buildings can be seen, one of which has a red roof.

6732.d: Esiplaanil, kõrgete lehtpuude taustal kaks tumedates toonides maalitud naisakti.
6732.de: In the foreground, against a background of tall deciduous trees, two female nude figures painted in dark tones.

6740.d: Paremal horisontaalsel keskjoonel jõgi halli suure paadiga. Sellest vasakul kaldapealne lõikuvate raudteerööbastega, millel sõidab must vedur. Vasakus servas kolm maja, üks neist erepunane, ning elektripostide rida. Pilvisest taevast paistab keskosas tükike helesinist. Maalitud puhastes toonides impressionistlikus maalitehnikas.
6740.de: On the right on the horizontal centre line, a river with a large grey boat. To the left of it, a bank with crossing railway tracks, on which a black locomotive is running. In the left edge three houses, one of them bright red, and a row of electric poles. From the cloudy sky, a patch of light blue shows through in the middle section. Painted in clean tones in an impressionistic painting technique.

6742.d: Noore ümaranäolise blondi naise rinnaportree, pea veidi pööratud vasakule, pilk suunatud ette alla. Naisel seljas pruunikas kleit suure heleda reväärkraega, maalitud sinakas-kollakas-pruunis koloriidis õhuliselt.
6742.de: Bust portrait of a young round-faced blonde woman, head turned slightly to the left, gaze directed forward and down. The woman is wearing a brownish dress with a large light-coloured lapel collar, painted airily in a bluish-yellowish-brown colour scheme.

6744.d: Ümaranäolise, kõrge kumera laubaga noore naise portree. Pea kerges pöördes vasakule. Pilk langetatud. Heledad juuksed kõrvade juures rõngasse keeratud. Koloriit hele. Maalimislaad etüüdlik.
6744.de: Portrait of a round-faced young woman with a high convex forehead. Head in a slight turn to the left. Gaze lowered. Light hair twisted into a ring near the ears. Light coloration. Sketch-like painting manner.

6745.d: Rohekate voltidega valgel draperiil külgvaates paremale istuv naisakt. Parem jalg kõverdatud, selles allarullitud sukk (lõigatud pöia, vasaku sääremarja kohalt). Kõverdatud seongus käed ees, vasak toetub toolileenile, millele langetatud vaatajalt ärapööratud pea. Foon vasakul hallikaspruun, paremal sinakas. Akt maalitud valkjashallides, beežides toonides kohati varje ja vorm laiema kontuurjoonega toonitades.
6745.de: A female nude sitting in side view facing right on a white drapery with greenish folds. Right leg bent, on it a rolled-down stocking (cut off at the foot, above the left calf). Bent, intertwined arms in front, the left resting on the back of a chair, on which the lowered head, turned away from the viewer, rests. Background on the left greyish brown, on the right bluish. The nude is painted in whitish grey, beige tones, with shadows and forms at times accentuated with a broader contour line.

6746.d: Kireval foonil tumedapäise pikajuukselise noore naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Pea veidi pööratud vasakule, pilk ette alla suunatud. Parem kõverdatud käsi risti üle rinna vasaku õla juures. Naisel seljas lühikeste varrukatega sinakas kleit. Maalitud sinakas-pruunikas-ookertoonides kergete hoogsate pintslilöökidega.
6746.de: Against a colourful background, a bust portrait, in frontal view, of a young woman with dark hair and long hair. Head slightly turned to the left, gaze directed forward and down. Right bent arm crossed over the chest near the left shoulder. The woman is wearing a bluish dress with short sleeves. Painted in bluish-brownish-ochre tones with light, vigorous brushstrokes.

6750.d: Pruunil, massiivsel, pisut nikerdatud laual, mille sahtlid osalt välja tõmmatud, on hulgast erinevatest esemetest koostatud seadeldis. Vasakul servas helepruun lillepott lopsaka kaktusega, poti ees kaks vartega redist ja pooleldi veega täidetud klaas. Potist paremal, tagaplaanil, pika kaelaga pooleldi täidetud veepudel, ažuursete sangadega metallist liud kahe kollase sidruniga ja potsaka vormiga pruun savist kann. Loetletud esemete ees, roosakaspunasel kirjul draperiil, üks tumeda, teine valge sulestikuga lastud lind. Neist paremal valgel draperiil kimp rediseid ja kaks sibulat. Laua ees, pildi esiservas ümmargune taburet, millel valge linik ja suur lõik kollast kõrvitsat. Ülal foonil tume,
6750.de: On a brown, massive, slightly carved table, with its drawers partly pulled out, an arrangement composed of a number of different objects is set up. On the left edge a light brown flowerpot with a lush cactus, in front of the pot two radishes with stems and a glass half filled with water. To the right of the pot, in the background, a half-filled water bottle with a long neck, a metal tray with openwork handles holding two yellow lemons, and a brown clay jug of a squat shape. In front of the listed objects, on a pinkish-red patterned drapery, one bird with dark plumage, another with white plumage, both shot. To the right of them, on white drapery, a bunch of radishes and two onions. In front of the table, at the front edge of the picture, a round stool with a white cloth on it and a large slice of yellow pumpkin. Above, in the background, dark,

6831.d: Esiplaanil kivine lagendik. Vasakult keskelt taha suunduva roigastara taga õlgkatusega hooneid ja üksikuid suuri lehtpuid. Paremal taga kitsas riba põlde. Horisondil taluhooneid ja tuulik.
6831.de: In the foreground a stony open ground. Behind a pole fence running from the left centre towards the back, thatched-roof buildings and single large deciduous trees. On the right in the background a narrow strip of fields. On the horizon farm buildings and a windmill.

6843.d: Väga kõrge horisondiga lage maastik, mille keskosas riba küntud põldu, kus paremal mees valge habemega alustab uue vao kündmist.
6843.de: A flat landscape with a very high horizon, in the middle part of which a strip of ploughed field, where on the right a man with a white beard begins ploughing a new furrow.

6861.d: Esiplaanil paremal kolm seisvat naisefiguuri, keskel suur, kogu pildipinda haarav lehtpuu. Taamal põõsaste ja puude kontuure.
6861.de: In the foreground on the right three standing female figures, in the middle a large deciduous tree covering the whole picture surface. In the background contours of bushes and trees.

6862.dm: kõrgus: 86.0 cm; kujutise laius: 93.0 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 80.0 cm; laius: 97.0 cm
6862.d: Interjöör. Esiplaanil paremal taburet ja püstiseisev naine selgvaates. Vasakul seina ääres kartuli korv, keskel raiepakk, kirves. Aknaesisel pingil õllekann. Läbi akna paistab mehe figuur.
6862.de: Interior. In the foreground on the right a stool and a woman standing, seen frontally. On the left by the wall a potato basket, in the middle a chopping block, an axe. On the bench by the window a beer jug. Through the window a man's figure is visible.

6928.d: Realistlikus laadis maal. Esiplaanil paremal noor naine väikese tüdrukuga. Naisel on peas ja õlgadel punane rätt, käes hoiab korvi. Maali keskel heledas kleidis astuv tüdruk, kellel on käevangus mõned oksaraod, peas hele rätik. Naise pea veidi kaldu vasakule, lapsel kerges pöördes paremale. Tüdrukust vasemal aiakatkend, vasakul tagapool seljaga seisev mees kahe hobusega põllutöid tegemas. Koloriidilt on maal pastelne, pruunikais toonides. Taevas sinakas, maapind pruunikas-rohekas.
6928.de: A painting in a realistic style. In the foreground on the right, a young woman with a small girl. The woman has a red kerchief on her head and shoulders, and holds a basket. In the middle of the painting, a girl in a light-coloured dress is walking, with a few twigs in the crook of her arm, a light-coloured kerchief on her head. The woman's head is tilted slightly to the left, the child in a slight turn to the right. To the left of the girl, a fragment of a garden, further back on the left a man standing with his back turned, working the fields with two horses. The colouring of the painting is pastel, in brownish tones. The sky is bluish, the ground brownish-greenish.

6933.d: Esiplaanil 3 suurt puud. Nende vahelt vaade ehitavalae kivihoonele. Hoone ees hobused veovankritega.
6933.de: In the foreground 3 large trees. Between them a view of a stone building under construction. In front of the building horses with carts.

6934.d: Esiplaanil oja tammiga. Oja kaldal üksikuid raagus puid. Keskel tammi ääres vesiveski ja teisi hooneid. Taamal kõrgeneval künklikul maastikul okasmets.
6934.de: In the foreground a stream with a dam. On the bank of the stream isolated leafless trees. In the centre by the dam a water mill and other buildings. In the distance, on a rising hilly landscape, coniferous forest.

6938.d: Esiplaanil kivine mererand. Vasakul ja paremal õlgkatustega hooneid, keskel latt-tara, taamal meri.
6938.de: A rocky seashore in the foreground. Thatched-roof buildings on the left and right, a slat fence in the middle, the sea beyond.

6939.d: Keskel istuv mees lõõtspilliga, tema ümber seisvad ja istuvad lapsed. Maalitud tumedais, pruunides toonides.
6939.de: A seated man with an accordion in the centre, surrounded by standing and sitting children. Painted in dark, brown tones.

6940.d: Talvine mets kahe metsatöölise- ja lõkkega esiplaanil.
6940.de: Winter forest with two forest workers and a campfire in the foreground.

6941.d: Madala silmapiirini ulatuv põld. Vasakule jäävad nelja kartulinoppija figuurid, paremale hobune.
6941.de: A field reaching to a low horizon. To the left the figures of four potato pickers, to the right a horse.

6943.d: Sinise riidega kaetud toolis tumedas kleidis noore naise kolmveerandfiguur, süles roosa päevavari. Parem käsivars toetub tooli seljatoele, pea kergelt langetatud, pilk suunatud ette.
6943.de: Three-quarter figure of a young woman in a dark dress seated in a chair covered with blue fabric, a pink parasol in her lap. Right arm resting on the back of the chair, head slightly lowered, gaze directed forward.

6944.d: Sinisel foonil tumedas kleidis istuva naise kolmveerandfiguur, poolpöördes paremale. Peas valge barett, käes ovaalne peegel.
6944.de: Three-quarter figure of a woman sitting in a dark dress on a blue background, in a half-turn to the right. A white beret on her head, an oval mirror in her hand.

6945.d: Tumehallil foonil, mille ülaserv ookrivärvi, istub noor naine, en face, labajalad pildiservaga ära lõigatud. Ilme mõtlik, seljas hele värvikate läigetega kleit musta vööga ja musta eest avatud mantliga. Käed osaliselt riide voltidega varjatud.
6945.de: Against a dark gray background whose upper edge is ochre-colored, a young woman sits en face, feet cut off by the edge of the picture. Pensive expression, wearing a light dress with colorful sheens and a black belt and a black coat open at the front. Hands partly hidden by the folds of the fabric.

6950.d: Tumerohelistes ja pruunides toonides läbimaalitud foonil grupp helepruunides keraamilistes pottides erinevat liiki kaktusi ülaltvaates.
6950.de: On a background painted in dark green and brown tones, a group of various kinds of cacti in light brown ceramic pots, seen from above.

6975.d: Esiplaanil mäenõlvak puudega, taga vaade linnamajadele.
6975.de: In the foreground a hillside with trees, behind a view of city houses.

6978.d: Esiplaanil lage kollane küngas, mis tõuseb pildipinnas 2/3 kõrgusel oleva silmapiirini. Künka tipul kollakas kasetukk.
6978.de: In the foreground a bare yellow hillock rising to the horizon at 2/3 of the picture's height. On the top of the hillock a yellowish clump of birches.

6985.d: Valge draperiiga kaetud taburetil, keskteljest vasakul istuv naisakt selgvaates, alakeha pööratud paremale. Pisut ette kummargil, käed toetuvad ette taburetile. Vasak jalg rippu, parem toetub põrandale. Ühtlasel helehallil foonil paremal tumedam modelli vari. Maal valkjashallis, beežis koloriidis.
6985.de: On a stool covered with white drapery, a female nude sitting to the left of the central axis, seen from behind, the lower body turned to the right. Slightly bent forward, hands resting on the stool in front. Left leg hanging, right leg resting on the floor. On an even light grey background, the model's darker shadow on the right. The painting is in whitish-grey, beige tones.

6989.d: Pruunikates ja hallikates toonides maastik. Esiplaanil vasakul suur puu, eemal hooned.
6989.de: Landscape in brownish and greyish tones. In the foreground on the left a large tree, buildings in the distance.

6991.d: Esiplaanil paremal külavahetee kivide ja kadakatega kahel pool. Vasakul ja paremal suurte puude keskel tumedad madalad talumajad. Madala silmapiiri kohal suurte valgete pilvedega tumesinine taevas. Pruunikasroheline üldkoloriit, maalitud lopsakalt, kohati spaatliga.
6991.de: In the foreground on the right a village road with stones and junipers on both sides. On the left and right, among large trees, dark low farmhouses. Above the low horizon a dark blue sky with large white clouds. General colouring brownish-green, painted lushly, in places with a palette knife.

6997.d: Vooremaastik kahe järvega keskel, voorte harjadel metsatukad. Taevas sinirohelistes ja roosades toonides.
6997.de: A hilly ridge landscape ("voor") with two lakes in the middle, clumps of forest on the ridges. Sky in blue-green and pink tones.

6998.dm: lehe laius: 40.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 31.0 cm
6998.d: Maastik teivasaiaga ja kuuskedega. Eest vasakult veidi tahapoole paremale suunduv teivasaed. Selle taga vasakul grupp suuri kuuski. Paremal üks suurem ja grupp väiksemaid puid. Tagapool keskel järve kaldal väike heinaküün. Taga vasakul metsatukk.
6998.de: A landscape with a stake fence and spruces. In front, a stake fence running from the left slightly backward to the right. Behind it on the left a group of large spruces. On the right one larger tree and a group of smaller trees. In the background in the middle a small hay barn on the shore of a lake. In the background on the left a patch of forest.

7005.d: Eest keskelt taha vasakule kulgev tee äärestatud suurtest lehtpuudest. Paremal tee ääres kiviaed. Taga keskel karjavärav ja lehtpuid.
7005.de: A road running from the centre foreground to the back left, lined with large deciduous trees. On the right along the road a stone fence. Behind in the centre a pasture gate and deciduous trees.

7009.d: Töö kujundatud poolringil. Esiplaanil keskel suure õunapuu all seismas mees ja rahvarõivais viljavihuga parema kaenla all naine. Nende ees poisikene õunu korjamas. Paremal kündja, vasakul 2 meest kändu kangutamas. Tagapool paremal heinavedu, vasakul kari. Taamal kollendavad põllud.
7009.de: The work is composed in a semicircle. In the foreground in the middle, under a large apple tree, a man standing and a woman in folk costume with a sheaf of grain under her right arm.
