In front of them a boy picking apples. On the right a ploughman, on the left 2 men prying out a stump. Further back on the right hay hauling, on the left a herd. Beyond, yellowing fields.

7013.d: Esialal vasemal tahapoole suunduv looklev tee, paremal üksik kask. Keskel nõos väike järv, tagapool kurrulisel maastikul hilissuvises värvuses põldusid ja metsatukki.
7013.de: In the foreground on the left a winding road leading backwards, on the right a solitary birch. In the centre, in a hollow, a small lake, behind it in a undulating landscape fields and small groves in late-summer colouring.

7015.d: Esiplaanil valg hoone suvepäikese valguses. Vasakul kaarja ukse kohal ikoon, paremal kaks kellatorni ja trepiga sissekäik. Hoonel väike sinise kupliga torn.
7015.de: In the foreground a white building in summer sunlight. On the left above an arched door an icon, on the right two bell towers and an entrance with stairs. The building has a small tower with a blue dome.

7019.d: Vaade  üle esiplaanil asuvate vanalinna majade pruunjaspurpursete katuste Niguliste kirikule kagust. Pikihoone astmeline katus vaskplekiga, Antoniuse kabel punaste katusekividega. Paremal äärel raekoja torn.
7019.de: View over the brownish-purple roofs of the old town houses in the foreground toward St. Nicholas' Church (Niguliste) from the southeast. The stepped roof of the nave is covered with tin sheeting, the Anthony Chapel has red roof tiles. On the right edge, the tower of the Town Hall.

7034.d: Kergelt paremale pöördunud istuv vana naine, juuksed keskelt lahku kammitud ja kuklasse seotud, nägu kortsuline, käed puhkavad kokkupandult süles heledal põllel. Seljas tumesinine kraeta kleit või pluus. Foon punakaspruun.
7034.de: A seated old woman turned slightly to the right, hair parted in the middle and tied at the back of the neck, wrinkled face, hands resting folded in her lap on a light apron. Wearing a dark blue collarless dress or blouse. Background reddish-brown.

7035.d: Halli riidega kaetud laual keskplaanis pruun, viltu asetatud kauss, valge riie peale visatud. Sellest vasakul tume nõu. All, sinaka draperiiga kaetud pingil valge, kõrge, ülalt ahenev kann ja kibu. Töö hallikassinises üldtoonis, maalitud kohati pikkade nähtavate pintslilöökidega.
7035.de: On a table covered with grey cloth, in the middle plane a brown, obliquely placed bowl with a white cloth thrown over it. To its left a dark vessel. Below, on a bench covered with a bluish drapery, a white, tall jug narrowing towards the top and a pitcher. The work is in an overall greyish-blue tone, painted in places with long visible brushstrokes.

7038.d: 4/5 maali ülemisest osast kujutab tihedat põõsaste-puudega metsa, vasakul puukroonide vahel paistmas tükike taevast. Esiplaanil, metsaservas ridamisi istumas-lebamas 9 inimest: paremal istuv ja lamav naisfiguur, keskel kaabuga lõõtspillimängija, vasakul neli meest ja naine. Maal rohekaspruunides toonides, erineva faktuuriga, kohati pastoosne, sissekraapeid värvipinnas.
7038.de: 4/5 of the upper part of the painting depicts a dense forest of bushes and trees, on the left a patch of sky visible between the treetops. In the foreground, at the edge of the forest, 9 people sitting-lying in a row: on the right a sitting and a lying female figure, in the center an accordion player wearing a hat, on the left four men and a woman. The painting is in greenish-brown tones, of varying texture, in places pastose, with scratched-in paint surface.

7039.d: Hõbehallides ja tuhmides rohelistes toonides künklik maastik. Keskel väike, metsatukaga kaetud mägi, mille ümber madalate põõsatuttidega kaetud maastik. Esiplaanil suundub tee alt vasakust nurgast paremale pildi sügavusse. Paremal servas üksik kuusk. Silmapiiri kohal hallikas, tihedalt valgete pilvedega kaetud taevas. Maalitud väikeste, kuid pastoossete pintslilöökidega.
7039.de: A hilly landscape in silvery-gray and dull green tones. In the center, a small hill covered with a patch of forest, surrounded by a landscape covered with low bush clusters. In the foreground, a path leads from the lower left corner into the depth of the picture on the right. On the right edge, a solitary spruce. Above the horizon, a grayish sky densely covered with white clouds. Painted with small but pastose brushstrokes.

7040.d: Tumehalli draperiiga kaetud diivanil hele lina ja roosa padi, millele toetub poollamavas asendis noor naine, ülakeha vaataja suunas. Naisel lühikesed, sirged juuksed, üks käsi puhkab padjal, teine rinnal. Naisel seljas lühikeste käistega suurte valgete nööpidega sinine kleit, avatud kaelusest paistab helekollane särk. Jalgade juures roosa vihmavari.
7040.de: On a sofa covered with a dark grey drape, a light-coloured sheet and a pink pillow, against which a young woman reclines in a half-lying position, upper body toward the viewer. The woman has short, straight hair, one hand resting on the pillow, the other on her chest. She is wearing a blue dress with short sleeves and large white buttons, a light yellow shirt showing through the open collar. A pink umbrella lies at her feet.

7062.d: a)Hämarusest kerkib Notre-Dame´i siluett. Ees sillakaaristu nelja, tuhmilt helendava laternaga.
7062.de: a) The silhouette of Notre-Dame rises from the dusk. In front, a row of bridge arches with four dimly glowing lanterns.

7063.d: Eesääres noored okaspuud ja säravsinine veesilm. Taamal künklik maastik valgete, punakate katustega majade gruppidega. Koloriit hele.
7063.de: In the front, young conifers and a sparkling blue patch of water. In the distance a hilly landscape with groups of houses with white, reddish roofs. Light colouring.

7064.d: Otsevaade kupliga ja kolme väikese torniga hoonele. Maja ees rikkalikult treppe. Maalitud sumedates rohekashallides toonides pastoosselt.
7064.de: Frontal view of a domed building with three small towers. In front of the house, numerous flights of steps. Painted pastosely in soft greenish-grey tones.

7065.d: Rohekashallides summutatud toonides maalitud vaade allpool hämaruses asetsevatele väikestele majadele puude vahel.
7065.de: View, painted in muted greenish-grey tones, of small houses lying below in the dusk among trees.

7066.d: Esiplaanil roheline veidi künklik maapind; selle taga samavärvilised madalad majad. Taamal Tallinna vanalinna siluett.
7066.de: In the foreground green, slightly hilly ground; behind it low houses of the same colour. In the distance the silhouette of Tallinn's Old Town.

7095.d: Esiplaanil veekogu paadisillaga. Tagapool poolsaar puudega ja mets.
7095.de: In the foreground a body of water with a boat landing. Beyond it a peninsula with trees and forest.

7096.d: Paremale pöördega, vasak jalg ees kivil, muistse sõjamehe figuur, valges lühikeses vöötatud kuues, kirjatud kõrgeis saabastes, paremas käes mingisugune puuvarras; ees kivil ohvritule leek.
7096.de: Turned to the right, left foot forward on a stone, the figure of an ancient warrior in a short white belted garment, patterned high boots, in his right hand some kind of wooden staff; before him on a stone the flame of a sacrificial fire.

7106.d: Rohekashallides toonides maalitud vaade talvisele väikelinnale, puude vahel lumiste viilkatustega majad. Esiplaanil paremal lage lumine aed. Maalitud lopsakalt, laiema pintslilöögiga.
7106.de: Painted in greenish-grey tones, a view of a small town in winter, houses with snowy gable roofs among trees. In the foreground on the right a bare snowy garden. Painted luxuriantly, with a broader brushstroke.

7107.d: Üle terve lõuendi tugeva võraga suured puud, nende vahel tee, tagapool põõsad. Läbi okste paistab helesinine taevas, keskosas selgvaates naine. Maalitud kollakasrohelistes, pruunikassinistes toonides, kohati laiade spaatlitõmmetega.
7107.de: Across the entire canvas, large trees with strong crowns, a path between them, bushes further back. Through the branches a light blue sky is visible, in the middle a woman in clear view. Painted in yellowish-green, brownish-blue tones, in places with broad palette-knife strokes.

7108.d: Esiplaanil jääga kaanetatud jõekäär, mille keskel sinine veejoom. Lumisel kaldal, mõlemal pool pildiservades mändidegrupid, nende vahel keskel üksik mänd. Siin-seal pruunid maapinna laigud. Taevas kahvatusinine.
7108.de: In the foreground, an ice-covered bend of a river, in the middle of which a blue stretch of open water. On the snowy bank, on both sides at the edges of the picture, groups of pines, between them in the middle a solitary pine. Here and there brown patches of ground. The sky is pale blue.

7109.d: Tuhmhallides toonides kompositsioon erinevais asendeis neljast naisaktist maastikul. Esiplaanil olev naine külgvaates poollamavas asendis, toetub küünarvarrele.
7109.de: A composition in dull grey tones with four female nudes in various poses in a landscape. The woman in the foreground, seen from the side, in a half-reclining position, leaning on her forearm.

7110.d: Soojades pruunides toonides maapind kahe suure valkja laiguga pildi keskosas. Ülaservas õrnalt rohetav metsaviirg.
7110.de: Ground painted in warm brown tones with two large whitish patches in the centre of the picture. In the upper edge a faintly greening strip of forest.

7111.d: Kahel pool kõrged majad. Keskel, väljaku ääres fassaadiga vaataja poole kolmekorruseline sinaka kuplilise katusega hoone. Maalitud kollakashallides rohekais toonides piirjooni hajutades.
7111.de: On both sides tall buildings. In the middle, at the edge of the square, a three-storey building with a bluish domed roof, its façade facing the viewer. Painted with contours diffused in yellowish-grey, greenish tones.

7112.d: Ülevalt vaade heledatele punakate viilkatustega majadele. Taamal Tallinna vanalinna tornid. Maalitud kohati tugeva faktuuriga sinakaisvalkjais-rohekais toonides.
7112.de: A view from above of light-coloured houses with reddish gable roofs. In the distance, the towers of Tallinn's Old Town. Painted in places with a strong texture in bluish-whitish-greenish tones.

7113.d: Veekogu madalatel kallastel kõrguvad sirgetüveliste rohekate ja pruunikas-oranžide lehekroonidega kaskede grupid. Taevas kaetud tiheda valkjas-hallika pilvesäbruga.
7113.de: On the low banks of a body of water rise groups of straight-trunked birches with greenish and brownish-orange foliage crowns. The sky covered with a dense whitish-grey curl of clouds.

7114.d: Hallides, rohelistes summutatud toonides maalitud lagendiku äärsed suured puud hämaruses, paremal väikese viilkatusega maja ots, aknas põleb oranžikas tuli. Pintslilöök laiem, lopsakas.
7114.de: Large trees at the edge of a clearing painted in gray, muted green tones in twilight, on the right the gable end of a small house with a gabled roof, an orange light burning in the window. The brushwork is broader, lush.

7115.d: Vaade pruunikas toonis metsaga kaetud kuplilisele maastikule. Keskosas heledamad põllud, mida läbib sikk-sakitav maantee ja paremal diagonaalselt kulgev jõgi. Nõlval üksikud majad. Maalitud lühikeste tihkete pintslilöökidega.
7115.de: View of a domed landscape covered with forest in brownish tones. In the middle section lighter fields, crossed by a zigzagging highway and, on the right, a diagonally running river. Isolated houses on the slope. Painted with short, dense brushstrokes.

7116.d: Majade taustal heledas rätis vanema naise rinnaportree otsevaates, pea veidi pööratud vasakule. Maalitud hallikasbeežis gammas.
7116.de: Bust portrait of an older woman in a light headscarf, in frontal view, head slightly turned to the left, against a background of houses. Painted in a grayish-beige range.

7117.d: Kahkjates kollakas-pruunikais toonides kaks kasesalu. Nende vahel paar erksinist järvesilma. Ülaservas kitsas taevariba. Maalipind kergelt faktuurne. Koloriit hele.
7117.de: In pale yellowish-brownish tones two birch groves. Between them a couple of bright blue lake-eyes. In the upper edge a narrow strip of sky. The painted surface slightly textured. The colouring light.

7120.d: Maastik lehtpuugruppide ja helesinise ojaga. Esmal üksikud punased katused.
7120.de: Landscape with groups of leafy trees and a light blue stream. In the foreground a few red roofs.

7257.d: Keskosas, roheluse vahel roosakas-sinakas kääruline jõgi. Ülaosas, roosade pilvedega taevas helenduv päikeseketas. Maalitud pastoosselt, lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
7257.de: In the central part, amid the greenery, a pinkish-bluish winding river. In the upper part, a glowing sun disc in a sky with pink clouds. Painted pastosely, with short brushstrokes.

7266.d: Panoraamne küngasmaastik: esiplaanil vasakul ja paremal kaks punaste katustega valget maja, keskplaanis kolm samasugust hoonet. Esiplaanilt suundub tee pildi sügavusse. Majade vahel, küngastel, metsatukad. Ülal tume hallikassinine taevas. Maalitud värvipindadega pisut vorme toonitades.
7266.de: Panoramic hilly landscape: in the foreground on the left and right two white houses with red roofs, in the middle ground three similar buildings. From the foreground a road leads into the depth of the picture. Between the houses, on the hills, clumps of forest. Above, a dark greyish-blue sky. Painted with colour surfaces, forms slightly emphasised with shading.

7267.d: Kollakasroosades toonides, kõrgele pildi serva tõstetud silmapiiriga maastik: esiplaanilt keskelt suundub pildi sügavusse väike oja, mille kaldal esiplaanil laugjad, tagaplaanis järsumat kallakut moodustavad. Esiplaanil vasakul, aga ka tagapool silmapiiril ookerkollaste puude grupid. Maalitud hajusate pintslilöökidega, kontuure igati ähmastada püüdes.
7267.de: A landscape in yellowish-pink tones, with the horizon raised high toward the edge of the picture: from the centre foreground a small brook runs into the depth of the picture, its banks gentle in the foreground and forming a steeper slope in the background. On the left in the foreground, as well as further back on the horizon, groups of ochre-yellow trees. Painted with diffuse brushstrokes, striving throughout to blur the contours.

7276.d: Laual suur punane vaas valgete ja kollaste krüsanteemidega. Raamat ja õunad. Vasakul aknast vaade linnale.
7276.de: On the table a large red vase with white and yellow chrysanthemums. A book and apples. On the left, a view of the city through the window.

7355.d: Meri. Keskel, vasakult paremale merre tungival maaninal kalurimaju, paate ja purjekaid.
7355.de: The sea. In the middle, on a headland jutting into the sea from left to right, fishermen's houses, boats and sailboats.

7420.d: Hallijuukselise mehe rinnapilt, kerge pöördega vasakule.
7420.de: Chest portrait of a grey-haired man, slightly turned to the left.

7421.d: Hallijuukselise, vurrude ja väikese lõuahabemega mehe poolfiguur. Laua taga istuvana. Keha kerge pöördega vasakule. Vasakus, lauale toetuvas käes paber.
7421.de: Half-figure of a grey-haired man with a moustache and small chin beard. Seated behind a table. Body turned slightly to the left. In his left hand, resting on the table, a paper.

7422.d: Avatud aknal istuva, heledapäise, heledas kleidis naise kolmveerandfiguur, raamat süles. Aknast paistab suvine aed.
7422.de: Three-quarter figure of a fair-haired woman in a light-coloured dress sitting at an open window, a book in her lap. A summer garden is visible through the window.

7436.d: Paremal nõlvak mändide ja kanarbikuga; vasemal org, taga mände.
7436.de: On the right a slope with pines and heather; on the left a valley, pines behind.

7437.d: Esiplaanil kanarbikuline lammorg. Taga paremal kalda nõlvakul mänitukk. Taamal mets.
7437.de: In the foreground a heathland valley. Behind on the right, on the slope of a bank, a juniper bush. Beyond, a forest.

7438.d: Esiplaanil lumine küngas raagus puudega. Taga vallil kivihooned.
7438.de: In the foreground a snowy hillock with bare trees. Behind, stone buildings on a rampart.

7439.d: Esiplaanil paremal kivine rannik ja meri. Vasemal tahapoole suunduv kõrge paekallas lehtpuudega.
7439.de: In the foreground on the right a rocky coast and sea. On the left a high limestone bank receding backward, with deciduous trees.

7442.d: Liivaluidete ja männimetsaga maastik: paremal keskel kolm mändi, vasakul nurgas väike männipuhmas, taamal liivasel kõrgendikul männitukk, millele tumedate pilvede vahelt langeb päikesevihk.
7442.de: Landscape with sand dunes and pine forest: on the right in the middle three pines, in the left corner a small pine bush, further back on a sandy elevation a pine grove, on which a ray of sunlight falls through dark clouds.

7443.d: Esiplaanil roheline luhta meenutav rannaäär, silmapiiril mereviirg, mida hõbetab ülalt pilvede vahelt alla langev valgus. Paremal mere poole suunduv väike jõgi või oja. Ülal hallide pilvedega kaetud taevas.
7443.de: In the foreground a green, meadow-like shoreline, on the horizon a strip of sea, silvered by light falling from between clouds above. On the right a small river or stream flowing toward the sea. Above, a sky covered with grey clouds.

7446.d: Lillakashallides ja rohekates toonides kivine ja vetikane rand. Vasakul hele veeriba. Taevas hallid, horisondi kohal lillad rünkpilved, vasakul eemal hele laik.
7446.de: A stony, seaweed-covered shore in lilac-grey and greenish tones. On the left a bright strip of water. Sky grey, above the horizon lilac cumulus clouds, in the distance on the left a bright patch.

7447.d: Kollakas-pruunikas lainetav viljapõld, keskel puuderühm ja taluhooned, milleni viib rada. Vasakul veeriba. Helesinises taevas suured hallikasvalged rünkpilved.
7447.de: Yellowish-brown undulating grain field, in the middle a group of trees and farm buildings, to which a path leads. On the left a strip of water. In the light blue sky large greyish-white cumulus clouds.

7448.d: Esiplaanil rohekaspruunides ja lillakates toonides kivine maastik, keskosas tihe männitukk, taevas helesinine kollaste laikudega.
7448.de: In the foreground a stony landscape in greenish-brown and purplish tones, in the middle a dense pine grove, the sky light blue with yellow patches.

7450.d: Rohelistes ja pruunides toonides lage küngas, taamal keskel grupp taluhooneid. Vasakul tumesinine mereviirg, taevas helesinine, pilved lillades toonides.
7450.de: A bare hill in green and brown tones, in the distance in the middle a group of farm buildings. On the left a dark blue strip of sea, the sky light blue, clouds in purple tones.

7463.d: Paremal pildi äärel osa kahekorruselisest punase viilkatusega heledast hoonest, mille juurest lähtuv pruunikaskollane tee ümbritseb vasakult lopsakaid õitsvaid põõsaid ja paremalt kirevat lillepeenart. Viimase ees seisab otsevaates helepunases kleidis naine, käes kastekann. Figuurist paremal pruun kaherattaline käru veevaadiga. Kaugemal, üldises erksas roheluses üksikud puud, paremal aimatav veesilm. Silmapiiril, üksikute rünkpilvedega kaetud helesinise taeva all madalad punaste katustega majad aedade varjus.
7463.de: On the right edge of the picture part of a two-storey light-coloured building with a red gable roof, from which a brownish-yellow path leads, surrounded on the left by lush flowering bushes and on the right by a colourful flower bed. In front of the latter stands, in frontal view, a woman in a bright red dress, holding a watering can. To the right of the figure a brown two-wheeled cart with a water barrel. Further away, in general vivid greenery, solitary trees, on the right a discernible patch of water. On the horizon, under a pale blue sky covered with scattered cumulus clouds, low houses with red roofs sheltered by gardens.

7466.d: Veidi pealtvaates nelinurksel, pruunil laual, keskel, kõhukas, sinine vaas, mille sees seitse, peaaegu valget astri-õit; vasakul kimp kollaseid, väikse-õielisi lilli; paremal punaseõielisi; paremalt murdub alla oks kollaste õitega. Laual, vaasi ees õun, paremal, valgel taldrikul punane õun. Foon helesinine. Lilleõitel kohati värv paksult kujutisele kantud.
7466.de: On a rectangular brown table seen slightly from above, in the middle, a bulbous blue vase containing seven almost white aster blossoms; on the left a bouquet of yellow, small-flowered blooms; on the right red-flowered ones; from the right a branch with yellow blossoms hangs down. On the table, in front of the vase, an apple, on the right, on a white plate, a red apple. The background is light blue. In places the paint on the flower blossoms is applied thickly to the image.

7467.d: Kõrge seljatoega tugitoolis, kerges pöördes vasakule istuva, heledate, väga lühikeseks lõigatud, otsmikul tukkadega juustega istuva, väikese tüdruku kolmveerandfiguur, seljas punane, põlvi paljaks jättev, pikkade varrukatega, väikese, ümarnurkadega, valge kraega kleit. Lapse käed süles. Foon sinakas-lilla, tooli seljatugi rohekas-kollakas. Üksikutes kohtades värv paksemalt peale kantud.
7467.de: A three-quarter figure of a little girl sitting in a high-backed armchair, turned slightly to the left, with light-coloured, very short-cut hair with a fringe on the forehead, wearing a red dress with long sleeves that leaves the knees bare, a small dress with rounded corners and a white collar. The child's hands are in her lap. The background is bluish-purple, the back of the chair greenish-yellow. In a few places the paint is applied more thickly.

7490.d: Tumeda linaga kaetud laual roheline vaas kollaste ja valgete lilledega, kaks õuna ja vaasist vasakul alustassile asetatud kohvitass.
7490.de: On a table covered with a dark cloth, a green vase with yellow and white flowers, two apples and, to the left of the vase, a coffee cup placed on a saucer.

7508.d: Lage lumine maastik külmsinise taeva ja kaugusse kaduva maanteega.
7508.de: A bare snowy landscape with a cold blue sky and a road disappearing into the distance.

7523.d: Kolmveerandpöördes, tumesinise riide foonil, istuva naise figuur. Seljas tuhmpruun kollase, pisut kroogitud krae ja kätistega, kolmnurkse kaelaväljalõikega kleit, peas punane barett, mille alt paistavad helepruunid juuksed. Vasakul servas riba lillakaspruuni foonil.
7523.de: Figure of a seated woman in a three-quarter turn, against a dark blue cloth background. Wearing a dull brown dress with a slightly gathered yellow collar and cuffs, a triangular neckline, a red beret on her head, from under which light brown hair shows. On the left edge a strip against a purplish-brown background.

7545.d: Paremal poodiumil istuv modell, tagapool, varju taga, teine modell; vasakul kunstnik tööl.
7545.de: On the right a model sitting on a podium, further back, behind a shadow, a second model; on the left the artist at work.

7547.d: Selili lamava naise poolfiguur (vasakult paremale) käed tõstetud kukla taha.
7547.de: Half-figure of a woman lying on her back (from left to right), hands raised behind the back of her head.

7549.d: Vaade Petseri kloostri õue. Vasakul üks kirikuid, paremal kellatorni nurk.
7549.de: View of the courtyard of Petseri monastery. On the left one of the churches, on the right the corner of a bell tower.

7550.d: Kitsas lõik kiriku interjöörist: paremale jääb eredates punastes, kollastes ja rohelistes toonides altariosa. Etüüdlik käsitluslaad.
7550.de: A narrow section of a church interior: on the right the altar area in bright red, yellow and green tones. Study-like manner of treatment.

7551.d: Lõuna-Eesti nõlvakuline maastik metsatukkadega (tumedal metsapiiril eralduvad heledatüvelised puudegrupid), põllulappidega. Mööda teed läheb üksik figuur.
7551.de: A hilly South Estonian landscape with small groves (groups of light-trunked trees stand out against the dark forest edge), with patches of fields. A lone figure walks along the road.

7552.d: Vaade Emajõele Vabadussillaga. Vasakul kaldaäär majadega, paate; tagant paistab majade grupp.
7552.de: View of the Emajõgi River with the Vabadussild [Freedom Bridge]. On the left the riverbank with houses, boats; behind it a group of houses is visible.

7553.d: Vasemal peegel, mille all pingil vaas lilledega, paremal võlvitud ruum, mille alumine osa erksinine. Seinal maale.
7553.de: On the left a mirror, under which on a bench a vase with flowers, on the right a vaulted room, the lower part of which is bright blue. Paintings on the wall.

7554.d: Esiplaanil õu, maalitud kollasena, vasakule jääb sinine pind. Maali ülaosas valge majasein, punase sissekäigu ja rõduga. Trepil kaks inimest, ees istub kolmas.
7554.de: In the foreground a yard, painted yellow, with a blue surface remaining on the left. In the upper part of the painting a white house wall, with a red entrance and balcony. On the stairs two people, in front a third one sitting.

7555.d: Vasakul järv, kaldal paremal kaks suurt puud (järve poole kaldu), rõheline tara, puid.
7555.de: A lake on the left, on the shore on the right two large trees (leaning towards the lake), a green fence, trees.

7556.d: Otsevaates toolil istuv naisakt. Taga roheline draperii.
7556.de: A female nude sitting on a chair in frontal view. Green drapery behind.

7557.d: Hallikassinise draperii foonil vasakule käele nõjatuv lamav naisakt selgvaates.
7557.de: Reclining female nude seen frontally, leaning on her left hand, against a background of greyish-blue drapery.

7558.d: Vaade Pariisi Pont Neuf´üle. Esiplaanil vasakul suured lehtpuud, paremal kraana. Taga hallides toonides sild.
7558.de: View of the Pont Neuf in Paris. In the foreground on the left, large deciduous trees, on the right a crane. Behind, a bridge in grey tones.

7559.d: Esiplaanil roheline murusõõr kõrgete puudega keskel ja valge tee. Taga heleda hoone kontuurid.
7559.de: In the foreground a green circle of lawn with tall trees in the middle and a white road. Behind it the contours of a light-coloured building.

7627.d: Osa siniste seinte ja kollase põrandaga toast avatud aknaga. Aknast vasakul laud lillevaasiga.
7627.de: Part of a room with blue walls and a yellow floor, with an open window. To the left of the window a table with a flower vase.

7628.d: Sini-valgel foonil noormehe pea poolpöördes paremale, kaelas valged pärlid.
7628.de: On a blue-white background the head of a young man in half-turn to the right, white pearls at the neck.

7629.d: Ruugetes, rohelistes, kollastes ja lillakates toonides pargivaade. Paremal osa hoonest, vasakul skulptuure.
7629.de: Park view in brownish, green, yellow and purplish tones. On the right part of a building, on the left sculptures.

7630.d: Pruunides toonides interjöör kirjutuslaua, tabureti ja raamaturiiuliga. Keskel aken, millest avaneb vaade linnale.
7630.de: Interior in brown tones with a writing desk, a stool and a bookshelf. In the middle a window through which a view of the town opens.

7631.d: Sinakal foonil suurte pindadena maalitud roosa kraega, pruunis kleidis noore naise kolmveerandfiguur, kerge peapööre vasakule.
7631.de: Against a bluish background, painted in large planes, the three-quarter figure of a young woman with a pink collar, in a brown dress, head turned slightly to the left.

7636.d: Vaarikapunasel taustal kirsipruunis suvekleidis, laia äärega kollase kübaraga noore naise rindportree veerandpöördes paremale, käed vaheliti rinnal. Naisel tõsine ilme, suured silmad, sirge nina, kübara vari langeb vasakule näopoolele. Kleidi ovaalse kaeluse juures kolm nööpi. Üldistatud, napp markeeriv laad, kohati kontuurjooni maalipinda sisse kraabitud.
7636.de: Against a raspberry-red background, a bust portrait of a young woman in a cherry-brown summer dress with a wide-brimmed yellow hat, in a three-quarter turn to the right, hands crossed on her chest. The woman has a serious expression, large eyes, a straight nose, the shadow of the hat falling on the left side of her face. Three buttons at the oval neckline of the dress. Generalized, sparse, marking manner, in places contour lines scratched into the paint surface.

7639.d: Punavalge triibulisel alusel poolkülili lebav noor naine, käed kuklal, jalad konksus, seljas vanaroosat tooni käisteta kleit. Ülakeha all sinine riie. Tagapool paremal türkiisrohelisel taustal kipstorso, vasakul hele-, keskel tumehall draperii. Markeeriv maalilaad, erksad toonid.
7639.de: A young woman lying half on her side on a base covered with red-and-white striped cloth, hands behind her head, legs bent, wearing a sleeveless dress in an old-rose tone. Under her upper body a blue cloth. Behind her on the right, against a turquoise-green background, a plaster torso; on the left a light-coloured drapery, in the middle a dark grey one. Sketchy painting style, bright tones.

7640.d: Laiaservalises kübaras noore naise rinnapilt. Beežil taustal.
7640.de: Bust of a young woman in a wide-brimmed hat. On a beige background.

7642.d: Pannoo kavand. Esiplaanil pallivõrgu ees neli spordiriietuses seisvat noormeest: vasakult esimene odaga, teine kuuli ja kolmas kettaga käes, neljandal käed ristamisi rinnal. Võrgu taga, paremal kaks jooksjat. Taustaks meri purjekate ja laevadega.
7642.de: Sketch for a panel. In the foreground, in front of a ball net, four young men standing in sportswear: from the left the first with a javelin, the second holding a shot put and the third a discus, the fourth with arms crossed on his chest. Behind the net, on the right, two runners. The background shows the sea with sailboats and ships.

7643.d: Naise ja mehe poolfiguurid, mõlemad peakatetes, mehel käes avatud ajaleht. Koloriit hele - valkjas, nägudel ja kätel varjudes roosakas-lilla toon. Katmisviis ühtlane, sile.
7643.de: Half-figures of a woman and a man, both wearing headwear, the man holding an open newspaper. Light colour scheme - whitish, with a pinkish-lilac tone in the shadows on faces and hands. Even, smooth application of paint.

7644.d: Hallikaspruunides toonides ja geomeetrilistes vormides linnavaade kõrgete tornitaoliste majadega.
7644.de: Cityscape in greyish-brown tones and geometric forms with tall tower-like houses.

7693.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon. Tagaplaanil sügisesed viljapõllud, millel kokkupandud viljarõugud. Kompositsioon koosneb kolmest figuurist: naine, laps ja mees. Ees vasakul tugev naisfiguur viljavihuga paremas kaenlas. Riietatud roosasse kleiti, ees sinakas põll ja peas rätt. Vaade suunatud paremale alla lapsele ja mehele. Keskel väike paljas laps haaranud ema riietest ja vaatab tema poole üles. Paremal ees istub tumesinisesse särki ja pruunidesse pükstesse riietatud mees, peas kaabu. Taamal künkaliste põldude keskel sinine ümmargune järveke.
7693.de: A figural composition. In the background, autumn grain fields with sheaves of grain stacked together. The composition consists of three figures: a woman, a child, and a man. In front on the left, a strong female figure with a sheaf of grain under her right arm. Dressed in a pink dress, a bluish apron in front, and a scarf on her head. Her gaze directed down to the right, at the child and the man. In the middle, a small naked child clings to the mother's clothing and looks up at her. On the right in front sits a man dressed in a dark blue shirt and brown trousers, a hat on his head. In the background, amid hilly fields, a small round blue lake.

7694.d: Laua taga, sügavalt dekolteeritud kleidis naise poolfiguur poolprofiilis vasemele. Vasakus käes peet; parem käsi laual seisva kruusi ümber. Naise ees laual päevalille pea, kõrvits, sibul, kurgid.
7694.de: Half-figure of a woman in a deeply décolleté dress behind a table, in half-profile to the left. In her left hand a beet; her right hand around a mug standing on the table. In front of the woman on the table a sunflower head, a pumpkin, an onion, cucumbers.

7695.d: Valgel linal istuva tütarlapse alasti täisfiguur poolprofiilis vasakule.
7695.de: Full-length nude figure of a girl sitting on a white sheet, in half-profile to the left.

7696.d: Esiplaanil lauataga mehe ja naise figuurid. Laual vaasike lilledega, avatud raamat ja taldrik. Taga vasakul seisva naise poolakt.
7696.de: In the foreground figures of a man and a woman at a table. On the table a small vase with flowers, an open book and a plate. Behind on the left a half-length nude of a standing woman.

7697.d: Ees meri kividega. Vasakul kõrge paekallas põõsaste ja puudega.
7697.de: In front the sea with stones. On the left a high limestone bank with bushes and trees.

7698.d: Tütarlapse põlvpilt istuvas asendis. Pea poolprofiilis paremale. Rohekas kleidis; üle vasaku õla süllerippuv punane sall.
7698.de: Half-length knee portrait of a girl in a seated position. Head in three-quarter profile to the right. Wearing a greenish dress; a red shawl hanging over the left shoulder.

7700.d: Punase baretiga istuva poisikese kolmveerand figuur. Pea kerge pöördega paremale. Hoiab põlvede vahele toetutud kitarri.
7700.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated boy with a red beret. Head turned slightly to the right. Holding a guitar resting between his knees.

7701.d: Metsamaastikus esiplaanil vasakul seljaga vaataja poole naine ja keskel taga kaks naist pähkleid korjamas, taustaks mets.
7701.de: In a forest landscape, in the foreground on the left a woman with her back to the viewer, and in the middle behind two women gathering nuts, with forest as background.

7702.d: Esiplaanil vana halli puutara tagant kerkivad suured lehtpuud pildi ülaääreni. Vasakult üle aia paistavad agulimajade katused. Esiplaanilt paremale suunduv agulitänav.
7702.de: In the foreground large deciduous trees rise from behind an old grey wooden fence to the top edge of the picture. On the left, over the fence, the roofs of suburban houses can be seen. A suburban street leading from the foreground to the right.

7703.d: Naisakt istumas toolil, vasakus käes roos, parem hoiab kinni toolileenest. Naise peas rätik. Fooniks sinakasroheline drapeering, vasakul alumises nurgas sinakas vaas. Toolil punane drapeering, ees all vasakul sinine.
7703.de: Female nude sitting on a chair, a rose in the left hand, the right holding onto the chair back. A kerchief on the woman's head. Background of bluish-green drapery, a bluish vase in the lower left corner. Red drapery on the chair, blue at the bottom left in front.

7704.d: Keskel Narva jõgi, mille vasakul kaldal Hermani ning paremal Ivangorodi kindlus. Üle jõe sild, tagaplaanil linna panoraam.
7704.de: In the middle the Narva River, on whose left bank stands the Hermann Castle and on the right the Ivangorod fortress. A bridge across the river, in the background a panorama of the town.

7705.d: Esiplaanil paremal punases pluusis pika seeliku ja heleda põllega naine. Temast vasakul laps valges särgis. Taga vasakul mehefiguur.
7705.de: In the foreground on the right a woman in a red blouse, a long skirt and a light-coloured apron. To her left a child in a white shirt. Behind, on the left, a male figure.

7706.d: Pruunikast tumedusest eralduvad heledas valguslaigus kolm figuuri, kaks neist istuvad (üks selgvaates), kolmas seisab. Maalitud üldistavas laadis.
7706.de: Three figures emerge from brownish darkness in a light patch, two of them seated (one in a full-face view), the third standing. Painted in a generalising manner.

7707.d: Vana kühmus mehe portree istuvas asendis pöördega vasakule. Parem kannu hoidev käsi toetub põlvedele, vasak, deformeerunud käsi, lauanurgale.  Laual kõlavas sinises toonis tass alusega, parema käsivarre kõrgusel nuikaktuse pott.
7707.de: Portrait of an old, hunched man in a seated position, turned to the left. His right hand, holding a jug, rests on his knees, his left, deformed hand, on the corner of the table. On the table, a cup with a saucer in a resonant blue tone, at the height of the right forearm a pot of nasturtiums.

7712.d: Sinise jaki ja tumeda rätikuga istuva vana naise figuur pöördes vasakule, nägu en face.
7712.de: The figure of an old woman sitting, in a blue jacket and dark headscarf, turned to the left, face en face.

7713.d: Otsevaates mehe portree roosakal foonil. Peas valge müts.
7713.de: Frontal portrait of a man on a pinkish background. On his head a white cap.

7714.d: Vaba pastoosse pintslikäsitlusega maal sagedaste pahtlilöökidega. Kaks kolmandikku pildipinnast katab rand, paremal kitsas riba merd väikese neeme ja lahega. Rannal vasakul kõrge järsu katusega väike maja katuse äärle toetuva pika teibaga. Harja vasakul otsal püstine teivas. Kompositsiooni keskel kuusk, selle all kummulipööratud paat. Esiplaanil kaks gruppi saetud puutüvesid; vasemal kõrvuti kaks, paremal kaks tüve toetumas risti jämedale tüvepakule. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks lambatalle, nende taga vasakule minev ja haokubu pea peal kandev naine. Paremal kalda ääres purjekas ja grupp inimesi.
7714.de: A freely, thickly brushed painting with frequent impasto strokes. Two thirds of the picture surface is covered by a beach, on the right a narrow strip of sea with a small headland and bay. On the beach on the left a small house with a tall, steep roof, with a long pole leaning against the edge of the roof. At the left end of the ridge an upright pole. In the centre of the composition a spruce, beneath it an upturned boat. In the foreground two groups of sawn tree trunks; on the left two side by side, on the right two trunks resting crosswise on a thick trunk block. In the foreground on the left two lambs, behind them a woman heading left carrying a bundle of brushwood on her head. On the right, by the shore, a sailing boat and a group of people.

7715.d: Tumepunases kleidis, mustas jakis ja kübaras istuv naine, pilk kätele suunatud. Kübaral lillekimp, kleidi kaeluses pross. Süles hele kauss, käte vahel punane õun ja nuga. Foon roheline. Naise vasak näopool ja kael hästi valgustatud. Tugeva lakikorra all.
7715.de: A woman sitting in a dark red dress, black jacket and hat, gaze directed at her hands. A bouquet of flowers on the hat, a brooch at the dress's neckline. In her lap a light-coloured bowl, between her hands a red apple and a knife. Background green. The woman's left side of the face and neck well lit. Under a thick layer of varnish.

7716.d: Mehe poolfiguur portree, kerges pöördes paremale, keha veidi ettekummardanud. Heledad, tihedad juuksed ülepea kammitud; näojooned ümarad, pehmed. Pintsak eest avatud; vesti kaeluse kolmnurgast paistavad valge särgikrae ning pruunikas lips.
7716.de: Half-length portrait of a man, slightly turned to the right, body leaning forward a little. Light, thick hair combed straight back; rounded, soft facial features. Jacket open at the front; through the triangle of the waistcoat collar a white shirt collar and a brownish tie are visible.

7717.d: Laiade, sulatavate pintslilöökidega maalitud vaade Emajõele, jalakäijate silla juures. Ees kaldaperv puudegrupiga. Taamal paremal ning vasakul paistavad puude vahelt majad. Paremas servas paat kahe figuuriga.
7717.de: A view of the Emajõgi River near the pedestrian bridge, painted with broad, blending brushstrokes. In front, a riverbank with a group of trees. In the distance on the right and left, houses can be seen through the trees. In the right margin a boat with two figures.

7718.d: Valdavalt rohekas-hallikas toonis maalitud taustal kaks, peaaegu elusuuruses jooksvat lapsefiguuri - alasti, tumedajuukseline poiss; pea profiilis vasakule ja roosakas kleidis tüdruk, parem käsi tõstetud, valmis haarama ees hõljuvat kuldkollast liblikat. Koloriit hele. Joon kohati hajutatud; maalipind osaliselt faktuurne.
7718.de: Against a background painted mainly in greenish-grey tones, two almost life-size running child figures - a naked, dark-haired boy, his head in profile turned to the left; and a girl in a pinkish dress, her right hand raised, ready to catch a golden-yellow butterfly hovering in front of her. The colour scheme is light. The line is in places diffused; the painted surface partly textured.

7719.d: Sinakal taustal valge draperiiga kaetud tugitoolis istuv noor naisakt veerandpöördes vasakule. Naisel ümar nägu, lühikesed tumedad juuksed, pilk suunatud otse ette. Käed toetuvad toolileenile, vasak jalg teisest veidi eespool. Figuur valgusvarjuga modelleeritud, kohati laiade spaatli tõmmetega maalitud.
7719.de: Against a bluish background, a young female nude sits in an armchair covered with white drapery, in a three-quarter turn to the left. The woman has a round face, short dark hair, her gaze directed straight ahead. Her hands rest on the armrest of the chair, the left leg slightly ahead of the other. The figure is modelled with light and shadow, painted in places with broad palette-knife strokes.

7720.d: Pruunika laudseina taustal istuv heledapäine patsidega tütarlaps otsevaates, käed süles. Figuur lõigatud põlvede kohalt. Tüdrukul tõsine ilme, pruunide silmade pilk suunatud ette paremale. Patsides tumedad lehvid, must seos suure kraega heleda suvekleidi kaeluses. Foonil paremal sinakas riie. Maalitud värvikalt valgus-varjuga pehmelt modelleerides.
7720.de: Against the background of a brownish plank wall, a fair-haired girl with braids sits in a frontal view, hands in her lap. The figure is cropped at knee level. The girl has a serious expression, her brown-eyed gaze directed forward to the right. Dark bows in her braids, a black tie at the neckline of her large-collared light summer dress. In the background on the right a bluish fabric. Painted colourfully, softly modelled with light and shadow.

7721.d: Suvine vaade kõrgendikult ojasängile allpool. Esiplaanil noorte mändide ladvad, nende taga käänuline veekogu. Taamal metsa veerel erkkollasel nõlvakul kolm majakest. Maalitud erksates toonides, kohati küllalt pastoosselt.
7721.de: Summer view from a height over a stream bed below. In the foreground the tops of young pines, behind them a winding body of water. Beyond, at the forest edge on a bright yellow slope, three small houses. Painted in vivid tones, in places rather pastose.

7736.d: Tumedates hallides ja pruunides toonides keskealise naise portree: naine antud istuvana, kuni põlvini, otsevaates, käed teineteise peal süles. Naisel seljas hall, tagasipööratud käistega kleit, kaelas valge rätik, ees valge põll. Naise heledasti valgustatud laubalt on juuksed üle pea taha kammitud. Foon tume.
7736.de: Portrait of a middle-aged woman in dark grey and brown tones: the woman is shown seated, to the knees, in frontal view, hands folded one over the other in her lap. The woman wears a grey dress with turned-back cuffs, a white kerchief at the neck, a white apron in front. The hair on the woman's brightly lit forehead is combed back over the head. The background is dark.

7751.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kirev vaas, keskel taburett, tool ja madal laud mitmesuguste tarbeesemetega. Tooli taga molbert pooleli teosega. Tagaseinas kõrge raamaturiiul, seinal pilte ja vaip.
7751.de: In the foreground on the left a colourful vase, in the centre a stool, a chair and a low table with various household objects. Behind the chair an easel with an unfinished work. On the back wall a tall bookshelf, on the wall pictures and a rug.

7768.d: Hallides puhvpükstes ja mürkrohelises pluusis noor mees istumas vöödilise tekiga kaetud toolil. Mehel rõõsk jume, pügatud vurrud ja šatäänid, pisut taandunud piiriga juuksed. Mehe parem küünarnukk toetub tooli seljatoele. Figuurist paremal laud värvituubide ja lahustipudelitega, läikival metallkandikul väike valge vaas märtsikellukestega ja tumerohelisest klaasist veinipudel. Foon rohekashall.
7768.de: A young man in grey puffed trousers and a poison-green blouse sitting on a chair covered with a striped blanket. The man has a ruddy complexion, trimmed moustache and side-whiskers, hair with a slightly receded hairline. The man's right elbow rests on the back of the chair. To the right of the figure a table with paint tubes and solvent bottles, on a shiny metal tray a small white vase with snowdrops and a wine bottle of dark green glass. Background greenish-grey.

7771.d: Keskjoonest vasakul ümar mitmekorruseline kaaristuga hoone, mida ülal kroonib väljasirutatud tiibadega kotkas. Hoonest paremal madalam ja väiksem ümar torn. Esiplaanil roheline vesi, hele kaldarinnatis ja kaartega sild.
7771.de: To the left of the centre line a round multi-storey arcaded building, crowned above by an eagle with outstretched wings. To the right of the building a lower and smaller round tower. In the foreground green water, a light-coloured bank parapet and an arched bridge.

7772.d: Keskplaanis nelinurkse põhiplaani, barokse (rohelise kiivriga) kupli ja nurgatornidega kirik. Esiplaanil jõgi, uhkete laternapostidega kaarsild. Taevas helesinine.
7772.de: In the middle ground, a church with a square ground plan, a baroque dome (with a green helmet) and corner towers. In the foreground, a river, an arched bridge with splendid lamp posts. Sky pale blue.

7773.d: Pastelsetes toonides linnavaade: esiplaanil paremal ažuursete käsipuudega väike sild üle sinise veega väikese kanali, tagaplaanis kuplite ja tornidega ehitised.
7773.de: A cityscape in pastel tones: in the foreground on the right a small bridge with openwork handrails over a small canal with blue water, in the background buildings with domes and towers.

7778.d: Erkroosas seelikus tütarlaps unelevas poosis nõjatumas aknalauale. Taustal heleda täiskuuga koobaltsinine öötaevas.
7778.de: A girl in a bright pink skirt in a dreamy pose, leaning on a windowsill. In the background a cobalt-blue night sky with a bright full moon.

7787.d: Poolpikkade tumedate juustega noore naise rindportree poolpöördes vasakule rohelise puudesalu taustal. Vasakul paar lilleherne õit. Detailitäpne kujutamisviis.
7787.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with dark, half-length hair, in a half-turn to the left, against the background of a green grove. On the left a pair of sweet pea flowers. Precisely detailed manner of depiction.

7807.d: a) Lillakaspunaste ja roosade ruutudega suurel, narmastega rätil pruun, ülalt ahenev ja avause kohal jälle laienev kann. Selle ees kaks kollast sidrunit, kaks apelsini, sibul, kaks kurki, üks tomat. Esiplaanil viinamarjad ja poolik sidrun. Foon lillakashall.
7807.de: a) On a large fringed cloth with purplish-red and pink squares, a brown jug narrowing at the top and widening again above the opening. In front of it two yellow lemons, two oranges, an onion, two cucumbers, one tomato. In the foreground grapes and a half lemon. Background purplish-grey.

7862.d: Pruunil foonil rohekas alus, millel üksteisest erineva suuruse ja kujuga sened; kübarad punased, kollased ja pruunid. Maalitud laia pintsliga, kohati pastoosselt, kohati kumab läbi lõuend.
7862.de: On a brown background a greenish base, on which mushrooms of differing size and shape; caps red, yellow and brown. Painted with a broad brush, in places pastose, in places the canvas shows through.

7871.d: Ees keskel pilvedel kaarik, mille ees neli hobust. Kaarikus seisev naise täisfiguur, ohjad käes ja kaks lapsefiguuri. Paremal kolme mehe figuurid lippudega.
7871.de: In the centre foreground a chariot on clouds, drawn by four horses. In the chariot the full figure of a standing woman, holding the reins, and two child figures. On the right the figures of three men with flags.

7878.d: Esiplaanil paremal istub punastel patjadel kuldsel toolil naisfiguur, keha 1/4 pöördes vasakule. Vasak käsi tõstetud. Naisel seljas pruunikas drapeeritud rõivas, pea kohal kuldne nimbus, millesse kirjutatud kirillitsas Maria. Vasakul seisab 3/4 pöördes paremale hoogsas poosis ingel. Ingel hoiab ühes käes peenikest saua, teine on tõstetud õnnistamaks Maarjat. Ingli nimbusesse on kirjutatud kirillitsas Gabriil. Seljas on tal punane mantel, mille all rohekas rüü, tiivad punase ja rohelisega. Figuuride taustaks on kaks hoonet, vasakul punane, paremal roheline, taust pruunikas - kuldne. Ülaosas Püha Vaimu sümbol - väike valge tuvi suundumas tuvi poole.
7878.de: In the foreground on the right sits a female figure on red cushions on a golden chair, the body in a 1/4 turn to the left. The left hand is raised. The woman is wearing a brownish draped garment, above her head a golden halo, on which is written in Cyrillic "Maria". On the left stands an angel in a 3/4 turn to the right, in a dynamic pose. The angel holds a thin staff in one hand, the other is raised to bless Mary. On the angel's halo is written in Cyrillic "Gabriil". He wears a red cloak, under which a greenish robe, wings in red and green. The background to the figures consists of two buildings, on the left red, on the right green, the background brownish-gold. In the upper part the symbol of the Holy Spirit – a small white dove heading towards the dove.

7891.d: Tumedates sinakasrohelistes ja heledates toonides maastik. Eemalt paistab hele tervatipulise torniga kirik.
7891.de: Landscape in dark bluish-green and light tones. In the distance a church with a bright pointed tower is visible.

7895.dm: laius: 65.5 cm (arm  ); kõrgus: 62.0 cm; kõrgus: 61.5 cm (arm  ); laius: 66.0 cm
7895.d: Esiplaanil laud selle seisva keraja klaasvaasiga, milles valgeid vesiroose. Tagaplaanil seinal pildiraami allosa.
7895.de: In the foreground a table with a standing round glass vase on it, containing white water lilies. In the background on the wall the lower part of a picture frame.

7898.d: Laual kolm õuna, pirn, nuga, tikutoos ja mängukaart.(eesti)
7898.de: On the table three apples, a pear, a knife, a matchbox and a playing card.

7905.d: Kruntimata vineerile maalitud suvine maastik rahutu taevaga. Vasakul suur puu, keskel väiksemate lehtpuude grupp.
7905.de: Summer landscape with a restless sky, painted on unprimed plywood. On the left a large tree, in the middle a group of smaller deciduous trees.

7921.d: Aknalaual roosades õites asaleapott, vasakul vaagen ja pudel. Maalitud õhukeselt pikkade pintslitõmmetega, lõuendit kohati kattmata jättes. Sinakad ja pruunikad toonid, aknaavas kollaseid toone.
7921.de: On a windowsill an azalea pot with pink flowers, on the left a platter and a bottle. Painted thinly with long brushstrokes, leaving the canvas bare in places. Bluish and brownish tones, yellow tones in the window opening.

7975.d: Tumedapäise noore naise poolfiguur otsevaates. Seljas valge avara kaelusega käisteta kleit punaste nööpidega.
7975.de: Half-figure of a dark-haired young woman, frontal view. Wearing a white sleeveless dress with a wide collar and red buttons.

8001.d: Ees rohtukasvanud jõesopp heinamaaga. Taga mets. Koloriit hele, domineerib heleroheline.(eesti)
8001.de: In front, a grassy river inlet with a meadow. Behind, a forest. The colouring is light, light green dominating.

8014.d: Pildi keskel alumises osas majadevaheline aianurk üksikute puude ja põõsastega. Paremal, vasakul ja keskplaanis mitmesugused, geomeetrilist mahtu rõhutavad majad. Majade taga lage väli, silmapiirist kõrgemal hall, kohati heledalt läbikumav taevas. Rohelus paksu värviga, pintslilööke paista lastes maalitud, mõnede majade külgi valguse ja varju abil modelleeritud. Domineerivad rohelised, kollased ja pruunid toonid.
8014.de: In the middle of the picture, in the lower part, a garden corner between houses with individual trees and bushes. On the right, left and in the middle plane various houses emphasising geometric volume. Behind the houses an open field, above the horizon a grey sky, in places translucent and light. The greenery is painted with thick paint, brushstrokes visible, the sides of some houses modelled with light and shadow. Green, yellow and brown tones dominate.

8020.d: Esiplaanil mööda lumist teed suunaga tahapoole sõitev regi talumehega. Üksikute raagus puude taga paistavad lumiste katustega majad. Paremale jääb kahekorruseline hoone. Taevas tumehall.
8020.de: In the foreground a sledge with a peasant man, driving along a snowy road, heading away from the viewer. Behind the solitary bare trees, houses with snowy roofs can be seen. To the right there is a two-storey building. The sky is dark grey.

8027.d: Rannaäärse kalarappimise stseen: ees keskel istub tünnide vahel beezhis pluusis ja seelikus paljasjalgne naine, valge pearätik kuklasse seotud, käed sorimas kõrvalasuvas kaladega täidetud kastis. Naisel ees põll ja põlvedel lõikelaud noa ja kalarapetega. Vasakul toetab põlle ja pearätikuga noor naine kaladega kuhjatud kasti tünnile. Vasakpoolse naise taga võrgukuur. Kuuri kõrval seisab keskplaanis poolproofiilis kõhn vana mees, soni peas ja piip hambus. Paremal alumises nurgas istub heledakarvaline koer, pea kalakastide alla peidetud. Tagaplaanil paremal meri ja paatidega rannaviirg kaldale tõmmatud paatidega. Kohati pastoosne faktuur.(eesti)
8027.de: A seaside fish-cleaning scene: in the centre foreground, between barrels, sits a barefoot woman in a beige blouse and skirt, a white headscarf tied at the nape of her neck, her hands rummaging in a nearby box filled with fish. The woman has an apron in front and a cutting board with a knife and fish scraps on her knees. On the left, a young woman with an apron and headscarf supports a box heaped with fish on a barrel. Behind the woman on the left a net shed. Next to the shed, in the middle ground, stands a thin old man in half-profile, a cap on his head and a pipe in his mouth. In the lower right corner sits a light-coloured dog, its head hidden under the fish boxes. In the background on the right the sea and a shoreline with boats, with boats drawn up onto the shore. The texture is pastose in places.

8031.d: Esiplaanil kaks istuvat naist lillekorvidega, tagapool üksikuid figuure. Maalitud kerges, skitseerivas laadis.
8031.de: In the foreground two seated women with flower baskets, further back solitary figures. Painted in a light, sketch-like manner.

8034.d: Punases kleidis prillidega naise rinnaportree otsevaates tumadel foonil.
8034.de: Bust portrait of a woman in a red dress with glasses, in frontal view against a dark background.

8040.d: Vasakul ees liivasel rannal selgvaates üksik lehm, paremal lamav pruuni-valgekirju lehm. Temast tagapool kaks lehma.(eesti)
8040.de: On the left in front on a sandy shore in clear view a solitary cow, on the right a lying brown-and-white spotted cow. Behind her two cows.

8073.d: Toas pingil istuva mehe täisfiguur üle vasaku põlve maha rippuvat purjeriiet parandamas. Pabeross suus, sonimüts peas.
8073.de: Full figure of a man sitting on a bench indoors, mending a piece of sailcloth hanging over his left knee. A cigarette in his mouth, a knitted cap on his head.

8083.d: Esiplaanil istuv naine (Greenbergi tüüp), rõhutatult tugevate käte vahel hoiab last, taga mees. Paremal kõrgete jalgadega laud rohelise kupliga lambiga. Käsitlus etüüdilik, maaliline.
8083.de: In the foreground a seated woman (Greenberg type), holding a child between markedly strong arms, a man behind. On the right a table on tall legs with a lamp with a green shade. Treatment sketch-like, painterly.

8084.d: Ees veekogu ääres kivid. Vastaskaldal madal talumaja puudega paremal.
8084.de: Stones by a body of water in front. A low farmhouse with trees on the right on the opposite bank.

8113.d: Kaarjate käetugedega istmel istuva noore naise täisfiguur, kere kergelt paremale pööratud, pea otse, vaade pisut vasakule. Parem käsi toetub paremale reiele, vasak istmele. Naisel seljas paksemal voodril mustast sifoonist dekolteeritud õhtukleit, jalas mustad sukad ja kingad. Fooniks pruun põrand ja punakaspruun sein, vasakus servas foonil tumehall pind.(eesti)
8113.de: A full figure of a young woman seated on a seat with curved armrests, her torso turned slightly to the right, her head straight, her gaze slightly to the left. Her right hand rests on her right thigh, her left hand on the seat. The woman wears a black chiffon evening gown with a heavier lining, décolleté, black stockings and shoes on her feet. The background is a brown floor and a reddish-brown wall, with a dark grey surface in the background at the left edge.

8123.d: Sinakas-rohekast valgusest täidetud taluõu, paremale jääva madala majaga. Taamal metsasiluett. Taevas täiskuu.
8123.de: A farmyard filled with bluish-green light, with a low house on the right. In the distance a forest silhouette. In the sky a full moon.

8129.dm: kõrgus: 48.0 cm (km.   ); laius: 43.0 cm (lm.   ); laius: 38.5 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 51.0 cm (lm.   )
8129.d: Telkide, hobuste, vankrite ja inimgruppidega ääristatud laadaplatsil tumedajuukseline naine külgvaates. Roosad lehvid juustes, hoiab helesinist salli. Temast paremal otsevaates mees, ülakeha paljastatud, käed vaheliti rinnal. Maalitud etüüdlikult, maalikiht õhuke, paber kumab läbi.
8129.de: At a fairground bordered by tents, horses, carts and groups of people, a dark-haired woman in profile. Pink ribbons in her hair, holding a light blue scarf. To her right, a man seen frontally, upper body bare, arms crossed over his chest. Painted in a sketchy manner, the paint layer is thin, the paper shows through.

8130.d: Vana naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Hallisegused juuksed üle pea kammitud. Suu juures nägu sissevajunud, huuled surutud kitsaks jooneks. Tumedate, sügaval asetsevate silmade pilk mõtlik. Ees ümarate raamidega prillid; seljas hall kleit, kaelus kinnitatud tumeda, ovaalse prossiga. taustaks kõrge toolileen.
8130.de: Bust portrait of an old woman in frontal view. Greying hair combed back over the head. Near the mouth the face is sunken, lips pressed into a narrow line. The gaze of the dark, deep-set eyes is thoughtful. In front, round-framed glasses; wearing a grey dress, the collar fastened with a dark, oval brooch. Background a high chair back.

8131.d: Talvine linnavaade. Vasakul pool tänava ääres ühe- ja mitmekorruselised majad, paremal lumine maa, raagus puud, teel mõned figuurid. Maalitud heledates hallides, pruunides toonides.
8131.de: A winter view of a city. On the left along the street one- and multi-storey houses, on the right snowy ground, bare trees, on the road a few figures. Painted in light grey, brown tones.

8139.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe põlvpilt en face, käed ristamisi rinnal.
8139.de: Caricature of the artist: a knee-length portrait of a standing man en face, arms crossed on the chest.

8140.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe põlvpilt profiilis vasemale. vasaku kaenla all mapp. Peas kaabu.
8140.de: Caricature of the artist: knee-length portrait of a standing man in profile to the left, a folder under his left arm. A hat on his head.

8141.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasemale. Vasak käsi taskus.
8141.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man in profile facing left. Left hand in pocket.

8142.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasakule. Käed kokkupandult kõhul.
8142.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man in profile to the left. Hands clasped on the stomach.

8144.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. taustaks sendine kirjamark.
8144.de: Caricature of the artist: half-figure of a man in profile facing left, background a brownish stamp.

8145.d: Šarž kunstnikust: vasakul õhus hõljuv naisfiguur asetamas pärga paremal seisva mehe pähe.
8145.de: Caricature of the artist: on the left a female figure hovering in the air placing a wreath on the head of a man standing on the right.

8151.dm: laius: 63.3 cm (arm  ); kõrgus: 49.0 cm; kõrgus: 48.6 cm (arm   ); laius: 63.2 cm
8151.d: Suvemaastik. Ees jõekäär pilliroopuhmastikuga vasakul. Ees paremal nurgas näha paadisilla nurk, keskel lootsik. Vastaskaldal puid, heinamaad.
8151.de: Summer landscape. In the foreground a river bend with reed thickets on the left. In the foreground right corner the corner of a boat landing is visible, a rowboat in the middle. On the opposite bank, trees, meadows.

8156.d: Mustlase portree en face õlgadeni. Mehel on vuntsid ja põskhabe, peas punaste paeltega müts.
8156.de: Portrait of a gypsy en face to the shoulders. The man has a moustache and side-whiskers, on his head a cap with red ribbons.

8159.d: Mererannal paat ja üksik puutüvi, mis ülalpool mutub joonia sambaks. (eesti)
8159.de: On the seashore, a boat and a solitary tree trunk, which above turns into an Ionic column.

8162.d: Heledale, kruntimata vineerile maalitud valge vaas lopsakate punaste ja kollaste õitega.
8162.de: A white vase with lush red and yellow blossoms, painted on light, unprimed plywood.

8165.d: Laua taga, millel on kolm suitsetamisraami ning kalad, istuvad kaks vanemat, valge ja roosa pearätiga naist ning lükivad kalu vardasse. Värvitoonid pastelsed.
8165.de: Behind a table on which there are three smoking racks and fish, sit two elderly women wearing white and pink headscarves, threading fish onto skewers. The colour tones are pastel.

8166.d: Esiplaanil jäätunud veekogu ja paat kahe inimesega. Kai ääres üks suurem ja üks väiksem aurulaev. Nende taga hooneid.
8166.de: In the foreground a frozen body of water and a boat with two people. By the quay one larger and one smaller steamship. Buildings behind them.

8261.d: Esiplaanil paremalt vasemale suunduva oja kaldal raagus pajud. Taga lumine vooremaastik.
8261.de: In the foreground, on the bank of a stream running from right to left, bare willows. Snowy hilly landscape behind.

8269.d: Täppivalt, rohelistes - kollastes toonides maalitud maastik. Puudealune metsatee ülekülvatud sillerdavatest päikeselaikudest. Puude kontuurid kergelt rõhutatud.
8269.de: A landscape painted in dotted technique, in green-yellow tones. A forest road under the trees strewn with shimmering patches of sunlight. The contours of the trees slightly emphasised.

8272.d: Pildi sügavusse suunduv sirge tänav. Vasakul kõrge müür ja majad, paremal puuderivi. Tänaval paarikaupa jalakäijaid. Üle puude ning majakatuste paistab laik sinist taevast.
8272.de: A straight street receding into the depth of the picture. On the left a high wall and houses, on the right a row of trees. Pedestrians walking in pairs on the street. A patch of blue sky shows above the trees and rooftops.

8294.d: Istuva tüdruku põlvportree kerges pöördes paremale. Tüdrukul tumedates juustes punane pael, seljas valge särk, sinine kleit ja lillakaspunane vest. Tüdruku parem käsi puhkab süles, vasak puusa juures. Paremal alumises nurgas kauss puuviljadega, ülanurgas pruunikirju kann suure lillekimbuga. Vasakul foon üksteisesse sulavates pruunides, beezides, sinakates toonides.
8294.de: Knee-length portrait of a seated girl in a slight turn to the right. The girl has a red ribbon in her dark hair, wears a white shirt, a blue dress and a purplish-red vest. The girl's right hand rests in her lap, the left near her hip. In the lower right corner a bowl with fruit, in the upper corner a brownish patterned jug with a large bouquet of flowers. On the left, the background merges into browns, beiges, bluish tones blending into one another.

8304.d: Talutuba avatud uksega tagaseinas. Ees paremal seisev naine, vasakul maas kirves.
8304.de: A farmhouse room with an open door in the back wall. In front on the right a standing woman, on the left an axe on the floor.

8330.d: Istuva noor naise poolportree otsevaates: naisel tumedad, kergelt laines juuksed, heledate kulmude ja väikeste, teineteisest lahus asetsevate silmadega nägu. Naisel seljas valge pluus, tume jakk või keep ja kollane seelik. Foon kollasega tembitud roosa.
8330.de: A frontal half-portrait of a seated young woman: the woman has dark, slightly wavy hair, a face with light eyebrows and small eyes set apart from each other. The woman wears a white blouse, a dark jacket or cape and a yellow skirt. Background pink tinged with yellow.

8340.d: Esiplaanil madalal rannal vasakul võrgumajad, paremal kaldale veetud paate ja purjekaid. Taga keskel purjekaid, nende taga maja. Paremal meri.
8340.de: In the foreground on a low shore, on the left net houses, on the right boats and sailboats pulled up onto the shore. Behind, in the middle, sailboats, behind them a house. On the right the sea.

8371.d: Heledal draperiil selili asendis naisakt, pea pööratud vaataja poole, silmad suletud. Vasak, kõverdatud käsi kukla taga, parem näo juures. Tumedad lahkukammitud juuksed langevad punasele draperiile. Jalad põlvest kõverdatud, alakeha pööratud vaataja poole. Foonil vasakul sinakas draperii. Akt maalitud hallikasbeezides toonides plastilist vormi rõhutades.
8371.de: A female nude lying on her back on a light drapery, head turned towards the viewer, eyes closed. The left, bent arm behind the back of the head, the right near the face. Dark hair, parted and combed, falls onto the red drapery. Legs bent at the knee, the lower body turned towards the viewer. In the background on the left a bluish drapery. The nude is painted in greyish-beige tones, emphasizing the plastic form.

8382.d: Keskel hallikas - valgel eeslil ratsutav Kristus. Tema kuju külg - asendis, pea pööratud vaatega üle vasaku õla tagasi. Seljas rohekas rüü. Nii Kristuse ees kui ka taga inimeste grupid teda saatmas ja tervitamas. Paremal taga linna kujutis. Linna ees olevatel inimestel käes väikesed palmioksad. Vasakul pool taga pruunid mäed, keskel suur puu.
8382.de: In the centre, Christ riding a grayish-white donkey. His figure in profile, head turned looking back over his left shoulder. Wearing a greenish robe. Both in front of and behind Christ, groups of people accompany and greet him. In the back on the right, a depiction of a city. The people in front of the city hold small palm branches in their hands. In the back on the left, brown mountains, a large tree in the centre.

8383.d: Keskel seisab jõevees meesfiguur, valge rätik ümber puusade, keha pöördes vasakule. Vasakul seisab kummargil teine mees - Ristija Johannes, kes puudutab parema käega vees seisva Kristuse pead. Johannese riietus rohelistes - punastes toonides. Paremal pool jõge seisavad kolm kummarduvat inglit, suunaga Kristuse poole. All vasakus nurgas seisab väike puu, mille võras on horisontaalselt asetatud must kirves. Ülal keskel Püha Vaimu sümbol - valge tuvi.
8383.de: In the middle, a male figure stands in the river water, a white cloth around his hips, his body turned to the left. On the left, another man stands bent over - John the Baptist, touching with his right hand the head of Christ standing in the water. John's clothing is in green-red tones. On the right side of the river stand three bowing angels, facing toward Christ. In the lower left corner stands a small tree, in whose crown a black axe is placed horizontally. At the top centre, the symbol of the Holy Spirit - a white dove.

8388.d: Šarž kunstnikust: istuva naise poolfiguur en face; käes ees vaheliti, peas kübar.
8388.de: Caricature of the artist: half-figure of a seated woman en face; hands crossed in front, hat on head.

8389.d: Šarž kunstnikust: koolipingis istuva mehe figuur profiilis vasemale. Seinal tahvel arvutusega 1 x 1 = 1
8389.de: Caricature of the artist: the figure of a man sitting at a school desk, in profile to the left. On the wall a board with the calculation 1 x 1 = 1

8390.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe põlvpilt profiilis vasakule. Käed kõhul kokku pandud.
8390.de: Caricature of the artist: a knee-length portrait of a man in profile facing left. Hands folded on the stomach.

8406.d: Kaks figuuri puu all  - istuv naine vasakul, kruus käes; mees paremal, käes piip. Lihtsustatud vormid, kahvatud toonid, maalitud pastoosselt jämedale lõuendile.
8406.de: Two figures under a tree – a seated woman on the left, holding a jug; a man on the right, with a pipe in hand. Simplified forms, pale tones, painted pastosely on coarse canvas.

8470.d: Lillelise linaga kaetud laual vasakul avatud raamat ja pott nuikaktusega. Paremal kolm apelsini ja vaas puuviljadega.
8470.de: On a table covered with a floral cloth, on the left an open book and a pot with a cactus. On the right three oranges and a vase with fruit.

8482.d: Pimedusse mähkunud maastikku valgustab kergelt heledam taevariba silmapiiri taha laskuva päikesega.
8482.de: A landscape shrouded in darkness is lit slightly by a lighter strip of sky where the sun is setting behind the horizon.

8497.d: Avaral maastikul kähara puu all vasakul pikas punases seelikus naine, laps käel. Naine veidi pööratud paremale, tema vastas seisev alasti poiss. Paremal istuv mees otsevaates, käed toetuvad põlvedele. Maalitud rõhutades värvipinda sissekraapimise teel, lastes vineeril läbi kumada.
8497.de: In an open landscape, under a curly tree on the left, a woman in a long red skirt, a child on her arm. The woman is turned slightly to the right, facing a standing naked boy. On the right a seated man seen frontally, hands resting on his knees. Painted emphasizing the paint surface through scratching-in, letting the plywood show through.

8498.d: a) rohekashallil foonil lühikeste tumedate juuste ja vuntsidega keskealise mehe portree poolprofiilis paremale. Pilk suunatud otse ette. Mehel seljas tume pintsak, kaelas punasekirju rätt. Nägu modelleeritud pehmelt kontuurjooni värvipinda sisse kraapides.
8498.de: a) on a greenish-grey background a portrait of a middle-aged man with short dark hair and a moustache, in half-profile to the right. Gaze directed straight ahead. The man wears a dark jacket, a red-patterned scarf around his neck. The face modelled softly, with contour lines scratched into the paint surface.

8517.d: Rohekashallides toonides, kerges kubistlikus stilisatsioonis antud vaade Tallinna linnamüürile, Paksule Margareetale, Suurele Rannaväravale ja Oleviste kirikule. Esiplaanil bastionid ja põõsad, ülal hallis taevas on üksikute joonte abil markeeritud pilved. (eesti)
8517.de: A view of the Tallinn town wall, Fat Margaret, the Great Coastal Gate and Oleviste Church, given in greenish-grey tones, in a slight cubist stylisation. Bastions and bushes in the foreground, clouds marked with individual lines in the grey sky above.

8519.d: Laia äärega kübaras noore naise poolfiguur. Keha kerge, pea tugeva pöördega paremale.
8519.de: Half-figure of a young woman in a wide-brimmed hat. Body slightly turned, head with a strong turn to the right.

8523.d: Kollakates ja rohekates toonides maalitud naisakt, punaste kräsus juustega pea pisut paremale kallutatud, silmad pruunid, kulmud peeneks kriipsuks raseeritud, meelas punane suu. Foon keskelt helesinine, vasakul sinistes ja punastes toonides mustriga drapeering, paremal punastes ja kollastes toonides draperii, mille servast hoiab naine mõlema käega kinni.
8523.de: A female nude painted in yellowish and greenish tones, the head with red curly hair tilted slightly to the right, brown eyes, eyebrows shaved into a thin line, a sensuous red mouth. The background is light blue in the middle, on the left a patterned drapery in blue and red tones, on the right a drapery in red and yellow tones, the edge of which the woman holds with both hands.

8524.d: Vanema, täidlase naise rinnaportree, kergelt vasakule pöördes. Keskendunud nägu raamivad hallisegused lühikesed juuksed. Seljas pruun, heleda kraega kleit. Nägu maalitud hoolikalt, modelleerivate pintsilöökidega, kleit ja foon kohati läbipaistvalt, etüüdlikult maalitud.
8524.de: Bust portrait of an older, plump woman, turned slightly to the left. Her focused face is framed by short greyish hair. Wearing a brown dress with a light-coloured collar. The face is painted carefully, with modelling brushstrokes, the dress and background painted somewhat transparently, in an étude-like manner.

8536.d: Laual vaas kirjude lilledega, mille ees mõned lilleõied ja rohelised õunad. Vaasi taga kummuli asetatud korv. Koloriidis rohkesti punaseid ja lillakaid toone.
8536.de: On the table a vase with multicoloured flowers, in front of it a few flower blossoms and green apples. Behind the vase an upturned basket. The colouring contains many red and purplish tones.

8570.d: Esiplaanil paadisild, millel lühikeste juustega valges särgis ja seelikus tütarlaps kükitades vees pesu loputab. Tütarlapse kõrval paadisillal kauss punase pesutükiga. Vasakul foonil paat ühe aeruga, taga kõrkjad. Paremal foonil tükike lagedat vett, kõrkjaid ning valged pardid.
8570.de: In the foreground a boat jetty, on which a short-haired girl in a white shirt and skirt rinses laundry in the water while squatting. Beside the girl on the jetty a bowl with a piece of red laundry. In the background on the left a boat with one oar, behind it reeds. In the background on the right a patch of open water, reeds and white ducks.

8578.d: Vaade ülalt pruunile lauale ja sellel asuvatele esemetele: keskel piklik punaste õunte, pirnide ja kollakate ploomidega täidetud korv ja vineerist silindrikujuline kohvrike, kaas lahti, siniseid ploome täis (rätiku peal). Esiplaanil kaks teravat nuga ja kaks suurt pirni. Foon ülaosas tume, sinakashall.
8578.de: A view from above of a brown table and the objects on it: in the middle an oblong basket filled with red apples, pears and yellowish plums, and a veneer cylindrical small case, lid open, full of blue plums (on a cloth). In the foreground two sharp knives and two large pears. The background is dark, bluish-grey in the upper part.

8588.d: Naisakt istuvas asendis. Parema käega maski näo ees hoidmas, vasak käsi vabalt alla rippumas. Pildi ülanurgas maske.
8588.de: Female nude in a seated position. Holding a mask in front of her face with the right hand, the left hand hanging freely down. Masks in the upper corner of the picture.

8590.d: Õue kivimajade vahel keskel plankudest aed avatud väravaga; taga kõrge viiluga maja taustal lumine puu; vasakul ees maja uste ees regi, paremal katuse all vanker.
8590.de: A yard among stone houses, in the middle a plank fence with an open gate; behind it a house with a high gable against a background of a snowy tree; on the left in front a sledge by the house doors, on the right a cart under the roof.

8598.d: Tumedal, roheka varjundiga foonil kimp punaseõielisi daaliaid. Värvipind pastoosne.
8598.de: On a dark background with a greenish tinge, a bouquet of red-blossomed dahlias. Paint surface pastose.

8599.d: Talvine linnavaade. Tänava ääres 2-3 korruselised majad. Paremal kõnnitee servas neli lumist puud. Tänavaristmikul kaks hobust regedega. Taustaks Toompea, Pika Hermaniga paremal ning kirikutorniga vasakul. Taevas sinakashall, maalitud erinevalt arhitektoonikast laiade pintslitõmmetega. Värvipind kohati faktuurne.
8599.de: Winter cityscape. 2-3 storey buildings along the street. On the right, at the edge of the pavement, four snowy trees. Two horses with sledges at the street crossing. In the background Toompea, with Pikk Hermann on the right and a church tower on the left. Sky bluish-grey, painted differently from the architecture with broad brushstrokes. Paint surface textured in places.

8616.d: Vasakul pruunika õlgkatusega talumaja ots, mille ees kuurid, puuridad. Esiplaanil õuemurul kanad. Tagaplaanil, läbi roheliste puukroonide paistab veetriip. Maal kroomrohekais, pruunides toonides.
8616.de: On the left the gable end of a farmhouse with a brownish straw roof, in front of it sheds, woodpiles. In the foreground, hens on the yard's grass. In the background, a strip of water shows through green treetops. The painting in chromium-green, brown tones.

8618.d: Lillakaspruunil foonil hallide vuntside ja habemega mehe rinnaportree otsevaates. Mehel ovaalsed kuldraamidega prillid ees, ninajuurel kaks sügavat kortsu. Tumedad hallisegused juuksed üle pea kammitud. Seljas tume kuub. Maalitud lühikese sileda pintslilöögiga.
8618.de: Frontal bust portrait of a man with grey moustache and beard on a purplish-brown background. The man wears oval gold-framed glasses, two deep wrinkles at the bridge of the nose. Dark greyish hair combed back over the head. Wearing a dark coat. Painted with short smooth brushstrokes.

8625.d: Ülal kiirtesõõris kahe ingli vahel trooniv Kristus. All keskel Maarja, Kristus ja kaks kuldsete tiibadega inglit õnnistamas kahel pool seisvat ja kummardavat rahvast.
8625.de: Above, Christ enthroned in a halo of rays between two angels. Below in the centre Mary, Christ and two angels with golden wings blessing the people standing and bowing on both sides.

8629.d: Šarž kunstnikust: kujutatud kassina naise peaga. Esimeste käppade vahel värvituub.
8629.de: Caricature of the artist: depicted as a cat with a woman's head. Between the front paws a tube of paint.

8630.d: Šarž kunstnikust: sammuva mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasemale. Vasak käsi taskus. Peas kaabu.
8630.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a walking man in profile to the left. Left hand in pocket. A hat on his head.

8631.d: Šarž kunstnikust: naise täisfiguur profiilis vasemale; sammuvas asendis. Parema kaenla all mapp. Vasakus käes kandekott.
8631.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a woman in profile to the left; in a walking pose. A folder under the right arm. A carrying bag in the left hand.

8632.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe põlvpilt poolprofiilis paremale. Vasak käsi kaabuga tõstetud üles, paremas käes kepp.
8632.de: Caricature of the artist: knee-length portrait of a man in half-profile to the right. Left hand raised with a hat, a cane in the right hand.

8638.d: Vaade Forum Romanumi lääneosale. Ees vasakul Marcus Aureliuse sammas, selle kõrval Septimus Severuse triumfikaar ja paremal Diocletianuse termidest ümber ehitatud Santa Maria degli Angeli kirik.
8638.de: View of the western part of the Forum Romanum. In front on the left the Column of Marcus Aurelius, next to it the Arch of Septimius Severus, and on the right the Church of Santa Maria degli Angeli, converted from the Baths of Diocletian.

8639.d: Esiplaanil veekogu kahekorruselise sillaga. Taamal tornidega linna siluett.
8639.de: In the foreground a body of water with a two-storey bridge. In the distance the silhouette of a city with towers.

8650.d: Panoraammaastik kollaste viljapõldude ja talumajadega nende vahel. Silmapiiril tume metsaviirg, keskjoonest kõrgemal kõrge lopsakate valgete pilvedega taevas. Eriti viljapõld esiplaanil ja pilved taevas väga pastoosselt maalitud.(eesti)
8650.de: Panoramic landscape with yellow grain fields and farmhouses among them. On the horizon a dark strip of forest, above the midline a tall sky with lush white clouds. The grain field in the foreground in particular, and the clouds in the sky, painted very pastosely.

8652.d: Keskel sinisel pinnal pruunikas roosa otsaga maja, vasakul ja paremal osad teistest majadest.(eesti)
8652.de: In the centre on a blue surface a house with a brownish-pink end, on the left and right parts of other houses.

8653.d: Erinevad geomeetrilised pinnad moodustavad keskosas tingliku inimfiguuri kaelaseotud käega. Esiplaanil vasakul all tikutoos ja tikk, paremal potilill, ülal paremal pilt inimfiguuridega. (eesti)
8653.de: Different geometric surfaces form a conventional human figure with a tied neck in the central part. In the foreground at the bottom left a matchbox and a match, on the right a flowerpot, above on the right a picture with human figures.

8713.d: Ees veekogu. Vastaskaldal paremal ühekordne kivihoone. Taga vabrikuhoonete kompleks.
8713.de: In front a body of water. On the opposite bank on the right a single-storey stone building. Behind, a complex of factory buildings.

8725.d: Õu Tallinna vanalinnast. Esiplaanil vasakul vanker. Taamal teravaid majaviile kivikatustega.
8725.de: A courtyard in Tallinn's Old Town. In the foreground on the left a cart. Sharp gables of houses with tiled roofs beyond.

8740.d: Esiplaanil merekallas varnas kuivavate võrkudega. Tagapool kaldale hiivatud ja vees olevaid sõu- ja purjepaare. Tagaplaanil taevaga ühtesulav veepind.
8740.de: In the foreground a seashore with nets drying on a rack. Behind it, pairs of rowing and sailing boats hauled onto the shore and in the water. In the background a water surface merging with the sky.

8741.d: Esiplaanil veekogu. Keskplaanil vasakul kindluse müürid torniga; keskel müüride taga torniga kirik. Paremal sild.
8741.de: In the foreground a body of water. In the middle ground on the left fortress walls with a tower; in the middle behind the walls a church with a tower. On the right a bridge.

8748.dm: kõrgus: 26.8 cm (km.   ); laius: 33.5 cm (lm.   ); laius: 31.5 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 30.6 cm (lm.   )
