8748.d: Laua ümber istumas neli meest. Parempoolne figuur 3/4 pöördes vaataja poole. Tagaplaanil, vasakul seisev mehefiguur.
8748.de: Four men sitting around a table. The figure on the right turned 3/4 towards the viewer. In the background, on the left, a standing male figure.

8760.d: Kolm laua ääres istuvat naist poolfiguuris. Laual malendid. Vasakpoolsel naisel süles koer.
8760.de: Three women sitting at a table, in half-figure. Chess pieces on the table. The woman on the left has a dog in her lap.

8783.d: Geomeetriliselt stiliseeritud kompositsioon selgvaates naisfiguuriga esiplaanis keskel. Naisel lühikeseks lõigatud paksud juuksed, mustad sukad ja pesu, jalas punased kõrge kontsaga kingad. Naise ees ovaalne peegel, tualett-tarvetega kaetud laud. Peeglis peegeldumas osa figuurist. Allservas paremal, varjuna mõjuv kübara ja kepiga mehe siluett. Fooniks geomeetrilistest kujunditest kompositsioon. Valitsevad mustad, hõõguvpunased ja sinised toonid.
8783.de: A geometrically stylized composition with a frontal-view female figure in the centre foreground. The woman has short-cropped thick hair, black stockings and underwear, and red high-heeled shoes. In front of her, an oval mirror, a table covered with toiletries. Part of the figure is reflected in the mirror. Lower right, the shadow-like silhouette of a man with a hat and a cane. The background is a composition of geometric shapes. Black, glowing red and blue tones predominate.

8787.d: Esiplaanil sadam paatide ja laevadega, tagapool vaade hoonetele.
8787.de: In the foreground a harbour with boats and ships, behind it a view of buildings.

8801.d: Esiplaanil lage plats üksikute suurte mändidega; aia taga puude ja põõsaste vahel üksikud majad. Horisondil mets.
8801.de: In the foreground an open area with individual large pines; behind a fence, among trees and bushes, individual houses. Forest on the horizon.

8817.d: Keskealise mehe rinnaportree: pea ja silmavaade kergelt paremale pööratud, juuksed taha kammitud, nina all väikesed vurrud. Seljas tumehall pintsak, valge särk ja bordoopunane lips. Ristatud, ebaloomulikult suured käed toetuvad millelegi. Foon tumepruun.
8817.de: Bust portrait of a middle-aged man: head and gaze slightly turned to the right, hair combed back, small moustache under the nose. Wearing a dark grey jacket, white shirt and burgundy-red tie. Crossed, unnaturally large hands rest on something. Background dark brown.

8818.d: Naise pea poolprofiilis pöördega vasakule, peas kirju tanu.
8818.de: A woman's head in half-profile turned to the left, wearing a colourful bonnet.

8839.d: Esiplaanil, poollamavas asendis, vasakule käele toetuv mees ning paremasse serva jääv kerra tõmbunud valge koer. Nende taga kolm mehefiguur. Vasakul mees valgel hobusel, seljaga vaataja poole. Taamal merel üksik valge purjekas.
8839.de: In the foreground, in a half-reclining position, a man leaning on his left hand, and on the right edge a white dog curled up. Behind them three male figures. On the left a man on a white horse, his back to the viewer. In the distance on the sea a solitary white sailboat.

8851.d: Valgete lillede keskel vana haraline tamm. Taustaks põõsastik.
8851.de: Among white flowers an old gnarled oak. Shrubbery as background.

8854.d: Brüneti tõmmunahalise valges särgis istuva naise põlvpilt. Pea ja õlad en face. paremal roheline - punane draperii.
8854.de: Knee-length portrait of a dark-haired, swarthy-skinned woman sitting in a white shirt. Head and shoulders en face. A green-red drapery on the right.

8860.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis paremale. paremas käes pintsel, vasakus hanesulg.
8860.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man in profile to the right, a brush in the right hand, a goose quill in the left.

8876.d: Pildipinda diagonaalselt läbivat jõge ääristavad tasased kaldapealsed, mis seejärel tõusevad järsult kõrgeks kaldaks. Tasasel alal inimesi, kaldapealsel sild, mida ületavad trammid.
8876.de: The river running diagonally across the picture surface is bordered by flat riverbanks, which then rise steeply into a high bank. People on the flat area, a bridge on the bank, crossed by trams.

8899.d: Maapind ja puude grupp, millest tõuseb üks mänd teistest kõrgemale kuni maali ülaservani, maalitud pruunikates ja tumerohelistes toonides ja lahtiste pintslilöökidega, osaliselt lõuendit katmata jättes. Tagapoolne järvepind antud hallides toonides, peegeldused rohekad. Eemal metsaviirg ja riba hallikat taevast. Meeleolu melanhoolne.
8899.de: The ground and a group of trees, from which one pine rises higher than the others up to the upper edge of the painting, painted in brownish and dark green tones with loose brush strokes, in places leaving the canvas uncovered. The lake surface behind is rendered in grey tones, the reflections greenish. In the distance a strip of forest and a band of grey sky. The mood is melancholic.

8940.d: Esiplaanil küngas. Keskosas parv lendavaid linde. Taustaks äikseline taevas.
8940.de: In the foreground a hill. In the middle a flock of flying birds. Background a stormy sky.

8946.d: 1/4 kujutatud künklik maastik üksikute hoonetega. 3/4 ulatuses pilvine taevas.
8946.de: 1/4 depicts a hilly landscape with individual buildings. 3/4 cloudy sky.

8948.d: Hämaras talutoas, vasakul profiilis paremale voki taga istuv ja ketrav keskealine naine paljajalu, peas lõua alt seotud hele rätik, seljas tumedad rõivad ja hele põll. Paremal, tulekolde ees, profiilis paremale, pea tagantvaates kükitav, paljasjalgne figuur. Interjööris, taga keskel lauduks, mille kõrval paremal seinal suur kulp. Maalitud tumedates, pruunides-hallides toonides.
8948.de: In a dim farmhouse room, on the left in profile facing right, a middle-aged woman sits spinning behind a spinning wheel, barefoot, her head covered with a light-coloured kerchief tied under the chin, wearing dark clothing and a light apron. On the right, in front of the hearth fire, in profile facing right, seen from behind, a crouching, barefoot figure. In the interior, at the back in the centre a table, beside which on the right wall a large ladle. Painted in dark, brown-grey tones.

8969.d: Esiplaanil kolm mehekuju, kaks kividel istumas, üks püsti. Keskel vasakul rannale tõmmatud paate. Vasakul äärel üksik purjepaat. Tagaplaanil kaks õlgkatusega hoonet ja puud.
8969.de: In the foreground three male figures, two sitting on stones, one standing. In the middle on the left, boats pulled up onto the shore. On the left edge a single sailboat. In the background two thatch-roofed buildings and trees.

8975.d: Keskel ülalpool valges rõivais Kristus kiirtevihus. Temast paremal ja vasakul üks Vana Testamendi pühak, kes kummarduvad kergelt Kristuse pool (Elijas ja Mooses?). All mägede taustal kolm Jeesuse jüngrit põlvitamas (Peetrus, Johannes, Jakobus?).
8975.de: In the centre above, Christ in white robes in a burst of rays. To his right and left, one Old Testament saint each, bowing slightly towards Christ (Elijah and Moses?). Below, against a background of mountains, three of Jesus' disciples kneeling (Peter, John, James?).

8993.d: Esiplaanil suur kala, Taga vasakul pruun tünn, keskel ja paremal sinakas draperii ja kast. Ees paremas nurgas pruun anum.(eesti)
8993.de: In the foreground a large fish. Behind on the left a brown barrel, in the middle and on the right a bluish drapery and a box. In the front right corner a brown vessel.

8997.d: Vasakul hallikasroosas koloriidis karjalaut, mille otsaseinale toetuvad lahtised lauad. Keskel ja paremal karjavärav, viiskudes, pruuni kaabuga jässakas mees seljaga vaataja poole karjaväravat avamas või sulgemas. Värava taga kaks lehma, taamal rohelised põllud ning paremal servas metsaviirg. Ülal hall pilvine taevas. Üldistatud vorm, hallides, pruunides, rohelistes ja roosades toonides summutatud kolriit.
8997.de: On the left, in a greyish-pink colour scheme, a cattle shed, against whose end wall loose boards lean. In the centre and on the right a cattle gate, wattle-fenced, a stocky man in a brown hat with his back to the viewer opening or closing the cattle gate. Beyond the gate two cows, further back green fields and on the right edge a strip of forest. Above a grey cloudy sky. Generalised form, muted colour scheme in grey, brown, green and pink tones.

9006.d: Kaljuse ranna mägimaastikul esiplaanil pikas pruunis nööriga vöötatud kuues paljasjalgne ja palja peaga seisev mees, laiali sirutatud kätega. Paremas käes raamatuke; ümbritsetud mitmesugustest lindudest.
9006.de: In a rocky coastal mountain landscape, in the foreground a barefoot and bareheaded man standing in a long brown coat tied with a cord, arms outstretched. A small book in his right hand; surrounded by various birds.

9014.d: Nooremapoolse mehe portree, pea pööratud paremale. Vasakult tulev valgus vormib tugevate refleksidega kõrgete põsesarnadega musklilise näo, sirge nina ja tumedad kulmud. Seljas tume kuub valge särgiga ja tumeroheline, laia paelaga kaabu. Foon hallikaspruun.
9014.de: Portrait of a somewhat younger man, head turned to the right. Light coming from the left models a muscular face with strong reflections, high cheekbones, straight nose and dark eyebrows. Wearing a dark coat with a white shirt and a dark green wide-brimmed hat with a wide ribbon. Background greyish-brown.

9033.d: Kolmest istuvast naisest kompositsioon: vasakpoolsel sinised rõivad ja jalg üle põlve, parempoolsel seljas oranžikaskollased riided, käes ridikül või raamat, juustes punane lill. Maalitud tihedate, vibreerivate pintslilöökidega.
9033.de: A composition of three seated women: the one on the left in blue clothing with a leg crossed over the knee, the one on the right wearing orange-yellow clothing, holding a handbag or a book, with a red flower in her hair. Painted with dense, vibrating brushstrokes.

9039.d: Helesinise kleidis naise rinnaportree, kaelas kollakas-roheline sall. Pea kerges pöördes paremale. Juuksed tumedad, kergelt laines, kõrged kulmud, tumedad silmad.
9039.de: Chest portrait of a woman in a light blue dress, a yellowish-green scarf around her neck. Head slightly turned to the right. Dark, slightly wavy hair, high eyebrows, dark eyes.

9041.d: Vaade Tallinnale Kalamaja kandist mere poolt: esiplaanil allservas ja paremal punakaspruunid laia põhjaga aurikud, vasakul allnurgas kai üksikute inimfiguuride ja tünnidega. Taamal Tallinna vanalinn, mille üle kõrgub Oleviste kirik. Ülal lillakashall, sünge pilvine taevas. Maalitud tumedates hallides ja pruunides toonides, esiplaanil veepind kohati pastoosselt antud.
9041.de: View of Tallinn from Kalamaja seen from the sea side: in the foreground, at the bottom edge and on the right, reddish-brown broad-bottomed steamships, in the bottom left corner a quay with a few human figures and barrels. Beyond, the Old Town of Tallinn, above which rises St. Olaf's Church. Above, a purplish-grey, gloomy cloudy sky. Painted in dark grey and brown tones, the water surface in the foreground given pastose in places.

9046.dm: kõrgus: 35.0 cm (vm.   ); laius: 27.4 cm; laius: 30.1 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 34.0 cm
9046.d: Noore naise poolfiguur en face; punases vestis ja sinises lühikäiselises pluusis.
9046.de: Half-figure of a young woman en face; in a red waistcoat and blue short-sleeved blouse.

9048.d: Ees vasakul jõgi paadisillaga, paremal kai. Pisut tagapool sild. Silla juures kai ääres purjepaadid.
9048.de: In the front on the left a river with a pontoon bridge, on the right a quay. A bit further back a bridge. Sailing boats by the quay near the bridge.

9054.d: Esiplaanil vasakul tugipiitadega tugimüür, paremal plekk-katus korstnaga. Keskel tõusvas järjestuses maju, nende vahel lehtpuid. Taama paremal üle puude ja katuste paistab Toomkiriku torni kiiver.
9054.de: In the foreground on the left a retaining wall with buttresses, on the right a sheet-metal roof with a chimney. In the middle houses in ascending order, with deciduous trees between them. In the distance on the right, above the trees and roofs, the spire of the Cathedral tower is visible.

9062.d: Suure, valge õie ja lopsakate lehtedega potilill. Selle kõrval, vasakul, kolju ülemine osa. Foon hallikas. Õieosas värvipind faktuurne.(eesti)
9062.de: Potted flower with a large white blossom and lush leaves. Beside it, on the left, the upper part of a skull. Background greyish. The paint surface of the flower area is textured.

9069.d: Keskel ülal istub Maarja. Allpool ringis kaksteist apostlit. All keskel tumepruunil taustal krooniga mehe poolfiguur, kes hoiab kätel linikut. Juurde kirjutatud Kosmos. Ülal keskel stiliseeritud päikesekiired.
9069.de: At the top centre sits Mary. Below, in a circle, the twelve apostles. At the bottom centre, against a dark brown background, a half-figure of a man with a crown, holding a cloth in his hands. The word "Kosmos" is written next to it. At the top centre, stylised sun rays.

9078.d: Pildi vasakul poolel noore mehe pea (kuni õlgadeni), nägu piklik, lühikesed juuksed, ilme mõtlik. Pluusi kaelus ümarik, punases toonis. Foon hele, paremale jääb mäe siluett.
9078.de: On the left side of the picture the head of a young man (down to the shoulders), an elongated face, short hair, a thoughtful expression. The blouse collar is rounded, in a red tone. The background is light, on the right the silhouette of a mountain.

9080.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis vasemale; töötamas enda ees seisval alusel oleva skulptuuri kallal.
9080.de: Caricature of an artist: full figure of a standing man in profile to the left; working on a sculpture placed on a stand in front of him.

9081.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe põlvpilt profiilis vasakule. Sabakuues. Vasak käsi taskus. Suus suitsev sigaret.
9081.de: Caricature of the artist: half-length portrait of a man in profile to the left. In a tailcoat. Left hand in pocket. A smoking cigarette in his mouth.

9082.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur. vasakus kaenlas mapp. Ees paremal ristikheina õis.
9082.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man, a folder under his left arm. In front on the right a clover blossom.

9083.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe täisfiguur, poolprofiilis vasemale. Vasakus käes palett, paremas pintsel.
9083.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a man, in half-profile facing left. In his left hand a palette, in his right a brush.

9161.d: Keskaegne õu. Paremal müür. Vasakul aed puudega, taga keskaegse telliskivikatusega maja. Korstna kõrval redel.
9161.de: A medieval courtyard. On the right a wall. On the left a garden with trees, behind it a house with a medieval tiled roof. A ladder by the chimney.

9168.d: Esiplaanil eest taha järve äärde suunduv tee kahe inimfiguuriga selgvaates. Kahel pool teed suured puud. Vastaskaldal põõstastiku ja veest tõusva udu läbi paistmas hoone kuppelkatus.
9168.de: In the foreground a road leading from front to back toward a lake, with two human figures in clear view. Large trees on both sides of the road. On the opposite shore, through the bushes and mist rising from the water, the domed roof of a building is visible.

9196.d: Esiplaanil rannariba seisvate figuuridega. Kaks keskset naiskuju valges rõivastuses, nende taga istub pruun koer. Vasakus servas, vees ratsanik hobusel. Silmapiiril tumeroheline metsaviirg. Maalitud hoogsate pintslilöökidega. Koloriit hele.
9196.de: In the foreground a strip of beach with standing figures. Two central female figures in white clothing, behind them a brown dog sitting. On the left edge, in the water, a horseman on a horse. On the horizon a dark green strip of forest. Painted with vigorous brushstrokes. Colouring light.

9201.d: Šarž kunstnikust: kujutatud kukena, mehe peaga profiilis vasakule. Rinnas lill.
9201.de: Caricature of the artist: depicted as a rooster, with a man's head in profile facing left. A flower on the chest.

9221.d: Realistlik varakevadine maastik pildi sügavusse suunduva ojaga esiplaanil paremal. Oja kallastel sulamata lumi, taamal paremal kaks hallikat talumaja. Oja mõlemal kaldal raagus puud, tammedel küljes mullusügisesed lehed. Silmapiiril vasakul väike tammik ja metsaviirg. Ülal selge sinine kevadine taevas.
9221.de: A realistic early-spring landscape with a brook running into the depth of the picture in the foreground on the right. Unmelted snow on the banks of the brook, in the distance on the right two greyish farmhouses. On both banks of the brook, bare trees, the oaks still bearing last autumn's leaves. On the horizon on the left, a small oak grove and a strip of forest. Above, a clear blue spring sky.

9264.d: Ees pesukorv diagonaalselt triikimislaua alla asetatud, selle taga naisfiguur laualt alla rippuvat lina triikimas; taga ripub lina ja paremal näha ahju nurk.
9264.de: In front a laundry basket placed diagonally under the ironing board, behind it a female figure ironing a sheet hanging down from the board; behind, a sheet is hanging, and on the right the corner of a stove can be seen.

9280.d: Tubases interjööris esiplaanil vasakul istuv mees otsevaates, seljas hele särk, tume vest. Paremas, süles olevas käes klaas. Põrnitseb altkulmu. Tema ees potilill. Tagapool paremal roosakas pükskostüümis naine istub sohval, jalg üle põlve, pea poolpöördes paremale. Maalitud lopsakate pintslilöökidega tumedais, lillakasmustjais toonides.
9280.de: In an indoor interior, in the foreground on the left a man sits facing forward, wearing a light shirt and a dark waistcoat. In his right hand, resting in his lap, a glass. He stares from under his brows. In front of him a potted plant. Further back on the right a woman in a pinkish trouser suit sits on a sofa, one leg over the other, her head turned in half-profile to the right. Painted with lush brushstrokes in dark, purplish-blackish tones.

9281.d: Lage maastik. Keskel, vastu sinist, pilvitut taevast, üksik mänd. Puust paremal ja vasakul põõsaste grupid. Silmapiiril kitsas veekogu viirg ja selle taga paistev metsajoon.
9281.de: Open landscape. In the middle, against a blue, cloudless sky, a solitary pine. Groups of bushes to the right and left of the tree. On the horizon a narrow strip of water and beyond it a visible line of forest.

9285.d: Vasakul lahtise uksega lambalauda nurk, uksel seisab halli jaki ja sinise rätiga naine külgvaates. Lauda otsas virn teibaid, päikselisel õuemurul regi. Paremal, karjaaia taga orus poolraagus lehtpuusalu, okste vahelt paistab eresinine taevas. Maalitud värvikalt, detaili jälgivalt.(eesti)
9285.de: On the left the corner of a sheep barn with an open door, a woman in a grey jacket and blue kerchief stands by the door in profile. At the end of the barn a pile of poles, a sledge on the sunlit yard grass. On the right, beyond the pasture fence, a half-bare grove of deciduous trees in the valley, bright blue sky showing through the branches. Painted colourfully, attentive to detail.

9291.d: Pildi sügavusse ahenev, 3-5 korruseliste majadega piiratud tänav. Siin-seal inimesed. All keskel, otsevaates mehe- ja naisefiguur. Ülal vasakul ning keskel paistab majade vahelt tükike sinist taevast.
9291.de: A street narrowing into the depth of the picture, lined with 3-5 storey buildings. People here and there. At the bottom centre, a man's and a woman's figure seen frontally. At the top left and in the middle, a piece of blue sky is visible between the buildings.

9292.d: Noore naise rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule, pilk suunatud tema ees olevasse ovaalsesse peeglisse. Naisel peas barett, poolpikad lokkis juuksed seljal ja paremal põsel, mida kohendab mõlema käega. Seljas ovaalse dekolteega lühikeste käistega kleit. Maalitud punastes-pruunides ja ookertoonides.
9292.de: Bust portrait of a young woman in half-turn to the left, her gaze directed into an oval mirror in front of her. The woman wears a beret, semi-long curly hair on her back and on her right cheek, which she is adjusting with both hands. She wears a dress with an oval décolleté and short sleeves. Painted in red-brown and ochre tones.

9293.d: Esiplaanil, madala kai ääres vees paadid. Samast algab paarikorruseliste agulimajade rivi. Taevas kahvatu sinine. Üldkoloriit hele.
9293.de: In the foreground, boats in the water by a low quay. From there begins a row of two-storey suburban houses. Pale blue sky. Overall light colouring.

9299.d: Otsevaates kompositsioon nelja figuuriga. Esiplaanil all keskel heledama koloriidiga maalitud tumedapäise naise rinnafiguur. Temast paremal - imik. Naise seljataga kolme seisva inimese poolfiguurid. Vasakul rohekas rõivas mees, keskel otsevaates oranžikas - pruunikais toonides riietusega naine, paremal äärel kollakas - rohekais rõivais naine. Kõigi kolme pilgud suunatud keskele alla. Keskel asuva naisfiguuri parem käsi tõstetud esiplaanil oleva naise pea kohale. Paremal seisja seljataga paistab punakais toonides vari. Esiplaanil oleva paljastatud õlgadega noore naise pea kerges pöördes paremale, suunatud imikule.
9299.de: A composition in frontal view with four figures. In the lower foreground, centre, the bust of a dark-haired woman painted in a lighter colouring. To her right - an infant. Behind the woman, half-figures of three standing people. On the left a man in greenish clothing, in the centre, facing front, a woman dressed in orangish-brownish tones, on the right edge a woman in yellowish-greenish clothing. The gazes of all three are directed down towards the centre. The right hand of the woman in the centre is raised above the head of the woman in the foreground. Behind the person standing on the right, a shadow in reddish tones is visible. The head of the young woman with bared shoulders in the foreground is turned slightly to the right, directed towards the infant.

9300.d: Keskplaanil Joakim ja Anna kummardumas paremale ning osundavad kätega nende ees seisvale väikesele Maarjale. Maarjast paremal seisab pjedestaalil Zahharias ning õnnistab Maarjat. Vasakul, Maarja vanematest veidi tagapool, hulk inimesi rohekates rõivastes ning punaste pealismantlitega. Kõige vasakpoolsemal käes põlev küünal. Taustaks arhitektuurielemente ning vasakul kõrgem tornjas maja. Paremas ülemises nurgas trooniv Maarja ingliga. Ikooni tonaalsus rohekas - pruunikas, rõivaste kaunistused, pühakute nimbused ja inglitiivad kuldsed.
9300.de: In the middle ground Joachim and Anna bow to the right and point with their hands to the small Mary standing before them. To the right of Mary, Zacharias stands on a pedestal and blesses Mary. On the left, somewhat behind Mary's parents, a crowd of people in greenish garments with red outer mantles. The leftmost of them holds a burning candle. In the background architectural elements and, on the left, a taller tower-like house. In the upper right corner Mary enthroned with an angel. The tonality of the icon is greenish-brown, the decorations of the garments, the halos of the saints and the angel wings are golden.

9302.d: Laeva lastimistöid kujutav olustikustseen. Esiplaanil kuus tööriietes ja sonides meest laevas kaupa tõstmas ja trosside külge kinnitamas. Lossitava laeva taga vasakul ja paremal suurte laevade ninad ja kai, millel kõnnivad inimesed. Taamal sadama laohooned. Hallides ja pruunides toonides. Kohati pastoosne faktuur.(eesti)
9302.de: A genre scene depicting ship-loading work. In the foreground, six men in work clothes and sou'westers are lifting cargo on the ship and fastening it to ropes. Behind the ship being unloaded, at left and right, are the bows of large ships and a quay along which people are walking. In the distance, harbour warehouse buildings. In grey and brown tones. In places a pastose texture.

9308.d: Laual suur pudel, kaks poolikut kõrvitsat, sibul, peet, kurk. Paremal sinine draperii, mis ulatub pudeli alla, vasakul pruunikas õhemalt maalitud riie. Foon helehall.(eesti)
9308.de: On the table a large bottle, two halved pumpkins, an onion, a beet, a cucumber. On the right a blue drapery reaching under the bottle, on the left a brownish, more thinly painted cloth. Background light grey.

9313.d: Vasakul punaste juuste ja erepunase suu, sirge pisut kongus nina ja mandlisilmadega naise pea. Naise ees tumedate krässus juustega ja suletud silmadega mehe pea. Pildi parem pool ja foon abstraktne värvilaikude kombinatsioon hallikasrohelises ja sinises värvigammas.
9313.de: On the left a woman's head with red hair and a bright red mouth, a straight, slightly hooked nose and almond-shaped eyes. In front of the woman a man's head with dark curly hair and closed eyes. The right side of the picture and the background an abstract combination of colour patches in a greyish-green and blue colour range.

9334.d: Nurk sinise seina ja punase põrandaga ruumist. Esiplaanil ümmargune laud, millel suur kupliga lamp, ja kaks tugitooli. Seintel maale.
9334.de: A corner of a room with a blue wall and a red floor. In the foreground a round table with a large domed lamp, and two armchairs. Paintings on the walls.

9337.d: Sauna interjöör. Paremal pink kibuga, vasakul ahi ja avatud uks. Keskel lava.
9337.de: Interior of a sauna. On the right a bench with a bucket, on the left a stove and an open door. A platform in the middle.

9338.d: Esiplaanil kõverate tüvidega lehtpuud, mille vahelt paistab lagendik. Tagaplaanil sinetab mets.
9338.de: In the foreground deciduous trees with crooked trunks, between which a clearing is visible. In the background a bluish forest.

9376.d: Ees vasakul istuva naise täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale. Vasemal ees raamatuga käes istuv naine, selgvaates. Tema vastas noor last imetav naine. Taga keskel kolm seisvat naisfiguuri.
9376.de: In front on the left, the full figure of a seated woman in half-profile facing right. On the left in front, a woman sitting with a book in her hand, in frontal view. Opposite her a young woman nursing a child. Behind, in the middle, three standing female figures.

9379.d: Esiplaanil kõrkjaid ja veeroogu. Taamal üle vee kalda äärseid maju. Vasakul mets.
9379.de: In the foreground sedges and water weeds. In the distance, across the water, houses along the shore. On the left a forest.

9384.d: Valge linaga kaetud laual sinine kuulvaas punaste ja lillade moonidega. Ümber vaasi õunu.
9384.de: On a table covered with a white cloth, a blue bulbous vase with red and purple poppies. Apples around the vase.

9391.d: Prillidega mehe rinnapilt en face. Pea kerge pöördega paremale. Pruunikas kuues. Taust tumepruun.
9391.de: Bust portrait en face of a man with glasses. Head slightly turned to the right. Brownish coat. Background dark brown.

9392.d: Grupp inimesi - müüja vanaeit ja ostjad tema ümber. Müüja kaalule kala asetamas. Tagapool hobusemehi. Taamal turuplatsi - äärsete majade siluette.
9392.de: A group of people - an old woman seller and buyers around her. The seller placing fish on the scale. Behind, men with horses. In the distance, silhouettes of houses bordering the market square.

9411.d: Tugitoolis istuv mehe poolfiguur, kerge pöördega vasakule, käed põlvedel. Vasakule laual astrid kerakujulises vaasis.
9411.de: Half-figure of a man sitting in an armchair, slightly turned to the left, hands on his knees. To the left on a table asters in a spherical vase.

9445.d: Ees vasakul kaks naist viljavihkudega, paremal alasi juures kaks meest ja naisfiguur. Tagaplaanil keskel kai ääres purjekas.
9445.de: On the left in front, two women with sheaves of grain, on the right by an anvil two men and a female figure. In the background in the centre, a sailing boat by the quay.

9457.d: Pärnu vanalinna hoov: esiplaanil ümara kangialusega maja, mille külgedel paremal väikesed ümarate kaartega uksed. Kangialuses seisab vanker ja hobune. Foonil paistab läbi kangialuse päikesepaisteline õu, punase katuse ja uksega maja ning valged palakad õues nööril rippumas.
9457.de: A courtyard in Pärnu Old Town: in the foreground a house with a round gateway passage, with small round-arched doors on the right side. A cart and a horse stand in the gateway passage. In the background, through the gateway passage, a sunlit yard can be seen, a house with a red roof and door, and white pieces of cloth hanging on a line in the yard.

9462.d: Esiplaanil asuvate väikeste küngaste taga kahe maja pruunid katused ja järvevesi, mille keskel paistab väike, puudega kaetud saar. Tagaplaanil puudemassiivid. Silmapiir suhteliselt madalal, taevas kaetud pilvedega. Koloriit ühtlaselt hallikasroheline. (eesti)
9462.de: In the foreground, behind small hills, the brown roofs of two houses and lake water, in the middle of which a small island covered with trees can be seen. In the background, masses of trees. The horizon is relatively low, the sky covered with clouds. The coloring is uniformly grayish-green.

9480.d: Vasakul Tallinna linnamüür tornidega. Toompea veerul bastionid. All keskel paremale suunduv tee ja põõsad. Hallis taevas napilt markeeritud pilvekuhilad. Roosades ja rohekashallides toonides. (eesti)
9480.de: On the left, the Tallinn town wall with towers. Bastions on the slope of Toompea. Below in the middle a road leading to the right and bushes. In the grey sky sparsely marked cloud masses. In pink and greenish-grey tones. (Estonian)

9487.d: Noore naise põlvpilt poolprofiilis vasakule, istuvas asendis. Looriga kübaras ja karusnahkse kraega mantlis.
9487.de: Knee-length portrait of a young woman in half-profile to the left, in a sitting position. Wearing a veiled hat and a coat with a fur collar.

9509.d: Pastelses, peenelt nüanseeritud, rohekas-beežis koloriidis, stiliseeriva vormikeelega maastikupilt. Esiplaanil kaharate lehekroonidega puud, taamal mäed. Nende jalamil grupp madalaid maju.
9509.de: In a pastel, finely nuanced, greenish-beige colour scheme, a landscape painting with a stylising formal language. In the foreground trees with spreading crowns, beyond mountains. At their foot a group of low houses.

9517.d: Kahel pool teed rukkipõld, mille servi palistavad kirevad aasalilled ning kolm valgetes õites põõsast. Tagaplaanil, künkal tuulik, vasakul paistab talumaja katus. Koloriit hele, maalimislaad detailiseeriv.
9517.de: On both sides of the road a rye field, whose edges are fringed with colourful meadow flowers and three bushes with white blossoms. In the background, on a hill, a windmill, on the left the roof of a farmhouse is visible. The colour scheme is light, the painting style detailed.

9526.d: Kaljumaastiku taustal ees vasakul grupp kuldsete nimbustega jüngreid. Ikooni keskel Kristus, parem käsi tõstetud, osundamas ikooni paremas servas olevale valges rüüs kuldse nimbusega mehele, kes astub välja hauakambrist. Mehe taga grupp üllatunud nägudega inimesi. All keskel kaks naist kummardamas Kristust.
9526.de: Against a background of rocky landscape, in the foreground on the left a group of disciples with golden nimbi. In the middle of the icon Christ, right hand raised, pointing to a man in a white robe with a golden nimbus on the right edge of the icon, stepping out of the tomb chamber. Behind the man a group of people with astonished faces. Below in the middle two women bowing before Christ.

9531.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur. keha profiilis vasemale, pea peaaegu en face, käes palett pintslitega; vasaku kaenla all paragrahvimärk.
9531.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man, body in profile to the left, head almost en face, a palette with brushes in his hand; a paragraph sign under his left arm.

9532.d: Šarž kunstnikust: seisva mehe täisfiguur profiilis paremale. Suus suitsev piip.
9532.de: Caricature of the artist: full figure of a standing man in profile facing right. A smoking pipe in his mouth.

9551.dm: laius: 67.2 cm (arm   ); kõrgus: 49.0 cm; kõrgus: 48.8 cm (arm   ); laius: 67.5 cm
9551.d: Esiplaanil vasakul hobune söömas, keskel pika laua ääres istuvad inimesed ja tantsupaarid murul. Tagaplaanil lehtpuude varjus talu kõrvalhoonetega.
9551.de: In the foreground on the left a horse eating, in the middle people sitting at a long table and dancing couples on the grass. In the background, a farm with outbuildings in the shade of deciduous trees.

9598.d: Istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur, pea kergelt pööratud, üks käsi toetub lauale, teine põlvele, pisut käharduvad hallisegused juuksed, väikese kühmuga nina. Pruun ülikond, valge särk, tumesinine valge kitsa triibuga lips.
9598.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated man, head slightly turned, one hand resting on a table, the other on the knee, slightly curling greyish hair, nose with a small hump. Brown suit, white shirt, dark blue tie with a narrow white stripe.

9619.d: Avatud värvikast pintslite ja pudelitega ja palett värvidega. Kasti taga rippumas valge kittel.
9619.de: An open paint box with brushes and bottles, and a palette with paints. A white smock hanging behind the box.

9620.d: Keskel riidega kaetud akna all oleva laua juures petrooliumlambi valgel, selgvaates istuv poisike. Paremal rinnuli lauale kummarduv naine.
9620.de: In the centre, by a table beneath a curtained window, in the light of a kerosene lamp, a boy sitting in clear view. On the right a woman leaning over the table towards him.

9621.d: Ees paremal maja fassaad trepiga ja kahe laternaga. Tagaplaanil keskelt vasakule suure hoone nurk.
9621.de: In front on the right the façade of a house with a staircase and two lanterns. In the background, from the middle to the left, the corner of a large building.

9626.d: Vasemal talumaja trepil istuv naine. Paremal kooguga kaev, tagapool madal õlgkatusega hoone; selle ja elumaja vahel roigasaed. Taamal aia taga põllud.
9626.de: On the left a woman sitting on the steps of a farmhouse. On the right a well with a sweep, behind it a low thatched-roof building; between it and the dwelling house a pole fence. Beyond the fence, fields.

9647.d: Paljufiguuriline kompositsioon, mille kesksel kohal sõimes lebav Kristus, tema kõrval istuv Maarja. Sõime päitsis ning jalutsis härg ja eesel. Keskel vasakul Kristuse poole tulemas kolm tarka. Paremas servas seisab pasunaga karjane. Ikooni allosas kaks stseeni pühakutega. Ülaosas vasakul ja paremal inglid, keskel Püha Vaimu sümboliseeriv kujutis.
9647.de: A multi-figure composition, at the centre of which Christ lies in a manger, beside him the seated Mary. At the head and foot of the manger, an ox and a donkey. In the middle on the left, three wise men approaching Christ. On the right edge stands a shepherd with a horn. In the lower part of the icon, two scenes with saints. In the upper part, on the left and right, angels, in the centre a depiction symbolising the Holy Spirit.

9649.d: Šarž kunstnikust: mehe täisfiguur, peaaegu en face. Käes lippudega kaunistatud hoone mudel.
9649.de: Caricature of an artist: full figure of a man, almost en face. In his hand a model of a building decorated with flags.

9659.d: Esiplaanil üks valge, üks must ja kaks pruuni hobust vankrite ette rakendatud. Hobuste taga etüüdliku üldistusega antud agulimajad. Rohelised, hallid ja pruunid toonid. Maalitud laia pintsliga, kohati lõuendit läbi paista lastes.(eesti)
9659.de: In the foreground, one white, one black and two brown horses harnessed to carts. Behind the horses, suburban houses rendered with sketch-like generalisation. Green, grey and brown tones. Painted with a broad brush, in places letting the canvas show through.

9679.dm: kõrgus: 43.0 cm; laius: 73.0 cm; laius: 70.0 cm; kõrgus: 47.0 cm
9679.d: Rohtukasvanud jõekäär paadisillaga esiplaanil. Sinisel veel silla all paat, vasakul ujuvad pardid.
9679.de: An overgrown river bend with a boat bridge in the foreground. A boat on the blue water under the bridge, on the left ducks swimming.

9685.d: Kolmest figuurist komponeeritud etüüd: vasakul servas laias mantlis seisev naisefiguur, paremas servas osa toolikorjust, laud paralleelselt pildi allservaga ja laudade taga istuvad kaks mehefiguuri. Kollakaspruun värvigamma.
9685.de: A study composed of three figures: on the left edge a female figure standing in a wide coat, on the right edge part of a chair's back, a table parallel to the lower edge of the picture and behind the tables two seated male figures. A yellowish-brown colour range.

9687.d: Roosakaslillas pilvevahus seisev alasti noormees veerandpöördes paremale. Paremal valgel tormaval hobusel alasti naisfiguur poolselgvaates, vasaku kõverdatud käega ulatab erekollase päikeseketast tema ees seisvale noormehele. Maal roosas, lillas, ultramariinsinises koloriidis, erksad valguslaigud figuuridel.
9687.de: A naked young man standing in pinkish-lilac cloud foam, in a three-quarter turn to the right. On the right, on a white galloping horse, a nude female figure in half-profile, with her bent left hand reaching out a bright yellow sun disc to the young man standing before her. The painting in pink, lilac, ultramarine blue coloring, bright patches of light on the figures.

9704.d: Veekogu-äärne kaldanõlv madalate agulimajade, kuuride, raagus puude, poollagunenud plankaiaga sügistuules. Esiplaanil vee ääres naine pesukorviga, hele riie käes lehvimas. Terav kollakas valgus langeb keskmes olevale maja keskel. Akvarellilikult roosakaspruunid toonid.
9704.de: A sloping bank by a body of water with low suburban houses, sheds, bare trees, a half-ruined plank fence in the autumn wind. In the foreground by the water, a woman with a laundry basket, a light-coloured cloth fluttering in her hand. A sharp yellowish light falls on the house in the middle. Watercolour-like pinkish-brown tones.

9712.d: Esiplaanil pildi sügavusse suunduv kitsas vanalinna tänav majaderägastikuga kahel pool. Vasakul nurgas hall otsaviilu, pilastrite ja kangialustega maja ning heledad punaste katuste ja pikkade korstnatega hooned. Ülal keskel jupike halli taevast. Hallikaspruun koloriit.
9712.de: In the foreground, a narrow old-town street receding into the depth of the picture, with a maze of houses on both sides. In the left corner, a grey gable-end house with pilasters and archways, and light-coloured buildings with red roofs and tall chimneys. Above in the middle, a patch of grey sky. Greyish-brown colouring.

9713.d: Sinakat tooni rätikul tume pudel ja kaks õuna.(eesti)
9713.de: On a bluish-toned cloth, a dark bottle and two apples.

9717.d: Sinakasrohelistes ja kollastes toonides maastiku foonil seisev ja istuv meesakt. Seisva akti parem käsi kõverdatud kuklale, vasakus käes valge rätik. Istuva akti parem käsi toetub vasakule õlale, pea kergelt kallutatud, silmad suletud.(eesti)
9717.de: A standing and a sitting male nude against a landscape background in bluish-green and yellow tones. The standing nude's right hand is bent behind the neck, a white towel in the left hand. The sitting nude's right hand rests on the left shoulder, head slightly tilted, eyes closed.

9718.d: Esiplaanil külavahetee, mida kahelt poolt piirab roigasaed. Sellest vasakul üksik puu ja tuuleveski keset koplit, taamal taluhoone. Esiplaanil paremal õlgkatusega taluhooned puudega nende taga. Taevas tume, pilvine. Maalitud kohati pastoosselt, rohelistes ja pruunides toonides.
9718.de: In the foreground a village road, bordered on both sides by a pole fence. To its left a solitary tree and a windmill in the middle of a paddock, in the distance a farm building. In the foreground on the right, thatched-roof farm buildings with trees behind them. The sky dark, cloudy. Painted in places pastosely, in green and brown tones.

9721.d: Valge padjaga pahmeks muudetud istmel istub lühikeste, lahkukammitud juustega tütarlaps, pea pisut paremale kallutatud, pilk vaatajale suunatud. Tüdrukul seljas valge kraega tumesinise põhjaga väikesemustrilisest riidest kleit, ees valge põll. Tüdruku süles magab pisike kollakashall, triibuline, valge kõhualusega kass. Tüdruku vasak käsi kassi seljal. Foon sulavates veinpunastes ja rohelistes toonides.
9721.de: On a seat made shapeless by a white cushion sits a girl with short, parted-combed hair, her head tilted slightly to the right, her gaze directed at the viewer. The girl wears a dress of small-patterned fabric with a dark blue ground and a white collar, and a white apron in front. In the girl's lap sleeps a small yellowish-grey, striped cat with a white underbelly, asleep. The girl's left hand rests on the cat's back. The background is in blending wine-red and green tones.

A bluish-green strip of forest on the horizon separates a grey, gloomy sky with occasional bright pink-blue streaks. Expressive manner of depiction, greenish-grey, bluish tones.

9952.d: Esiplaanil madala rohuga tume, varjus olev küngas, mille paremal serval kaks, tippudest risti kasvanud puud, neist vasakul madalam puu, siin-seal kivisid. Paremal taamal veekogu, vasakul künka taga aimatav sinakas mets. Päikeseloojangu eelne taevas antud sinakasroheliste triipudena, keskosas päike, ülaosas üksikud kollased jooned. Taeva osa maaling ei kata paberit üleni. Katsetuslik teostuslaad.
9952.de: In the foreground a dark, shadowed hillock with low grass, on whose right edge two trees growing crosswise from their tops, of which the left one is lower, here and there some stones. In the distance on the right a body of water, on the left behind the hillock a bluish forest can be discerned. The sky before sunset is rendered as bluish-green stripes, the sun in the middle section, isolated yellow lines at the top. The painted sky does not cover the paper entirely. Experimental manner of execution.

10303.d: Toolil istuv noor naine poolkülgvaates, pea pööratud vaataja poole, pilk suunatud alla. Naisel lühikesed helepruunid juuksed, kollakas müts peas. Vasak käsi totub tooli seljatoele, parem süles. Parem jalg sirutatud ette, vasak põlvest kõverdatud. Naisel seljas roosakaspunane nööbitav jakk, jalas pikad tumesinised puhvpüksid. Tagapool, interjööris paremal seina ääres pildid. Modelli nägu ja käed vormitud pehmelt, riietus ja foon maalitud laiade, hoogsate tõmmetega.

Her left hand rests on the back of the chair, the right in her lap. The right leg is stretched forward, the left bent at the knee. The woman wears a pinkish-red buttoned jacket, and long dark-blue puffed trousers. Behind her, in the interior on the right along the wall, pictures. The model's face and hands are modelled softly, the clothing and background painted with broad, sweeping strokes.

11589.d: Väikelapse pea, pärani silmade, pruntis põskede, nöbinina ja veidi naeratava suuga, skulptuurivorm pehme ja tundeline, miimika elav.(eesti)
11589.de: Head of a small child, with wide-open eyes, chubby cheeks, a button nose and a slightly smiling mouth, the sculptural form soft and sensitive, the expression lively.

11602.dm: kõrgus: 33.0 cm; sügavus: 2.0 cm; laius: 51.0 cm
11602.d: Pannoo koosneb viiest pildiväljast, keskel kogu pannoo kõrguses sepp tehniliste detailidega, temast vasakul ülal vokiga naine, all kirkaga kaevur; paremal ülal müürsepp, all laevnik ankruga
11602.de: The panel consists of five picture fields, in the middle, across the whole height of the panel, a blacksmith with technical details, above to his left a woman with a spinning wheel, below a miner with a pick; above on the right a mason, below a sailor with an anchor

11610.dm: kõrgus: 50.0 cm; sügavus: 39.0 cm; laius: 15.0 cm
11610.d: Alusel asuval kõrgendikul istuv naisfiguur, ülakeha ette kallutatud. Vasak jalg põlvest kõverdatud, jalalaba toetub kõrgendikule, varbad puudutavad alust. Parem jalg on ette sirutatud, põlvest kergelt kõverdatud, mõlemad käsivarred on sirutatud ette, käed hoiavad jalalaba ümbert kinni. Selg väga elava töötlusega, ribid teravalt välja joonistunud.
11610.de: A female figure sitting on an elevation on a base, upper body leaning forward. The left leg bent at the knee, the foot resting on the elevation, the toes touching the base. The right leg is stretched forward, slightly bent at the knee, both arms are stretched forward, the hands holding the foot around it. The back is very vividly modelled, the ribs sharply delineated.

11633.dm: kõrgus: 51.0 cm; sügavus: 27.5 cm; laius: 48.5 cm
11633.d: Mehe büst kõrge kaelusega vammuses, peas meremeeste tormikübar e. süüdvester, mille serv eest üles tõstetud ja tagant seljale ulatuv. Ninajuurel kaks vertikaalset vagu, ülahuult katavad vuntsid. Teose esi- ja tagakülg poleeritud
11633.de: Bust of a man in a jacket with a high collar, on his head a sailor's storm cap, or sou'wester, the brim of which is turned up at the front and extends down the back at the rear. Two vertical grooves at the bridge of the nose, the upper lip covered by a moustache. The front and back of the work are polished.

11645.dm: kõrgus: 35.0 cm; sügavus: 19.5 cm; laius: 19.0 cm
11645.d: Teismelise tütarlapse puhtajooneline ovaalne nägu madalate sarnadega; vabaks jäetud lauba, kaarjate kulmude, modelleeritud laugudega avatud silmade, sirge nina ning täidlaste huultega. PIKAD juuksed on kogu pea ulatuses lahku kammitud, palmikud algavad kõrvade tagant kahel pool pead, ulatudes õlgadeni. Õlad kitsalt lõigatud, büsti alus kitsas, eest neljakandiline
11645.de: A clean-lined oval face of a teenage girl with low cheekbones; free forehead, arched eyebrows, open eyes with modelled eyelids, a straight nose and full lips. The LONG hair is parted across the whole head, the braids begin behind the ears on both sides of the head, reaching to the shoulders. Shoulders narrowly cut, the base of the bust narrow, square in front

11655.dm: kõrgus: 45.0 cm; sügavus: 28.0 cm; laius: 42.0 cm
11655.d: Noore naise rindportree lühikese lainja soenguga, peened näojooned, puhta lõikega näoovaal, sirge kaunis kael
11655.de: Bust portrait of a young woman with a short wavy hairstyle, delicate facial features, clean-cut oval face, straight beautiful neck

11661.d: Vanema mehe portreebüst otsevaates. Kõhnem kortsudes nägu. Lühikesed, keskelt pikemad ja üle pea kammitud juuksed. Väikeste ovaalsete metallraamidega prillid, ülahuulel suunurkadeni ulatuvad vuntsid, särgikrae, pikk väiksema lipsusõlmega lips, reväärid.
11661.de: A bust portrait of an older man, frontal view. Thinner wrinkled face. Short hair, longer in the middle and combed over the head. Small oval metal-framed glasses, a moustache reaching to the corners of the mouth on the upper lip, shirt collar, a long tie with a small knot, lapels.

11663.dm: kõrgus: 83.5 cm; sügavus: 131.0 cm; laius: 39.0 cm

11663.de: Female nude kneeling, resting on the right leg, the left one set further back, head with short hair bent back to the nape, hands on the chest, drapery covering the right thigh and the pubic area. Base regular, rectangular in shape
